title: Comprador em Supermercado
description:
Sobre Nós

NOSSO TIME SANGUE LARANJA #VEMSERATAK

Somos uma empresa legitimamente baiana, com uma história única que começou a ser escrita por Teobaldo e que evolui a cada dia graças à dedicação de Maria, Antônio, Ana, José, João e de muitos outros associados.

O Atakarejo segue firme rumo ao crescimento. Com trabalho, disciplina e determinação, fazemos o simples muito bem feito, buscando ser a melhor empresa de alimentos da Bahia e uma das 10 maiores do Brasil até 2025. Ter o “Sangue Laranja” é ter paixão por vencer.

Como é Trabalhar Aqui

Quem trabalha no Atakarejo sabe que somos um time com um jeito único de ser. Trabalhamos com propósito, temos uma visão clara, uma missão inspiradora e valores que guiam nossas atitudes. Nosso jeito de ser faz a diferença no dia a dia de colaboradores e clientes, é o sangue laranja que corre em nossas veias. Por isso, buscamos novos talentos dispostos a fazer a diferença conosco.

Principais Responsabilidades

  1. Acompanhar indicadores da carteira;
  2. Executar os processos padronizados do setor;
  3. Contribuir com o planejamento de compras anuais;
  4. Participar de reuniões com fornecedores estratégicos;
  5. Levantar necessidades de compra de produtos para abastecimento nas lojas;
  6. Analisar pesquisa de preços nos concorrentes;
  7. Gerenciar o Mix da categoria;
  8. Negociar receitas comerciais, entre outras atividades.

Qualificações Necessárias

  1. Ensino superior completo ou em andamento em Economia, Engenharia, Administração ou áreas afins;
  2. Pós-graduação desejável;
  3. Experiência prévia no cargo;
  4. Desejável experiência no segmento de Varejo ou Atacado;
  5. Conhecimento intermediário em Pacote Office, Tributos e Sistema de Compras.

description:
Descrição

A Dubai Construtora quer muito ter você em nossa equipe!

title: Analista de Marketing
description:
SOBRE NÓS

A FOLKS é uma Consultoria Healthtech, especializada em transformação digital para instituições de saúde. Aqui, você terá a oportunidade de contribuir diretamente para a inovação no setor de saúde, fazendo parte de uma equipe colaborativa e inovadora. Oferecemos um ambiente que valoriza a criatividade, o aprendizado contínuo e o desenvolvimento profissional. Valorizamos pessoas que gostam de trabalhar em equipe, trocar experiências, respeitar e colaborar!

Sobre a Vaga

Buscamos uma Analista de Marketing para integrar nossa equipe e impulsionar nossas estratégias de marketing e comunicação.

RESPONSABILIDADES E ATRIBUIÇÕES:

Como parte do time, você será responsável por:

  1. Criação de conteúdos: desenvolver posts para Instagram, LinkedIn, copywriting, entre outros.
  2. Produção visual: elaborar materiais como artigos, revistas, apresentações e outros conteúdos visuais (utilizando ferramentas como Canva e PowerPoint).
  3. Captação e edição de mídia: registrar e editar fotos e vídeos em eventos internos e externos, como palestras, workshops, treinamentos e congressos.
  4. E-mail marketing: redigir e gerenciar campanhas de e-mail marketing.
  5. Gestão de leads: organizar e monitorar a captação de leads resultantes de campanhas e anúncios.
  6. Atualização de relatórios: manter documentos internos atualizados e reportar entregas à Gerente de Marketing.

Além dessas responsabilidades, você terá a oportunidade de:

  1. Participar de alinhamentos estratégicos com a equipe comercial e gerentes da FOLKS.
  2. Sugerir ideias e ações para aprimorar campanhas de marketing.
  3. Analisar métricas e resultados para identificar oportunidades de melhoria, com suporte da Gerente de Marketing.

REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES

- Disponibilidade para trabalho híbrido, com presença em São Paulo (próximo à Av. Paulista) pelo menos 1x por semana.
- Experiência prévia em estágio ou como Analista de Marketing.
- Conhecimento em ferramentas de marketing digital, como Google Analytics, SEO, mídias sociais, automação de marketing e CRM.
- Habilidade na produção de conteúdos e uso de ferramentas como Canva, PowerPoint e editores de vídeo.
- Organização, proatividade e capacidade de gerenciar demandas e prazos de forma independente.
- Formação superior completa em Marketing, Comunicação, Administração ou áreas relacionadas.

At RWS, we’re here for one purpose: unlocking global understanding.

Our unrivaled experience and deep understanding of language have been developed over more than 60 years. Our ambition is to create a world where understanding is universal for everyone.

We work with over 80% of the world’s top 100 brands, more than three-quarters of Fortune’s 20 ‘Most Admired Companies,’ and almost all the top pharmaceutical companies, investment banks, law firms, and patent filers. If you like working with smart, passionate people who aim to break down language barriers and give back to communities, then you’ll love life at RWS. Our work recognizes the value of every language and culture. We celebrate differences, are inclusive, and believe that diversity makes us stronger.

We want every employee to grow individually and excel in their careers. In return, we expect all our people to live by our values: partnering with colleagues and clients, adopting a pioneering spirit, being positive in progressing our work, and always delivering on promises.

description:
Digibee is an iPaaS that scales integration workflows while reducing cost and technical debt. Rather than require specialized integration experts, Digibee lets every developer quickly build, test, deploy, govern, and monitor integrations across on-premise and cloud environments using a simple but powerful low-code interface. Founded in São Paulo, Brazil, in 2017 and headquartered in Weston, Florida, our team is widely distributed throughout the Americas. In May of 2023, Digibee closed a Series B funding round of $60 million that is intended to drive our expansion in the United States.

About the role

As a Customer Success Manager at Digibee, you will play a vital role in driving the successful adoption and utilization of our Integration Platform as a Service (iPaaS) solutions. You will be a trusted advisor to our B2B customers, guiding them through their integration journey and ensuring they achieve maximum value from their investment in Digibee. This role requires a strong understanding of integration concepts, excellent communication skills, and a passion for helping customers succeed.

On a daily routine you will..

  • Onboarding and Implementation:
  • Lead the onboarding process for new customers, providing comprehensive training and support on Digibee's iPaaS platform.
  • Collaborate with customers to understand their integration needs and develop tailored implementation plans.
  • Guide customers through configuring and deploying integrations, ensuring a smooth and efficient process.
  • Relationship Management:
  • Build and nurture strong relationships with key stakeholders within customer organizations.
  • Conduct regular check-in meetings to review integration performance, address any challenges, and identify opportunities for improvement.
  • Act as the primary point of contact for customer inquiries and support requests related to Digibee's iPaaS solutions.
  • Proactively monitor customer usage of the platform and identify opportunities to optimize integrations and improve business processes.
  • Educate customers on advanced features and functionalities of Digibee's iPaaS to unlock further value.
  • Track key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure the impact of integrations on customer business outcomes.
  • Retention and Expansion:
  • Proactively identify and mitigate any risks that could lead to customer churn.
  • Develop and execute strategies to increase customer satisfaction and loyalty.
  • Identify and pursue opportunities to expand customer usage of Digibee's iPaaS through upselling and cross-selling.
  • Advocacy and Collaboration:
  • Act as a customer advocate within Digibee, providing feedback to product development and engineering teams to enhance the platform.
  • Collaborate effectively with internal teams (sales, support, engineering) to ensure seamless customer experience.

What you’ll need to bring

  • Proven experience in a customer-facing role, preferably within a SaaS or technology company.
  • Strong understanding of integration concepts, APIs, and iPaaS solutions.
  • Excellent communication, interpersonal, and presentation skills.
  • Ability to build rapport and establish trust with technical and business stakeholders.
  • Proactive and solutions-oriented mindset.
  • Experience using CRM software (e.g., Salesforce) and other customer success tools.
  • Familiarity with Winning by Design methodology is a plus.
  • We’re remote first, with a flexible working schedule
  • Health care and Odonto Plan
  • R$ 1.200,00/month on Caju card (for food and meal allowance, mobility, home office
    supplies, culture, health, and education)
  • Life insurance
  • Child care assistance
  • Gympass
  • English course: we have a partnership for group classes for R$100 monthly
  • Equity Program (RSUs)

Our culture

We believe in a highly collaborative work environment in order to foster constant development and exchange between teams. We encourage learning, sharing knowledge, and using new technologies to create disruptive ideas - we want to create something great together!

At Digibee, we know it's our people who make the difference. We embrace and value diversity and are dedicated to encouraging a supportive and respectful culture in our community.

title: Solutions Architect - WMS Systems
description:
Join to apply for the Solutions Architect - WMS Systems role at Freshpet

4 days ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Join to apply for the Solutions Architect - WMS Systems role at Freshpet

Who We Are
Freshpetis a family of pet-loving humans guided by a simple mission: to positively impact pets, people and the planet shared by all. Freshpet employees work hard as a team and get rewarded generously for their dedication and effort. From real career growth, mentorship, stock ownership and competitive pay and benefits for employees and their families — and their fur families, too! — Freshpet aims to make work a rewarding, fun and inspiring part of life. Plus, there are so many ways to contribute atFreshpet. Whether it’s finance, manufacturing, HR, marketing, engineering, innovation or other functions, the company is rapidly growing and always seeking motivated and passionate people to join theFreshpetfamily. Come joinFreshpet’smission to bring the power of real, fresh food to pets.
What You Will Do
Freshpet is seeking a hands-on Functional Solution Architect specializing in Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations (D365 F&O) Advanced Warehousing, including the Warehouse Management System (WMS) app. This role will be responsible for designing, configuring, maintaining, and supporting warehouse operations within D365.
Solution Design & Implementation

  • Design, configure, and deploy D365 Advanced Warehousing & WMS for Freshpet’s warehouse operations.
  • Lead the setup of inbound (receiving, put-away), outbound (picking, packing, shipping), and inventory management processes.
  • Configure wave processing, work templates, location directives, cycle counting, and replenishment strategies.
  • Optimize warehouse layouts, storage zones, and inventory tracking for real-time visibility.
  • Implement WMS Mobile App configurations for barcode scanning, picking workflows, and label printing.
System Support & Continuous Improvement
  • Act as the go-to expert for D365 Advanced Warehousing, resolving system issues and optimizing processes.
  • Monitor and maintain warehouse system performance, ensuring seamless operations.
  • Work with end-users and warehouse teams to troubleshoot issues and enhance system usability.
  • Stay current on Microsoft’s D365 roadmap, evaluating and implementing new features.
Business Collaboration & Process Optimization
  • Partner with Logistics, Operations, and Supply Chain teams to translate business needs into system solutions.
  • Identify and implement warehouse automation opportunities to improve productivity.
  • Provide training and support for warehouse users on best practices and system functionality.
  • Collaborate with third-party logistics (3PLs) and integration teams to ensure seamless data flow.
How You Will Make An Impact
As a key member of the Business Systems team, this individual will work closely with Logistics, Operations, and Supply Chain teams as well as our implementation partner to optimize warehouse processes, improve efficiency, and drive automation. The ideal candidate is a techno-functional expert with deep business process knowledge and thrives in a hands-on role.
What You Will Bring
Required
  • 5+ years of experience in D365 F&O Advanced Warehousing & WMS.
  • Hands-on expertise in warehouse configuration, picking/packing workflows, wave processing, and inventory control.
  • Strong understanding of warehouse execution processes and system-driven optimizations.
  • Experience with WMS Mobile App setup, RF scanning, and label printing.
  • Ability to troubleshoot system issues, optimize workflows, and train end-users.
Preferred
  • Experience in food & beverage, manufacturing, or consumer goods industries.
  • Knowledge of 3PL integrations, TMS connectivity, and warehouse automation.
  • Familiarity with Power Automate, Power Apps, or Azure DevOps for process automation is a plus.
What We Offer
At Freshpet, we offer a competitive salary and an excellent benefits package, including medical, dental and vision insurance, basic and optional life insurance, short- and long-term disability protection, flexible spending accounts, and a 401(k) plan with company match, paid parental leave, pet insurance, tuition assistance, a generous PTO plan and so much more!
Our Commitment To a Diverse Workforce
At Freshpet, we embrace and encourage our employees’ differences in age, sex, color, disability, ethnicity, family or marital status, gender identity or expression, language, national origin, physical and mental ability, political affiliation, race, religion, sexual orientation, socio-economic status, veteran status, and other characteristics that make our employees unique.
Freshpet aims to foster, cultivate and preserve a culture of diversity, equity and inclusion. Our employees are our most valuable assets. The collective sum of the individual differences, life experiences, knowledge, inventiveness, innovation, self-expression, unique capabilities and talent that our employees invest in their work represents a significant part of not only our culture, but our reputation and company’s achievement as well. Freshpet is an Equal Opportunity Employer.
Disclaimers
We are interested in every qualified candidate who is eligible to work in the United States. However, we are not able to sponsor visas.

All resumes submitted by search firms to any employee at Freshpet via-email, the Internet or in any form and/or method without a valid written search agreement in place for this position will be deemed the sole property of Freshpet. Telavita está democratizando o acesso a um cuidado de saúde emocional de qualidade. Os programas da Telavita acompanham os pacientes durante toda sua jornada de cuidado, desde o diagnóstico inicial, com terapias digitais, teleconsultas de psicologia e psiquiatria até a melhoria clínica. Com isso, temos muitas possibilidades de otimização de experiência, ganho de eficiência e aumento da eficácia em tratamentos.   6. Conduzir a evolução e o desenvolvimento dos produtos da Telavita.

UNDP is committed to achieving workforce diversity in terms of gender, nationality and culture. Background

Position Information

Governance, Women’s Leadership and Participation

Reports to (Title/Level): Portfolio Manager/Head of Gender-responsive Governance, Women’s Leadership and Participation/NO-B, with matrix supervision of Deputy Representative/Head of Programme Unit

Contract Modality: Service Contract (SC)

Duties and Responsibilities

Organizational Context

UN Women, grounded in the vision of equality enshrined in the Charter of the United Nations, works for the elimination of discrimination against women and girls; the empowerment of women; and the achievement of equality between women and men as partners and beneficiaries of development, human rights, humanitarian action and peace and security.

The UN Women Country Programme in Brazil is implemented in line with the national development priorities, as well as in the framework of the international commitments to gender equality and empowerment of women, as well as the UN frameworks and instruments on Human Rights, of which Brazil is signatory.

The UN Women Country Office in Brazil focuses on three key areas:

  • Women lead, participate in, and benefit equally from governance systems
  • Women have income security, decent work, and economic autonomy
  • All women and girls live a life free from all forms of violence

Reporting to the Portfolio Manager/Head of Women’s Leadership and Governance Area and with matrix supervision of the Deputy Representative/Head of the Programme Unit, the Project Manager provides programme support to the effective management of UN Women programmes and projects in the Brazil Country Office by contributing to the programme and project design, formulation, implementation and evaluation. The Project Manager works in close collaboration with the programme and operations team, UN Women HQ and Regional Office staff, UN System partners, Government officials, multi and bilateral donors and civil society ensuring successful UN Women programme implementation under portfolio.

Key Functions and Accountabilities

  1. Contribute technically to the development of programme strategies in Gender-responsive Governance, Women’s Leadership and Participation
    • Provide technical inputs to the design and formulation of programme/ project proposals and initiatives related to Gender-responsive Governance, Women’s Leadership and Participation.
  2. Provide technical support to the implementation and management of the Gender-responsive Governance, Women’s Leadership and Participation programme
    • Provide inputs to the annual workplan and budget as required.
    • Coordinate and monitor the implementation of programme activities.
    • Coordinate the call/request for proposals, including the organization of technical review committees, and capacity assessment of partners.
    • Review and coordinate the submission of implementing partner financial and narrative reports.
    • Train partners on Results Based Management.
  3. Provide technical assistance and capacity development support to project/programme partners
    • Provide technical support to and technically oversee the implementation of programme activities with partners.
    • Identify opportunities for capacity building of partners and coordinate and facilitate technical/ programming support and trainings to partners as needed.
  4. Provide technical inputs to the monitoring and reporting of the programme/ project
    • Monitor progress on programme activity, results, and indicators.
    • Monitor the implementation of proposals by responsible partners.
    • Provide inputs to quarterly reports, donor reports and other reports on outputs, results outputs, and outcomes.
  5. Provide technical inputs to the management of people and finances of Gender-responsive Governance, Women’s Leadership and Participation programme
    • Monitor budget implementation and programme activity expenditures and perform budget revisions when required.
    • Provide inputs to financial reports.
    • Oversee the work of Programme Associates and Assistants as needed.
  6. Contribute to building partnerships and resource mobilization strategies
    • Provide inputs to resource mobilization strategies; analyze and maintain information and databases.
    • Provide inputs to relevant documentation such as project summaries, conference papers, briefing notes, speeches, and donor profiles.
  7. Provide technical inputs to inter-agency coordination on Gender-responsive Governance, Women’s Leadership and Participation
    • Provide technical support to the Representative and National Programme Officer on inter-agency coordination related activities by providing inputs to background reports and briefs.
  8. Provide inputs to advocacy, knowledge building and communication efforts
    • Provide technical inputs to background documents, briefs and presentations related to Gender-responsive Governance, Women’s Leadership and Participation.
    • Coordinate and support the organization of advocacy activities and campaigns events, trainings, workshops, and knowledge products.
    • Provide inputs to the development of knowledge management products on Gender-responsive Governance, Women’s Leadership and Participation.

The incumbent performs other duties within their functional profile as deemed necessary for the efficient functioning of the Office and the Organisation.

Supervisory/Managerial Responsibilities:
The incumbent may be requested to supervise programme/project assistants in the thematic area (SB3/4). S/he will also supervise affiliate personnel (consultants).

  • Respect for Diversity
  • Integrity
  • Professionalism

  • Awareness and Sensitivity Regarding Gender Issues
  • Programme formulation, implementation, monitoring and evaluation skills.
  • Knowledge of Results Based Management.
  • Ability to gather and interpret data, reach logical conclusions, and present findings.
  • Good analytical skills.
  • Good knowledge of Gender-responsive Governance, Women’s Leadership and Participation.

Required Skills and Experience

Recruitment Qualifications

Education and Certification:

  • Post-Graduation courses (Stricto Sensu: Master’s or Doctor’s degree) or equivalent in social sciences, human rights, gender/ women’s studies, international development, or a related field, or additional 06 years of relevant technical experience to the post, beyond the requirement, is required.
  • A project/programme management certification (such as PMP, PRINCE2, or MSP) would be an added advantage.

Experience:

  • At least 6 years of relevant work experience in development programme/project implementation, coordination, monitoring and evaluation, donor reporting and capacity building.
  • Experience in Gender-responsive Governance, Women’s Leadership and Participation is an asset.
  • Experience in intersectional approach to human rights is an asset.
  • Experience coordinating and liaising with government agencies and/or donors is an asset.

Languages:

  • Fluency in English and Portuguese is required.
  • Knowledge of the other UN official working language is an asset.

Diversity and Inclusion

At UN Women, we are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive environment of mutual respect. UN Women recruits, employs, trains, compensates, and promotes regardless of race, religion, color, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, ability, national origin, or any other basis covered by appropriate law.

The role

We seek a professional with a strong infosec background and clear IT relationship to join our Global GRC Team. This role focuses on implementing regulatory frameworks, safeguarding assets, and ensuring information security across regions. The ideal candidate will have expertise in infosec controls, risk management, and technical security measures, with the ability to translate security requirements into business processes. Responsibilities include assessing security controls, supporting compliance, conducting risk assessments (vendor, project, third-party), and assisting in security assessments to improve security posture.

Top Key Responsibilities

  • Support the implementation and maintenance of the global ISMS (ISO27001) for LATAM, evaluating compliance and follow-up actions.
  • Identify security risks related to information assets, technical environment, third-party relationships, or operational processes.
  • Conduct security assessments across applications to identify vulnerabilities and strengthen security.
  • Investigate technological solutions to enhance security measures and compliance (e.g., DLP, endpoint protection, network security).
  • Apply technical and administrative controls across network security, access management, cloud security, endpoint security, physical security, third-party risk, legal compliance, and operational security.
  • Identify threats and risks that could compromise confidentiality, integrity, or availability of information or systems.
  • Analyze third-party solutions for security risks prior to adoption, requiring knowledge of protocols, cloud environments, and databases.
  • Contribute to security awareness materials and measure their effectiveness.
  • Perform routine activities to ensure ongoing compliance with security frameworks and legislation.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Systems Engineering, or equivalent.
  • Minimum of 5 years in the Security Industry.
  • Proven experience in:
    • Security controls management
    • Risk assessments and mitigation strategies
    • Cloud security (AWS, GCP, Azure)
    • Endpoint security
    • Email security protocols (SPF, DMARC, DKIM)
    • Third-party risk management
    • Security awareness and training
  • Upper Intermediate English level, tested during the interview.

Preferred Qualifications

  • +2 years in roles such as Security Consultant or Security Compliance Analyst.
  • Information Security certifications or trainings.

What We Are Looking For

  • Excellent communication and social skills.
  • Ability to present security topics to technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Self-directed, resourceful, critical thinker with attention to detail.
  • Organized and results-oriented.
  • Willing to learn and improve continuously.
  • Passionate about self-improvement and process enhancement.

About Monks

Monks is the digital brand of S4Capital, offering global marketing and technology services. Recognized for innovation, it combines content production, enterprise technology, and data science, powered by AI, to help brands stay ahead. Monks has received numerous industry awards and is committed to diversity and inclusion.

As a Delivery Manager, you are a leader within one or more software development teams, helping them be more productive through the management, coordination and facilitation of the team’s current operational workload.

This includes:

  • Proactively identifying and removing obstacles to progress;
  • Investigating, identifying and implementing changes to improve the systems, processes and tools employed by the team to deliver their work;

You help people find common ground and help them to achieve outcomes beyond what they thought possible. You are curious; you want to know how things work and enjoy thinking of ways to improve them.

You can adapt your approach to suit the demands of the situation. At some times, this may mean applying an analytical approach (i.e. gathering supporting data to justify a process change) and at other times, a people-focussed one (i.e. understanding the motivations of key stakeholders and finding ways to satisfy them for a true win-win).

You are a leader, who unites people and makes sure they have the support they need to succeed. You see a job well done as its own reward, as building and maintaining trust with your team is essential to success as a Delivery Manager.

If you come from a process engineering, change management, or project management background then we’d love to meet you. These recognitions highlight LVHN's commitment to teamwork, compassion, and technology with an unrelenting focus on delivering the best health care possible every day.

Whether you're considering your next career move or your first, you should consider Lehigh Valley Health Network.

Summary

Provides professional nursing care through skillful assessment, diagnosis, outcomes identification, planning, implementation, and evaluation in accordance with facility or department policies and procedures. Directs and manages the care of designated patients. Utilizes effective and appropriate communication styles. Assists in maintaining a safe work environment and maintains clinical and professional competency as appropriate to the population of patients served.

Job Duties

  • Assesses, plans, implements, and evaluates the care for designated patients. Recognizes the need for and initiates collaboration/communication with physicians, interdisciplinary team members, and takes actions to proactively resolve patients needs. Synthesizes available data, information, and knowledge relevant to the situation to make decisions which optimize patient outcomes based on ANA Scope and Standards of Practice and the Code of Ethics.
  • Demonstrates commitment to quality and safety, in accordance with established policies and procedures, utilizing evidence-based practice. Participates in evidence-based practice and research projects as applicable.
  • Uses effective and appropriate verbal and non-verbal communication styles with patients, significant others, visitors, staff, and professional colleagues.
  • Coordinates and provides patient and family education throughout treatment course to facilitate an effective transition of care.
  • Functions as a department team member to support unit and hospital goals and objectives. Participates in all phases of the performance improvement process, including organizational and unit-based patient experience goals.
  • Performs validated technical skills based upon clinical specialty and unit practice.
  • Utilizes technology and incorporates technology to optimize alternative modes of care delivery.
  • Demonstrates leadership and team building skills including teaching and mentoring new colleagues and department interns, delegating on the basis of skills and expertise of team member, acuity and specific needs of the patient, and time availability of team members, and providing input as requested for performance appraisals of care delivery team members.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Graduate of accredited Nursing program.
  • Knowledge and competence that reflects current nursing practice.
  • Ability to organize and prioritize assignments in the delivery of patient care.
  • Successful completion of additional orientation programs related to specialty.
  • Attainment and maintenance of unit-specific competencies.
  • Basic computer skills.
  • American Heart Association Basic Life Support - State of Pennsylvania Upon Hire.
  • RN - Licensed Registered Nurse_PA - State of Pennsylvania Upon Hire.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree Nursing.

Physical Demands

Lift and carry 40-50 lbs. Examples: Push/pull patients on bed, stretcher (requires 29 lbs. push force), lateral transfers up to 50 lbs. of the patient's weight. Frequent to continuous standing/walking. Patient transporters can walk 8-10 miles per shift. Patient care providers may be required to perform activities specific to their role including kneeling, bending, squatting and performing CPR.

Join to apply for the MÉDICO ORTOPEDISTA - HOSPITAL MUNICIPAL PEDRO II role at SPDM/PAIS - Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde

Desde dezembro de 2015, a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Municipal Pedro II .

A infraestrutura do Hospital conta com dez andares, nos quais estão distribuídos os serviços de emergência e de Unidade de Tratamento Intensivo (UTI) adulta, pediátrica e neonatal; maternidade; clínica médica, cirurgia-geral e bucomaxilofacial, neurocirurgia, psiquiatria, pediatria e ortopedia. Exames de imagem (raio X, tomografia, ultrassonografia, eletrocardiografia, ecocardiografia) e laboratoriais também são realizados na unidade.

Devido à grande população de idosos da Zona Oeste, região assistida pelo Hospital Municipal Pedro II (HMPII), há duas Enfermarias destinadas ao atendimento desse público.

O Centro de Tratamento de Queimados é outro diferencial entre os serviços oferecidos, e que dispõe de uma UTI exclusiva para prevenir infecções, que podem ser muito graves para quem está com queimaduras.

Além disso, a unidade conta com a Coordenação de Emergência Regional (CER) Santa Cruz, que possui 39 leitos, e tem como objetivo absorver as demandas de menor complexidade, deixando o HMPII liberado para os casos de risco iminente de morte, necessidade de cirurgia urgente e/ou internação. Um diferencial deste CER é o fato de possuir atendimento especializado em Psiquiatria e Obstetrícia.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Realizar atendimento clínico e cirúrgico em Ortopedia nas áreas: CER, enfermarias, centro cirúrgico, unidade de terapia intensiva e ambulatório do Hospital.

title: Industrial Project Implementation Specialist
description:
Why join us

TRACTIAN is transforming the industrial world by empowering frontline maintenance workers to achieve more. We’ve fused cutting-edge hardware with innovative software into one powerful platform, disrupting legacy systems and delivering smarter, faster solutions for our clients.

At TRACTIAN, you'll break boundaries, question convention, and collaborate with top talent to drive real change. As a part of our growth-stage startup, you’ll work alongside the founders, shaping the vision, products, and experiences that will define the future of industrial tech.

Customer at TRACTIAN

The Customer team is the driving factor behind lifetime value, retention and expansion at Tractian. We focus on expanding inside existing customers, cross-selling to different products, and building even stronger relationships with our current accounts. Our Enterprise customers are comprised of Fortune 500 companies, such as Hyundai, Bosch, Unilever, Suzano, PepsiCo, and others. Every member of our team directly affects the results of our clients. As part of this team, you will be in contact with clients to understand their needs and help create solutions to improve their maintenance processes.

What you'll do

As an Implementation Engineer at TRACTIAN, you will be responsible for deploying and maintaining cutting-edge Condition-based Monitoring (CbM) solutions for our industrial clients. You will work directly with Reliability teams, ensuring that best practices in asset management and predictive maintenance are effectively implemented.

You will lead the project implementation from initiation to Go-Live, ensuring seamless system integration into manufacturing and industrial environments. Additionally, you will conduct alignment meetings with clients, define deadlines and deliverables, and ensure the quality of project implementation.

Your role will provide clients with reliable tools to optimize machine performance and predictive maintenance. Your expertise will drive our mission to enhance machine reliability and operational efficiency.

Responsibilities

  1. Project Management: Manage all project stages, ensuring that deadlines and deliverables are met within the stipulated timeframe.
  2. Client Alignment Meetings: Conduct alignment meetings with clients, define deadlines and deliverables, and ensure the quality of project implementation.
  3. Technical Asset List Review: Review the technical asset list, ensuring that all necessary information is available for a safe and effective project implementation.
  4. Process Mapping: Conduct a full process mapping of the client's operations, identifying key performance indicators, key users, and internal champions to drive project adoption.
  5. Master Field Installation Plan: Develop the Master Field Installation Plan, a technical reference document that will guide the installation process, prioritize sensor placement, and include the necessary regulatory standards to ensure proper sensor installation.
  6. Structured Handoff: Ensure a well-structured handoff process, guaranteeing the complete transfer of information to internal teams and securing the project's long-term success.
  7. Continuous Improvement: Collaborate with cross-functional teams to enhance system implementations and provide feedback on product development, ensuring solutions effectively meet industrial client needs.

Requirements

  1. Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Mechanical, Electrical, Production, Mechatronics, Automation).
  2. Strong knowledge of Maintenance and Reliability Project Management.
  3. Solid troubleshooting skills with expertise in real-time monitoring.
  4. Problem-solving mindset with a proactive approach to continuous improvement.
  5. Excellent communication skills for client training and documentation purposes.
  6. Knowledge of maintenance performance indicators (MTTR, MTBF, MTTA, among others).
  7. Proficiency in Project Management Software and Project Management Methodologies (MS Project).
  8. Knowledge of CRM systems (HubSpot).

Bonus Points

  1. Advanced/Fluent proficiency in English and Spanish.

Compensation

  1. Competitive salary and stock options.
  2. Optional fully funded English / Spanish courses.
  3. 30 days of paid annual leave.
  4. Education and courses stipend.
  5. Employee Giving.
  6. Earn a trip anywhere in the world every 4 years.
  7. Day off during the week of your birthday.
  8. Up to R$1.000/mo for meals and remote work allowance.
  9. Health plan with national coverage and without coparticipation.
  10. Dental Insurance: we help you with dental treatment for a better quality of life.
  11. Gympass and Sports Incentive: R$300/mo extra if you practice activities.

title: VP - CSR Business Unit
description:
ABEC is at the forefront of innovation in our industry, offering highly differentiated products and services driving exceptional growth. As we expand to meet increased demand and new opportunities, we seek talented individuals to join our team and support our continued success.

We’re in a significant growth phase, with multiple key roles open across our organization. If you’re qualified for multiple positions, we encourage you to apply for the role that aligns most with your skills and experience.

Company Background:

For over 50 years, ABEC has been a leading supplier to the biopharmaceutical manufacturing industry. ABEC’s unique value is based on combining long experience with the ability to engineer, design, manufacture, commission, qualify, and service the entire bioprocess to reduce overall cost, shorten time to market, and maximize productivity. ABEC’s products include process and equipment engineering/consulting services, comprehensive site services, and stainless steel and single-use bioprocess equipment, including bioreactors and fermenters, filtration and chromatography systems, prep and hold systems, and cleaning/sterilization systems.

Position Summary:

As a member of ABEC’s executive staff, the Vice President, CSR Business Unit leads all go-to-market activity for ABEC’s CSR Single Use Systems products, including Sales, Applications, Product Management, Product Marketing, Customer Experience (CX), and New Product Development. This position is accountable for the long-term growth and profitability of the CSR product line. The VP CSR BU is responsible for overall product lifecycle management and strategy, while growing revenue and market share for current products and ensuring customer support excellence.

Responsibilities:

  • Define, prioritize, and implement product improvement and product cost reduction opportunities.
  • Define, implement, and manage optimal sales and product marketing strategies.
  • Monitor process and equipment technologies, methods, and advancements within the industry. Identify potential gaps and manage a pipeline of potential new products from the ideation through conceptual design stage gates.
  • Track and report BU performance metrics. Update and modify performance metrics as appropriate.
  • Track and understand competitor capabilities and activities.
  • Advance personnel and organizational development to ensure alignment with BU goals. Provide mentorship to potential leaders.
  • Interface regularly with other ABEC business units to leverage company-wide capabilities and support overall ABEC success.
  • Advise on and support top-level ABEC corporate initiatives.
  • Exemplify ABEC culture and values.

Qualifications:

  • Minimum of 15 years’ experience in the cGMP biopharmaceutical clinical/commercial manufacturing industry. Strong industry knowledge of customers’ operations and processes.
  • Strong background in capital equipment engineering, design, operation, product development, and/or product management.
  • Demonstrated history of successful direct line management including establishing teams and developing personnel.
  • Excellent strategic planning and communication skills.
  • Demonstrated experience in establishing procedures and metrics as well as continuous improvement.
  • Knowledge of upstream and/or downstream bioprocess equipment, including fermenters, bioreactors, filtration systems, and chromatography systems. Single-use systems knowledge highly preferred.
  • BS Degree in Engineering or Science, MBA a plus.
  • Ability to travel globally.

title: Manager, Commercial Planning
description:
Why PlayStation?

PlayStation isn’t just the Best Place to Play — it’s also the Best Place to Work. Today, we’re recognized as a global leader in entertainment producing The PlayStation family of products and services including PlayStation5, PlayStation4, PlayStationVR, PlayStationPlus, acclaimed PlayStation software titles from PlayStation Studios, and more.

PlayStation also strives to create an inclusive environment that empowers employees and embraces diversity. We welcome and encourage everyone who has a passion and curiosity for innovation, technology, and play to explore our open positions and join our growing global team.

The PlayStation brand falls under Sony Interactive Entertainment, a wholly-owned subsidiary of Sony Group Corporation.

Manager, Commercial Planning

S ao Paulo, Brazil (Hybrid)

The Manager, Commercial Planning will support demand forecasting across all PlayStation Categories (Hardware, Software and Peripherals) for the Latin America Region. In this role, you will collaborate with cross functional teams across Global, Americas, and local Latin American markets to contribute to a robust, consensus based demand plan. This position plays an important role in aligning demand with supply, improving forecast accuracy, supporting new product introductions, and driving S&OP processes to ensure operational efficiency and customer satisfaction.

You will have an opportunity to apply your business acumen, analytical mindset and organizational skills to help scale a growing regional business.

Reporting to the Head of Sales, PlayStation LATAM, this role supports key planning activities and offers visibility into strategic decision-making.

What You’ll Do:

  1. Lead and coach a regional commercial planning team, fostering collaboration, development, and performance excellence.
  2. Contribute to the development and execution of short- and long-term demand forecasts at product, category, and channel levels, using historical data, market trends, and promotional inputs.
  3. Support the S&OP process by working closely with Sales, Marketing, Finance, and Supply Chain teams to ensure alignment and accuracy.
  4. Act as a key liaison between regional sales teams, marketing, and operations to maintain coordinated and well-informed demand plans.
  5. Assist in building the yearly budget, quarterly forecast and monthly flash sales plans and follow its performance, reporting and explain variances.
  6. Support executive-level reporting and presentations with accurate and insightful forecasting data.
  7. Engage with channel teams to collaborate on forecasting and obtain and ensure that current and accurate information is used for demand forecasts.
  8. Monitor assumptions, risks, and opportunities impacting the demand plan, and communicate implications as needed.
  9. Review historical sales trends, research demand drivers, prepare forecast data, develop statistical forecast models, and evaluate results.
  10. Coordinate with Global and Americas planning teams to communicate market requirements and updates.
  11. Support Sales, MKT and Head of Sales on ad-hoc analysis to run the business. Manage day to day sales and planning operation.
  12. Improve data quality by ongoing validation & follow up of sell-out and sell-through.
  13. Understand new product introduction roadmaps to manage product transitions.

What We’re Looking For:

  1. 8+ years of relevant experience in Demand Planning, Supply Chain, Operations or Sales Planning.
  2. Bachelor’s degree in Business, Analytics, Engineering or related field.
  3. Past experience directly managing and developing a team while delivering strong business outcomes.
  4. Solid understanding of forecasting processes, S&OP, and commercial planning.
  5. Familiarity with planning tools such as SAP/IBP.
  6. Highly analytical, data-driven decision maker with strong organizational and prioritization skills.
  7. Ability to interpret complex data sets (both qualitative and quantitative) and present findings clearly and effectively.
  8. Collaborative team player with excellent communication skills and a solution-oriented mindset.
  9. Enthusiastic and confident team player with excellent verbal and written communication skills; able to connect and collaborate effectively across diverse teams. Brings an innovative mindset and learns quickly in dynamic environments.
  10. Clear and concise written skills. Ability to concept, write and develop persuasive, organized presentations.
  11. High level of organization and flexibility to deal with urgent requests.
  12. Proficient in Excel and PowerPoint.
  13. Bilingual in English is a must (Spanish is a plus).

title: Desenvolvedor Denodo
description:
Sobre a Digi:

Com inúmeras certificações nas principais tecnologias, a Digisystem conta hoje com uma infraestrutura robusta para prestar serviços de soluções em TI.

Fundada em 1990, em São Paulo, são mais de 30 anos de experiência no mercado, mais de 1000 funcionários com alto nível de especialização é o seu melhor parceiro na jornada da Transformação Digital.

Nós entendemos do negócio e transformamos tecnologia em resultado.

Como será o seu dia a dia:

Escopo: Desenvolver soluções de dados de variadas complexidades utilizando a plataforma Denodo para a modelagem, virtualização, otimização e integração de dados trabalhando com diversas fontes de dados.

Responsabilidades:

  1. Modelagem e Virtualização de Dados: Criar camadas de abstração para integrar dados de múltiplas fontes (bancos de dados, APIs, arquivos, data lakes, etc.). Definir modelos de dados virtuais otimizados para consumo por aplicações e usuários. Criar views lógicas para organizar e transformar os dados conforme as necessidades do negócio.
  2. Desenvolvimento e Otimização de Consultas: Escrever queries otimizadas em Denodo VQL (Virtual Query Language). Melhorar a performance de consultas através de técnicas como caching, indexação e partitioning. Configurar e testar diferentes métodos de delegação de queries para fontes de dados externas.
  3. Integração e Conectividade: Conectar o Denodo a diversas fontes, como bancos de dados relacionais (SQL Server, Oracle, PostgreSQL), APIs REST/SOAP, arquivos CSV/JSON/XML, data lakes e sistemas legados. Configurar drivers JDBC, ODBC e Web Services para permitir que outras aplicações consumam dados virtualizados. Desenvolver integrações com ferramentas de BI (Power BI, Tableau, Qlik, Looker) e ETL.
  4. Segurança e Governança de Dados: Implementar controles de acesso baseados em perfis de usuários e regras de negócio. Gerenciar permissões e autenticação (LDAP, OAuth, SAML, Active Directory). Assegurar conformidade com regulamentações de proteção de dados (LGPD, GDPR).
  5. Monitoramento e Manutenção: Acompanhar o desempenho e a estabilidade dos serviços Denodo. Identificar e resolver problemas de conectividade, latência e erros em queries. Implementar boas práticas de log e auditoria para rastreabilidade dos acessos aos dados.

Requisitos:

  • Experiência em virtualização e integração de dados utilizando a Plataforma Denodo (VQL)
  • Sólidos conhecimentos em Banco de dados relacionais e não relacionais
  • Experiência avançada em SQL para queries complexas, otimização e indexação
  • Familiaridade com APIs REST/SOAP e WebServices

Diferenciais:

  • Experiência com ETL e Data Integration
  • Inglês
  • Certificação Denodo Platform 9 Certified Developer Associate
  • Certificação Denodo Platform 9 Certified Developer Professional
  • Certificação Denodo Platform 9 Certified Administrator Associate

Na Digisystem, valorizamos a diversidade e entendemos que o que acrescenta é justamente ideias e pontos de vistas variados. A Syngenta Crop Protection mantém as plantas seguras desde o plantio até a colheita. Desde o momento em que uma semente é plantada até a colheita, as culturas precisam ser protegidas de ervas daninhas, insetos e doenças, bem como secas e inundações, calor e frio.

  • Projetar e desenvolver soluções backend escaláveis utilizando Node.js .
  • Projetar e desenvolver soluções frontend e mobile escaláveis usando HTML, CSS, JavaScript/TypeScript, React e React Native .
  • Liderar decisões técnicas e arquiteturais em ambientes AWS : ECS , Lambda , RDS , API Gateway , Route53 , Secrets Manager e Pinpoint .

WL4A

Na Syngenta somos altamente focados em pessoas - buscamos profissionais comprometidos/as, colaborativos/as e com excelência na execução. Valorizamos líderes que se comunicam efetivamente, desenvolvem equipes e lideram com o exemplo. Nossa indústria e funções estão mudando rapidamente, por isso estamos em busca de profissionais com um forte desejo de autodesenvolvimento. É indispensável para esta posição:

Mais do que acreditar somente no poder da diversidade, a Syngenta vem promovendo uma cultura inclusiva que abrange as diferenças em todas as formas. Hogarth is seeking a highly skilled and innovative AI Engineer to join our post-production team.   • Programming and Technical Expertise
    • Develop and optimize custom AI models and workflows tailored to specific project needs.
    • Write and maintain Python scripts to automate tasks, machine learning, and improve production pipelines.
    • Troubleshoot technical challenges and ensure seamless integration of AI tools into existing systems.
    • Partner with creative teams to brainstorm and conceptualize visually compelling advertising campaigns.
    • Use AI and 3D tools (e.g., Blender, Unreal Engine, 3D Studio) to create virtual production environments and assets.
  • Collaboration and Innovation
    • Stay updated on emerging technologies and trends in AI, VFX, and post-production.

Join to apply for the Assistant Director for Sports Medicine role at Lehigh University

Lehigh University is seeking a highly motivated and skilled professional to join our dynamic team as an Assistant Director of Sports Medicine. This full-time position within the Athletics Staff department offers an exciting opportunity to contribute to the overall well-being of our student-athletes.
As the Assistant Director of Sports Medicine, you will play a crucial role in ensuring that our student-athletes receive exceptional healthcare services. Key responsibilities include:

  • Minimize risk of injury/illness of student-athletes impacted by or involved in a specific activity through awareness, education, and intervention.
  • Interpret pre-participation and other relevant screening information in accordance with accepted and applicable guidelines to minimize the risk of injury and illness.
  • Administer baseline orthopedic, podiatric, and concussion screening for new student-athletes.
  • Contribute to annual program goals, objectives, strategic plan and metrics for the Sports Medicine program.
  • Contribute to position searches, interviews, and recommendations regarding the hiring of staff.
  • Implement prevention programs based upon injury trends associated with primary and secondary sport program assignments.
  • Attend clinical symposia, presentations, and in-services necessary to fulfill continuing education requirements for professional certification and state licensure.
  • Develop, foster, and maintain effective relationships with student-athletes, coaches, parents, administrators, team physicians, consultants, department staff, and university staff.
To be considered for this role, you must possess the following qualifications:
  • Master's Degree in Sports Medicine, a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience
  • One to three years of related work experience
  • Current certification from the National Athletic Trainers' Association preferred
  • Experience as a Certified/Licensed Athletic Director in the collegiate setting preferred
  • CPR/First Aid Certification preferred
  • Ability to interact effectively with diverse stakeholders, including students, faculty, staff, and medical professionals

Prepaga Swiss Medical, días libres adicionales, capacitación en idiomas inglés y portugués, descuentos en plataformas educativas, en gimnasios, regalo de cumpleaños, desayuno en la oficina, ayuda económica para guardería y asistencia al viajero.

title: Evento quer desmistificar mercado de capitais aos empresários rurais
description:
Evento quer desmistificar mercado de capitais aos empresários rurais

Evento “O Agro e o Mercado de Capitais” apresentará novas fontes de financiamento, além da gama de produtos e serviços financeiros existentes

Londrina (PR) recebe “O Agro e o Mercado de Capitais”, evento gratuito que irá conectar agentes das cadeias produtivas do agronegócio e investidores, apontando novas fontes de financiamento através do mercado de capitais, produtos e serviços financeiros existentes. O evento acontecerá no dia 18 de novembro, a partir das 8h30, na sede da Sociedade Rural do Paraná, com realização conjunta do IBDA (Instituto Brasileiro do Direito do Agronegócio), IPA (Instituto Pensar Agropecuária) e CVM (Comissão de Valores Mobiliários). Apoiam a iniciativa a ANBIMA (Associação Brasileira das Entidades dos Mercados Financeiro e de Capitais), B3, CNA (Confederação Nacional da Agricultura), Nova Futura, Sociedade Rural do Paraná, Agrometrika, Belagrícola, ESG Law, Kijani Investimentos, Nova Futura Investimentos e OAB Paraná.

O objetivo do evento é ampliar o acesso de empresários rurais às informações sobre o mercado de capitais e instrumentos privados de crédito usados no financiamento do setor. Em Londrina estarão presentes representantes de entidades e do mercado: Renato Buranello, presidente do IBDA, Christino Áureo, ex-deputado e relator do Fiagro, os executivos Joaquim Ferreira e Henrique Filho, da Nova Futura Investimentos, além de Ivan Wedekin, ex-secretário de Política Agrícola.

O presidente CVM, João Pedro Barroso do Nascimento, participará remotamente. Estão confirmados também Bruno de Freitas Gomes (CVM), Bruno Santana (Kijani Investimentos), Carlos Parreira (Belagrícola), Fernando Pimentel (Agrometrika), José Alves Ribeiro Júnior (VBSO Advogados) e Renato Barros (Opea Capital).

Serão dois painéis de discussão sobre a Importância do Crédito Privado e Participação do Mercado de Capitais, Securitização, CRA (Certificados de Recebíveis do Agronegócio) e Fiagro (Fundo de Investimento em Cadeias Agroindustriais).

“A agricultura tem demandado cada vez mais recursos. Precisamos renovar e ampliar as fontes de financiamento, oferecendo alternativas privadas e fora do modelo anterior já conhecido, que conta com instrumentos e recursos públicos e direcionamento através das instituições participantes do Sistema Nacional de Crédito Rural”, avalia Renato Buranello, presidente do IBDA.

Sobre o IBDA
O Instituto Brasileiro de Direito do Agronegócio (IBDA) tem por objetivo o estudo do Direito & Economia dos Sistemas Agroindustriais (SAGs), formando um observatório para a formulação de políticas públicas e melhor interpretação do conjunto de normas que regulam o setor. O Instituto promove a difusão de conhecimento específico sobre regime jurídico do setor, bem como estudos técnicos que venham a contribuir para seu melhor desenvolvimento.

Serviço:
*Evento “O Agro e o Mercado de Capitais”
Data: 18 de novembro de 2024
Horário: 08h30 às 12h30.
Local: Sociedade Rural do Paraná | Parque Ney Braga Eventos, Av. Tiradentes, 6275 – Cilo 2, Londrina/PR.
Inscrições gratuitas:

Podcast 226 - Professora da UEL e cientista da Embrapa conquista o Nobel da Agricultura

A engenheira agrônoma, pesquisadora da Embrapa Soja e professora da Universidade Estadual de Londrina, Mariangela Hungria, é a primeira mulher brasileira a vencer o World Food Prize, principal prêmio mundial da agricultura. Veja também no podcast Conexão Agro que o Paraná subiu para o segundo lugar no ranking nacional de exportações de milho.

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. We are hiring a System Software Engineer for Ubuntu Networking
Our growing investment in Ubuntu now enables us to hire a group of outstanding systems software engineers to focus on the connectivity of Ubuntu in a wide range of circumstances, from cloud to server to desktop and IoT. We would like to strengthen the tooling, services, documentation, robustness, security and clarity of Linux network abstractions to provide fast, reliable and secure connections for Ubuntu.
The network stack is one of the most critical aspects of any operating system where stability, reliability and uptime are paramount. Its ease of use and reliability contribute to Ubuntu's success from IoT, Desktop, Server to the Cloud. We are expanding our Foundations team to focus our efforts on this essential function and are looking for people passionate about lower level technologies involved in an operating system's network stack. Applicants will be comfortable discussing bridges, bonds, routing, DNS resolution and other technologies used to interconnect modern operating systems. We'll work with a very wide range of upstream components and communities covering a wide range of connectivity tech. We might touch the kernel, iwd, networkmanager, wpa_supplicant, bluetooth stacks, conman, mobile data stacks, ethernet, infiniband, network virtualisation capabilities, VPNs and offload to smartnics. We model Ubuntu connectivity with Netplan and will continue to drive this forward as the easiest and most effective central tool to enable connectivity everywhere.
The Ubuntu Foundations Team delivers and maintains the core of the Ubuntu system, the base for the entire Ubuntu family of products and services. Ubuntu strives to deliver the latest and best free software components, in an easy to use and highly reliable form. We build on the technical excellence of Debian and bring additional focus and shape to the solutions we offer industry.
As a Linux System Engineer, you will maintain and integrate core components involved in the network stack of the Ubuntu Distribution. You will be discussing design with other team members, upstream projects, mentor less senior engineers and participate in code reviews and design reviews. You will also be working with other teams to ensure architecture decisions improve the overall performance and experience of Ubuntu.

title: Coordenador de Controladoria
description:
Descrição:

O Coordenador de Controladoria será o profissional responsável por liderar o processo de estruturação da área de Controladoria da empresa, desde o diagnóstico até a implementação de processos, políticas e ferramentas que garantam previsibilidade, controle e suporte estratégico ao negócio.

Essa posição exige um perfil analítico, com sólida bagagem técnica, mas também com postura hands-on, alguém que coloque a mão na massa, atue próximo da operação e saiba construir, junto com as demais áreas, uma controladoria robusta, eficiente e escalável.

Mais do que gerir números, essa pessoa será protagonista na construção de uma cultura de controle e responsabilidade financeira, atuando como parceira estratégica da alta liderança em um ambiente extremamente dinâmico, desafiador e cheio de oportunidades.

Responsabilidades:

  1. Liderar a estruturação da área de Controladoria, definindo escopo, processos, políticas e indicadores;
  2. Diagnosticar a situação atual e implementar boas práticas de governança financeira e controle gerencial;
  3. Gerenciar o ciclo de orçamento (budget), forecast e real x orçado, com entregas claras e prazos definidos;
  4. Realizar análises financeiras, econômicas e de viabilidade que embasem decisões estratégicas;
  5. Estabelecer e acompanhar indicadores de performance (KPIs) financeiros e operacionais;
  6. Desenvolver e implementar processos e rotinas de controle de custos, receitas e margem;
  7. Apoiar na gestão do fluxo de caixa, garantindo visibilidade e previsibilidade financeira;
  8. Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com as áreas operacionais, comerciais e executivas, promovendo uma visão integrada e estratégica do negócio;
  9. Apoiar auditorias e garantir conformidade com normas fiscais, contábeis e regulatórias;
  10. Avaliar, propor e implementar ferramentas e sistemas de apoio à controladoria (ERP, BI, dashboards);
  11. Liderar, desenvolver e engajar a equipe de controladoria (quando estruturada), com foco em crescimento técnico e entrega de valor.

Requisitos Técnicos (Hard Skills):

  1. Formação superior em Ciências Contábeis, Economia, Administração ou áreas correlatas;
  2. Pós-graduação ou MBA nas áreas de Finanças, Controladoria ou Gestão será considerado um diferencial;
  3. Sólida experiência prévia em controladoria, com vivência comprovada em implantação ou reestruturação da área;
  4. Forte conhecimento em contabilidade gerencial, análise financeira, orçamento, DRE gerencial, fluxo de caixa e KPIs;
  5. Domínio de Excel avançado;
  6. Capacidade de transformar dados em informações estratégicas para o negócio.

Competências Comportamentais (Soft Skills):

  1. Perfil hands-on, com alto senso de urgência, foco em solução e atitude proativa;
  2. Habilidade para trabalhar em ambientes dinâmicos, com múltiplas demandas e prazos curtos;
  3. Visão estratégica aliada à capacidade de execução detalhada;
  4. Excelente comunicação interpessoal e capacidade de influenciar diferentes áreas e níveis hierárquicos;
  5. Organização, disciplina e atenção aos detalhes;
  6. Capacidade de lidar com ambiguidades e ambientes em construção.

O que buscamos em você:

  1. Você tem perfil construtor e não se intimida com o novo – pelo contrário, enxerga oportunidade onde outros veem caos;
  2. Sabe equilibrar estratégia com operação: tanto desenvolve uma política orçamentária quanto abre uma planilha e resolve um problema técnico;
  3. Tem mentalidade de crescimento contínuo e não se acomoda. Quer crescer junto com a empresa e fazer história;
  4. Gosta de ambientes rápidos, desafiadores e acredita que a meritocracia real recompensa quem entrega com consistência;
  5. Quer liderar uma área que será referência de controle, inteligência e suporte estratégico ao negócio.

MISSÃO DO CARGO

Como parte do nosso compromisso com um modelo inovador de assistência, buscamos Médicos Geriatras apaixonados pela transformação do cuidado à saúde no ambiente domiciliar, seguindo os princípios do modelo Buurtzorg, que prioriza o autocuidado e a manutenção das funcionalidades das pessoas em suas próprias comunidades.

  • Capacidade de trabalhar de forma colaborativa e multidisciplinar, integrando ações que promovam a saúde do paciente no seu ambiente familiar.
  • Proatividade na busca de soluções que promovam a qualidade de vida e a funcionalidade dos pacientes.

Sobre Nós:

Na Laços Saúde, a diversidade é o coração do nosso trabalho. Acreditamos que cuidar é um ato de amor e acolhimento, e isso se reflete em nossa equipe, que é composta por profissionais de diversas origens e experiências. O modelo Buurtzorg que adotamos é mais do que um método: é uma filosofia que prioriza o cuidado comunitário, respeitando a individualidade e as necessidades de cada pessoa. Se você é um fisioterapeuta que acredita na transformação do cuidado à saúde, venha fazer parte da nossa equipe e ajude a moldar o futuro da saúde no Brasil. Aqui, cada dia é uma nova oportunidade de fazer a diferença na vida das pessoas.

Tem Paixão pelo Cuidado? Então junte-se a nós!

A Laços Saúde está pronta para receber você!

Vamos juntos cuidar da saúde da comunidade!

Proporcionar atendimento psiquiátrico de qualidade, acessível e humanizado através da telemedicina, promovendo o bem-estar mental e emocional dos pacientes. O médico geriatra deve atuar com empatia, responsabilidade e ética, garantindo diagnósticos e tratamentos assertivos, respeitando a individualidade de cada paciente e contribuindo para a melhoria de sua qualidade de vida. Fortalecer a confiança no atendimento remoto, assegurando que cada consulta seja conduzida com o mesmo rigor e acolhimento de um atendimento presencial.

RESPONSABILIDADES:

description:
São Paulo, SP

Nossa história começou em 2001, com um pequeno escritório de agentes autônomos de investimentos em Porto Alegre e hoje somos um grande ecossistema de serviços financeiros, mídia e educação.

Chegamos até aqui com a dedicação de equipes talentosas que tiveram garra, determinação, resiliência e, acima de tudo, ambição de fazer o impossível.

  • Foco no cliente: Somos obstinados em superar as expectativas dos nossos clientes.
  • Sonho grande: Miramos no impossível, acreditamos que ele pode se tornar realidade, e chegamos lá juntos.
  • Mente aberta: Nossa abertura para o novo e nossa capacidade de adaptação são o que nos fazem evoluir e melhorar sempre.
  • Espírito empreendedor: Construímos o futuro com nossas próprias mãos com o mais alto nível de comprometimento e sentimento de dono.

Sobre a Oportunidade

Essa oportunidade é para a Mesa de Operações Institucional Offshore, que tem a missão de garantir eficiência e segurança na execução das operações internacionais, aliando excelência operacional com inovação e melhoria contínua dos processos da mesa.
A área em questão é responsável pela negociação de swaps de juros e derivativos de moedas OTC offshore para clientes Institucionais, atuando em um ambiente de alta velocidade e precisão.
Esse é um time apaixonado por resolver desafios diários com inteligência e agilidade, suportando diretamente as demandas da mesa e garantindo que as operações sejam fluídas do pré ao pós-trade.
Você pode se dar muito bem se gostar de atuar em um ambiente dinâmico, propor soluções criativas e desenvolver ferramentas que facilitem o dia a dia da equipe.

Requisitos

  • Perfil analítico, organizado e com boa comunicação interpessoal.
  • Interesse genuíno pelo mercado financeiro e pelo funcionamento do mercado offshore.
  • Proatividade para buscar melhorias e colaborar com diferentes áreas da empresa.

Diferenciais:

  • Experiência prévia em ambientes de mesa de operação ou suporte ao negócio no mercado financeiro.
  • Desenvolver scripts ou automações para facilitar rotinas de trabalho.
  • Inglês avançado para comunicação com público internacional.
  • Curiosidade constante por novas tecnologias e soluções para otimização de processos.

Desafios e Impacto

  • Desenvolver soluções escaláveis para automação de rotinas operacionais e controle de operações internacionais OTC (swaps de juros e derivativos de moedas).
  • Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinares em projetos de inovação e melhoria contínua nos fluxos pré e pós trade da mesa institucional offshore.
  • Otimizar a eficiência e a segurança na execução de operações em ambientes de alta velocidade e precisão.
  • Implementar ferramentas e scripts que reduzam riscos operacionais e aumentem a fluidez das operações para clientes institucionais.

Processo Seletivo

  • Triagem inicial: Análise do currículo para verificar a adequação às qualificações e requisitos da vaga.
  • Testes gerais: Avaliação do alinhamento cultural com o teste da Mindsight e teste de raciocínio lógico da Predictive Index.
  • Vídeo entrevista: Uma oportunidade para nos conhecermos melhor e entender suas motivações e experiências.
  • Entrevista com a equipe de Recrutamento: Discussão sobre as expectativas em relação à vaga e aos objetivos profissionais.
  • Avaliação técnica: Entrevista/dinâmica/teste focado nas habilidades específicas necessárias para a função.
  • Entrevista com a liderança: Uma conversa para discutir sua visão e como você pode contribuir para a equipe e a empresa.
  • Entrevista com colegas de trabalho: Interação com futuros pares para avaliar a sinergia e o trabalho em equipe.
  • Entrevista focada em cultura: Exploração dos valores e princípios da empresa para garantir um bom encaixe cultural.
  • Oferta: Apresentação da proposta de trabalho, incluindo detalhes sobre remuneração e benefícios.

Benefícios

  • Saúde e bem-estar: plano de saúde, plano odontológico, Gympass, Zenklub, VA, VR, New Value, seguro de vida.
  • Maternidade e Paternidade: auxílio creche para pais e mães, licença maternidade de 6 meses, licença paternidade de 20 dias.
  • Só na XP Inc.: assessoria de investimento e acesso a fundos de investimentos exclusivos.

Jornada de trabalho com flexibilidade

O nosso modelo de trabalho varia de acordo com a função: presencial para frentes de negócio e híbrido para as demais equipes. É importante ressaltar que todos os colaboradores precisam morar na localidade da vaga (nossa sede está localizada na cidade de São Paulo e é onde temos o maior número de posições), já que temos atividades que exigem a presença física para promover a colaboração e os rituais da nossa cultura. Esses encontros são organizados de acordo com as orientações dos líderes e as particularidades de cada rotina, para que nossos colaboradores possam exercer suas jornadas de trabalho com liberdade e autonomia.

title: Stage Jeugdzorgwerker Justitiële Jongeren
description:
Ben jij een MBO of HBO Social Work student? Misschien hebben wij dan een fijne stageplek als groepsbegeleider of mentor voor jou bij de kleinschalige voorziening justitiële jongeren (KVJJ) in Krimpen aan de IJssel.

Wij hebben ruimte voor iemand die minimaal 16 uur per week stage loopt.

Daadkrachtig, empathisch en hoopvol

Als stagiair(e) in de jeugdhulp verbind je je met jongeren in kwetsbare omstandigheden. Je werkt aan hoop, herstel en perspectief. Dat is waar je het voor doet.

Je laat dat zien door:

  1. In de beginperiode mee te lopen en te observeren.
  2. Je eigen maken van de dagelijkse routine.
  3. Steeds meer te functioneren als een beginnend groepswerker/mentor.
  4. Het uitvoeren van overstijgende taken zoals samenwerken met ketenpartners en overleggen met meerdere disciplines.

Over het KVJJ

In samenwerking met DJI heeft Timon in Krimpen a/d IJssel een ‘kleinschalige voorziening justitiële jeugd’ (KVJJ). Dit is een beveiligde voorziening voor max. 8 justitiële jongeren die tijdens de periode van voorlopige hechtenis of het laatste gedeelte van hun straf of PIJ-maatregel dichtbij hun ouders, school en netwerk geplaatst worden. In de KVJJ werken jeugdzorgprofessionals, de jongere en zijn familie/netwerk samen om crimineel gedrag te voorkomen en te verminderen. De focus ligt op continuering van zorg en school, en het betrekken van het eigen netwerk: de gezonde elementen uit het leefsysteem van de jongere kunnen worden voortgezet. Overdag gaan de jongeren gewoon naar school of naar hun werk, en wij begeleiden en stimuleren hen daarbij.

Wij zijn Timon

Bij Timon verbind je je christelijk geloof met je professionele inzet. Jij bent er voor kinderen en jongeren, en jouw team staat voor jou klaar. Iedereen kan een beroep op ons doen, ongeacht achtergrond en levensovertuiging. Met bijna 800 bevlogen medewerkers werken we in een groot deel van Nederland. Timon innoveert en groeit. We denken in kansen en zetten graag een stapje extra. Dat is voor ons vanzelfsprekend en wordt erkend.

Vanuit je kracht

Bij Timon geef je je geloof handen en voeten. Je maakt het verschil dankzij jouw sterke persoonlijkheid en sociale vaardigheden. Met jouw talent voeg jij als stagiair(e) HBO of MBO waarde toe aan het leven van een ander. Dat is onze basis. Wat jij meebrengt:

  • Motivatie om te leren
  • Je kunt een veilige sfeer scheppen en handhaven in de groep
  • Samenwerken is voor jou geen probleem, maar je gaat ook zelfstandig te werk
  • Een stevige persoonlijkheid die stevig in zijn/haar schoenen staat
  • Daadkracht en proactief zijn jou niet vreemd
  • Je kunt in actie komen op moeilijke momenten

Daarom Timon

Bij Timon krijg je de kans om te groeien. Je ontvangt volop ondersteuning door persoonlijke begeleiding van een vaste collega. Dát is werken als stagiair(e) bij Timon. Dat belonen we met:

  • Een uitdagende en leerzame stageplek in een leuk en gemotiveerd team voor de duur van 10 maanden
  • Reiskostenvergoeding op dagen dat je ov-jaarkaart niet geldig is
  • Een stagevergoeding conform cao jeugdzorg

Jij @ Timon?

Denk jij dat Timon de organisatie is die bij je past? Solliciteer dan op de vacature voor een stageplek bij de KVJJ. Heb je vragen over de stage of de sollicitatieprocedure? Neem contact op met onze recruiter.

title: Graduate Legal Counsel - Tech Sector
description:
Join to apply for the Graduate Legal Counsel - Tech Sector role at Canonical

Join to apply for the Graduate Legal Counsel - Tech Sector role at Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.
We are expanding our in-house legal team, creating an opportunity for an exceptional recent graduate as junior Legal Advisor or junior Legal Counsel. The successful candidate will be a rigorous and effective practitioner with a track record of academic achievement and social engagement. At Canonical they will have the opportunity to work on a variety of transactional matters in the technology and enterprise software realm, as well as the contracts that underpin global employment, contracting and partnerships. In this appointment we are more focused on ability than experience; the position is open to applicants with a relevant degree, but does not have a requirement for extensive work experience. The successful candidate will work closely with our in-house legal team and colleagues worldwide.
Candidates must be able to demonstrate good commercial judgment as well as being organized, efficient, and capable to provide high quality legal and commercial advice. We are looking for a rigorous work ethic, detailed analysis, conscientiousness, and the ambition to identify opportunities for improvement.
Location : This role is home based in Europe, the Middle East, Africa or the Americas, with the option of our London office.
The role entails

  • Report to our global general counsel
  • Draft, review, and negotiate commercial contracts with customers and vendors in many countries across the globe
  • Provide legal support to various internal clients across the company, including Canonical's sales organization
  • Interface with cross-functional teams to support company initiatives
  • Utilize Canonical's contract management system to ensure accurate data is maintained for signed contracts
  • Work with local counsel in many countries to seek and implement advice
What we are looking for in you
  • An exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • A degree in law, JD or equivalent, and active license to practice law or current progress towards that
  • Drive and a track record of going above-and-beyond expectations
  • Strong organizational and prioritization skills with the ability to work in a fast-paced, multi-cultural environment
  • Effective both independently and as part of a team
  • A passion for technology evidenced by personal initiatives and projects
  • Professional written and spoken English with excellent drafting and presentation skills
  • Confidence to respectfully speak up, exchange feedback, and share ideas without hesitation
  • Appreciative of diversity; polite and effective in a multicultural multinational organization
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability
  • Thoughtfulness and self-motivation
  • Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments
  • Ability to travel twice a year, for company events up to two weeks long
Nice-to-have skills
  • Experience in commercial transactions, intellectual property, or corporate law
  • Leadership and the ability to influence others to embrace new ideas or practices
  • Understanding of the open source software community and values
  • Understanding of the technology industry - silicon, data centers, PCs, connected devices, and software
  • Experience working on in-house legal team and/or law firm
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.
