A mineradora é a indústria mais longeva do país, com 190 anos de atuação, e uma das maiores produtoras de ouro do Brasil. Com cerca de 3 mil empregados diretos, as operações brasileiras estão entre as mais avançadas do mundo no campo da tecnologia de mineração, pela excelência dos equipamentos e processos utilizados e pelo desenvolvimento de soluções de engenharia foco em segurança e na prática de uma mineração responsável no subsolo.

Na AngloGold Ashanti, acreditamos que a diversidade é uma força transformadora. Estamos comprometidos em revolucionar o setor da mineração, promovendo um ambiente onde cada pessoa seja valorizada por sua singularidade, com a equidade e a inclusão como pilares fundamentais de nossa cultura.

Como parte desse compromisso, atuamos ativamente para ampliar a representatividade de gênero no setor e avançar na construção de um futuro mais justo e sustentável.

REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES

  • Graduação concluída em Administração, Engenharia de Produção ou correlatas, Economia, Contabilidade e afins.
  • Pós-graduação concluída em Logística, Gestão de Projetos ou afins.
  • Vasta atuação em cargos de Gerência direcionada para gestão de almoxarifado.
  • Expertise em gerenciamento operacional e estratégico de almoxarifados industriais de grande porte.
  • Forte experiência em controle e gestão de estoques de materiais, peças, equipamentos.
  • Consolidada experiência na gestão de almoxarifados e logística.
  • Alto conhecimento e experiência nas melhores práticas de gerenciamento de estoque.
  • Compreensão dos Incoterms e do processo de importação.
  • Capacidade de análise financeira e gestão de custos/despesas.
  • Alta compreensão das atividades da indústria de mineração.
  • Experiência e conhecimento de SAP módulos WM e MRP.
  • Habilidades de gerenciamento de projetos.
  • Proficiente no uso de pacote Microsoft, incluindo Excel, Word e PowerPoint.
  • Proficiência em nível avançado no idioma Inglês - escrito e oral.

CONHECIMENTOS DESEJÁVEIS

  • Desejável conhecimento e experiência em práticas de sourcing e aquisição de material e serviços.
  • Diferencial experiência com MS Project.
  • Desejável conhecimento no módulo SAP Ariba.

RESPONSABILIDADES E ATRIBUIÇÕES

  • Representar a área de Suprimentos nas operações, sendo ponto de conexão e interação entre Operações e de Suprimentos.
  • Liderar as operações de almoxarifado, incluindo gestão das operações de posto de combustível e paiol de explosivos, dos sites Cuiabá/Lamego e Queiroz.
  • Controle de estoque, armazenamento, logística e atividades de remessa com foco no controle de custos, além de melhorar a eficiência e a precisão no gerenciamento de estoque e da cadeia de suprimentos.
  • Responsável por comportamentos consistentes com a Missão, Visão e Valores da AngloGold Ashanti.
  • Promover uma cultura de Saúde e Segurança entre os colaboradores.
  • Contribuir para a Excelência Operacional, proporcionando melhorias de desempenho sustentáveis por meio de liderança, disciplina e processo.
  • Garantir a conformidade com as práticas legais e de compliance em sua área de responsabilidade.
  • Desenvolver e manter relações de trabalho eficazes com todos os stakeholders locais e regionais.
  • Monitorar se todas as políticas, procedimentos e orientações emitidas pela administração do site relevante são cumpridas.
  • Gerenciar as operações de almoxarifado e a cadeia envolvida.
  • Definir responsabilidades e tarefas críticas para todos os subordinados diretos.
  • Definir e implementar a estrutura organizacional aprovada necessária para entregar o orçamento e o plano de negócios do almoxarifado.
  • Envolver e desenvolver as pessoas adequadamente qualificadas, capazes e experientes.
  • Identificar as necessidades específicas de desenvolvimento de cada funcionário do departamento, oferecendo oportunidades de treinamento, coaching, projetos e atribuição de funções para que o indivíduo se desenvolva em todo o seu potencial.
  • Gerenciar os supervisores de almoxarifado no desempenho de suas funções, incluindo recebimento e saídas, reconciliação de estoque, carga e descarga, armazenamento e manuseio, estoques e MRP.
  • Auditar o inventário de estoque do almoxarifado para garantir que o processo de retirada de estoque seja concluído até o final do ano civil, de acordo com os requisitos financeiros e da SOX.
  • Gerenciar as atividades do almoxarifado para fornecer o nível de serviço otimizado para fornecer os recursos de que a empresa precisa para atingir suas metas.
  • Estabelecer e monitorar procedimentos de armazenamento e manuseio.
  • Responsável por identificar e recomendar oportunidades para otimizar a utilização de frete e logística para cada site.
  • Gerenciar e coordenar provedores logísticos terceirizados, incluindo agentes de agenciamento de cargas internacionais.
  • Responsável por desenvolver e gerenciar os orçamentos (Budget) de Capex, operação e pessoal relativos aos almoxarifados dos sites.
  • Identificar e desenvolver melhorias de processo para processos e sistemas de logística, estoque e armazém a partir de uma visão regional.
  • Implementar processos e sistemas globais de estoque e almoxarifado da AGA.
  • Suportar no gerenciamento e coordenação do processo de planejamento da produção, incluindo previsão de oferta/demanda, gerenciamento de estoque e entrega no prazo.
  • Implementar e executar as melhores práticas na gestão da área.
  • Garantir que os padrões de gestão e organização dos almoxarifados estejam alinhados aos padrões globais da cadeia de suprimentos.
  • Responsável por garantir um relacionamento eficaz com todas as demais funções de Suprimentos dentro da região, ou seja, cadastro de materiais e fornecedores, gestão de inventário e materiais, melhoria da cadeia de suprimentos e governança.
  • Responsável por auxiliar e suportar os aspectos de gestão de contratos e contratadas, sendo a interface de Suprimentos entre todos os contratos gerenciados globais e regionais e a entrega ao negócio.

A AGA estimula a candidatura de profissionais com perfis diversos em todas as nossas vagas. Promovemos a inclusão de mulheres, pessoas com deficiência, reabilitados do INSS, pessoas negras, membros da comunidade LGBTQIA+ e profissionais de todas as idades em nossos processos seletivos. Esperamos sua inscrição!

O grupo AngloGold Ashanti tem sede em Londres (Reino Unido), e atuação em nove países, com 10 operações. Empresa de capital aberto, suas ações são negociadas nas bolsas de Johannesburgo, Nova York, Austrália e Gana. No Brasil, a empresa possui minas e plantas metalúrgicas e de beneficiamento nos estados de Minas Gerais e Goiás.

Somos exemplo de cuidado ativo e de segurança, nosso primeiro valor. Trabalhamos com disciplina e excelência operacional, buscando a inovação e a melhoria contínua para manter nossas operações entre as mais avançadas no setor da mineração. O nosso trabalho é pautado na mineração responsável e no compromisso com as pessoas, com o meio ambiente e com o desenvolvimento sustentável.

Temos responsabilidade e orgulho de valorizar a multiplicidade de perspectivas e experiências que a diversidade proporciona, seja ela baseada em gênero, etnia, orientação sexual, deficiência, formação cultural, religião ou idade.

Acreditamos que podemos desenvolver, juntos, o potencial individual e coletivo.

The ROW SHARP team is looking for a Sr. Product Manager. In this position, you will be responsible for defining the product roadmap, designing the product, and driving the rollout in collaboration with tech teams, product teams, and stakeholders from emerging countries. This is an individual contributor position that requires a strong sense of business and operations, product insights, and a willingness to dive deep. If you are excited by the challenge of designing end-to-end supply chain and fulfillment products for 10 countries, this may be the next big career move for you.
A successful candidate will demonstrate:
- Strong program and product management skills
- Ability to work with multiple stakeholders from various areas including operations and tech
- Ability to work with internal and external customers to identify opportunities and translate them into clear solutions and business requirements
- Ability to deliver on multiple deadlines and prioritize compulsively as a self-directed individual, comfortable with a fast-paced, ambiguous environment

- Work with multiple operations and internal software development teams to design, build, and maintain processes and features to help drive supply chain and fulfillment products expansion in ROW
- Define, own, and manage the supply chain feature roadmap with the software development teams using Agile Software Development to deliver customer valued features
- Clarify and drive project priorities and commitments, as well as establish and maintain clear chains of project management and accountability
- Interact with Project Sponsors, Technical Product Managers, and multiple Development Teams to define and deliver complex features
- Collaborate with Global Technology and Product teams to understand global processes and refine them to suit the ROW business context and requirements
- Anticipate bottlenecks, provide escalation management, anticipate and make tradeoffs, and balance the business needs versus technical constraints
- Drive effective teamwork, communication, collaboration and commitment across multiple disparate groups with competing priorities
A day in the life
- Define the three-year product roadmap and the OP product roadmap.
- Design the product based on the vision and stakeholder requirements.
- Track and report the product development progress.
- Roll out the product to ROW countries and drive adoption
About the team
The ROW (Rest Of World, which includes India, Japan, AMET, BR, MX, SG and AU) SHARP team is driving several innovations and optimizations in Amazon's Supply Chain and Fulfillment Centers, to bring the world’s most customer centric experience to the ROW countries.

- Bachelor's degree

Join to apply for the Software Engineering Manager - Sustaining Engineering role at Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1100+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder led, profitable and growing.
We are hiring a Engineering Manager for Sustaining Engineering passionate about open source software, Linux and cloud computing. Come build a rewarding, meaningful career working with the best and brightest people in technology at Canonical, the growing international software company behind Ubuntu.
Sustaining Engineering is a business critical team that continuously improves various open source software by resolving software defects reported by customers. Software stack includes everything from the kernel all the way up to the user space applications and IaaS platforms. This position leads one of our regional teams and is one of several managers, who report directly to the global Director of Sustaining Engineering.
Our customers build large-scale mission critical infrastructure and application solutions on Ubuntu and open source from Canonical. While not actively developing products, Sustaining Engineering, as part of Support Engineering, solves problems for the customer and for the benefit of the wider Open Source community. This team is well staffed with experts in every time zone and, while the work can be challenging sometimes, the team is resourced to ensure a good work-life balance and ongoing development of each team member.
As an engineering manager in the Sustaining Engineering team, your primary responsibility is to the people you support: ensuring that they are growing as engineers, making valuable contributions, and generally having a great experience at Canonical. Technical leadership and a solid background in software development are a must, so that you are able to help your team members grow professionally. You will have the opportunity to influence the culture, facilitate technical delivery, and work with your team on strategy and execution.
Location: This is a globally remote role, unless specified otherwise.
The role entails

  • Manage and lead a distributed team of engineers
  • Hire, coach, mentor, provide feedback and career development guidance to your team
  • Manage & measure key performance indicators (KPIs), and training
  • Support timely delivery of bug fixes, patches, and other technical solutions to address business needs in a variety of technology fields, including but not limited to Ubuntu, OpenStack, Ceph, Kubernetes, Juju & MAAS
  • Demonstrate the very best of Canonical in customer interactions
  • Set and manage expectations with other engineering teams, senior management, and external stakeholders
  • Advocate and advance modern software development practices
  • Grow a healthy, collaborative engineering culture in line with the company value
  • Collaborate with other teams in the organisation
  • Work from home with global travel up to 10% for internal and external events
What we are looking for in you
  • Professional software delivery experience using C, C++, Go, Python, or similar
  • You are knowledgeable and passionate about software development
  • Leadership experience displaying ability to organise and prioritise complex problem resolution and bug fixes
  • Experience with version control systems such as git
  • Experience with debugging tools such as gdb, crash or other
  • Demonstrated strong commitment to testing methodologies and maintainable code quality
  • Excellent communication skills in the English language, both verbal and written
  • Experience with Linux, with a preference towards Ubuntu
  • Experience with Open Source and Open Source Business Models
  • People management experience in a support organisation is a strong plus
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

title: Head of Public Policy, Latin America
description:
Discord is used by over 200 million people every month for many different reasons, but there’s one thing that nearly everyone does on our platform: play video games. Over 90% of our users play games, spending a combined 1.5 billion hours playing thousands of unique titles on Discord each month. Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming. We are focused on making it easier and more fun for people to talk and hang out before, during, and after playing games.

As Discord’s Head of Public Policy for Brazil and Latin America, you will be responsible for building trust and finding common ground with policymakers, regulators, and other stakeholders in Brasilia and national capitals across Latin America. This role can be resident in Sao Paulo or Brasilia and will report to the Head of Americas Public Policy.

What you will do

Introduce Discord to government policymakers and civil society stakeholders in key markets across the region, including educating decision-makers on our founding vision, our products, and our investments in privacy and safety;

Develop and execute a multi-year government advocacy strategy that maps the interests of Discord users and the company’s business goals to the evolving legal and regulatory landscape in those key markets;

Identify emerging trends in the regulation of online communications services and build action plans responsive to these trends in coordination with our Legal, Product, and Communications teams;

Advocate for Discord’s position on key legislative and regulatory initiatives that will impact our users and our business, balancing direct advocacy with effective leverage from coalitions and associations;

Provide context and support for the company’s responses to regulator inquiries;

Promote employee awareness and invite employee engagement on our public policy strategy and priorities;

Engage in public policy coalitions with peer companies and civil society organizations;

Coordinate and drive compelling returns from the company’s partnerships with non-profits and civil society organizations; and

Manage the company’s government affairs consultants and advisors in Latin America.

What you should have

Sustained (7+ years) professional success at the highest levels of government and/or in strategic public policy advocacy

Experience developing and executing public policy advocacy campaigns in Brazil, with experience in other key markets (Mexico, Argentina, Chile) in the region a plus

Insight on the policymaking process in key markets throughout the region

Commitment to Discord’s mission to be the place where everyone can find belonging before, during and after playing games together online

Willingness to travel as necessary within the region, with occasional travel to the U.S. as required

Bonus Points

Work experience on technology policy initiatives such as online safety, privacy, cybersecurity, or content moderation, especially in the online gaming space

Ability to translate complex technical information into clear, compelling narratives for non-technical audiences

Leadership experience with a civil society organization and/or tech company

Success building trust and consensus across stakeholders with different perspectives and priorities

Why Discord?
Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming. We're a multiplatform, multigenerational and multiplayer platform that helps people deepen their friendships around games and shared interests. We believe games give us a way to have fun with our favorite people, whether listening to music together or grinding in competitive matches for diamond rank. Join us in our mission! Your future is just a click away!

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.
We are hiring engineering managers who are passionate about operational systems, open source technologies and cutting-edge hardware to lead engineering teams to enable and optimize Ubuntu for the latest x86, ARM, RISC-V, s390x and POWER systems.
We partner with the world's leading silicon vendors to optimise Ubuntu on their latest platforms. We integrate next-generation features and performance enhancements in Ubuntu while also ensuring a common operating experience for their users.
Engineering Managers should be outstanding developers themselves. They should be completely at home reviewing a patch or a software design spec. You will be expected to drive healthy engineering practices, documentation, quality and performance optimisations as well as lead your team to deliver high-quality design and code.
An Engineering Manager is responsible for line management and career guidance. The ability to develop engineering talent, to represent your team and product from a technical perspective, and to drive collaboration with other teams and customers are all critical to success in this role.
You will have the opportunity to influence the culture, facilitate technical delivery, and work with your team on strategy and execution.
Location: This is a globally remote role. We have open positions in every time zone.
What your day will look like

  • Lead and develop a team of engineers, ranging from graduate to senior
  • Oversee commercial engagements and support timely delivery on agreed project milestones
  • Participate as technical lead on complex customer engagements involving complete system architectures
  • Implement disciplined engineering processes

  • Optimize Ubuntu for latest hardware platforms
  • Display technical leadership internally and within our external communities
  • Contribute to code reviews and technical documentation

  • Thoughtfulness, and self-motivation

  • Ability to travel internationally twice a year for company events up to two weeks long
Nice-to-have skills
  • Experience working with open source communities and licenses
  • Computer architecture knowledge of x86, ARM, RISC-V or s390x
  • Understanding of build systems and toolchains, including for cross-compilation
  • Experience working with customers
  • Experience with board bring up and validation
  • Experience with Linux virtualization, networking or graphics stacks
  • Experience with one or more of the follow
  • Experience with Docker/OCI containers/K8s
  • ing technologies: confidential computing, RDMA, Infiniband and high performance computing.
  • Performance engineering, benchmarking and profiling
What we offer you
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave

  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1100+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder led, profitable and growing.
We are hiring a Engineering Manager for Sustaining Engineering passionate about open source software, Linux and cloud computing. Come build a rewarding, meaningful career working with the best and brightest people in technology at Canonical, the growing international software company behind Ubuntu.
Sustaining Engineering is a business critical team that continuously improves various open source software by resolving software defects reported by customers. Software stack includes everything from the kernel all the way up to the user space applications and IaaS platforms. This position leads one of our regional teams and is one of several managers, who report directly to the global Director of Sustaining Engineering.
Our customers build large-scale mission critical infrastructure and application solutions on Ubuntu and open source from Canonical. While not actively developing products, Sustaining Engineering, as part of Support Engineering, solves problems for the customer and for the benefit of the wider Open Source community. This team is well staffed with experts in every time zone and, while the work can be challenging sometimes, the team is resourced to ensure a good work-life balance and ongoing development of each team member.
As an engineering manager in the Sustaining Engineering team, your primary responsibility is to the people you support: ensuring that they are growing as engineers, making valuable contributions, and generally having a great experience at Canonical. Technical leadership and a solid background in software development are a must, so that you are able to help your team members grow professionally. You will have the opportunity to influence the culture, facilitate technical delivery, and work with your team on strategy and execution.
Location: This is a globally remote role, unless specified otherwise.
The role entails

  • Manage and lead a distributed team of engineers
  • Hire, coach, mentor, provide feedback and career development guidance to your team
  • Manage & measure key performance indicators (KPIs), and training
  • Support timely delivery of bug fixes, patches, and other technical solutions to address business needs in a variety of technology fields, including but not limited to Ubuntu, OpenStack, Ceph, Kubernetes, Juju & MAAS
  • Demonstrate the very best of Canonical in customer interactions
  • Set and manage expectations with other engineering teams, senior management, and external stakeholders
  • Advocate and advance modern software development practices
  • Grow a healthy, collaborative engineering culture in line with the company value
  • Collaborate with other teams in the organisation
  • Work from home with global travel up to 10% for internal and external events
What we are looking for in you
  • Professional software delivery experience using C, C++, Go, Python, or similar
  • You are knowledgeable and passionate about software development
  • Leadership experience displaying ability to organise and prioritise complex problem resolution and bug fixes
  • Experience with version control systems such as git
  • Experience with debugging tools such as gdb, crash or other
  • Demonstrated strong commitment to testing methodologies and maintainable code quality
  • Excellent communication skills in the English language, both verbal and written
  • Experience with Linux, with a preference towards Ubuntu
  • Experience with Open Source and Open Source Business Models
  • People management experience in a support organisation is a strong plus
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

CONTEXTO E DESCRIÇÃO DO PROJETO:

A AVSI Brasil ( é uma organização brasileira, sem fins lucrativos, constituída em 2007, para contribuir na melhoria das condições de vida de pessoas que vivem em situações de vulnerabilidade. É uma organização local vinculada ao contexto internacional, por meio da parceria com a Fundação AVSI, ONG de origem italiana que atua no Brasil desde os anos 80 e que estimulou a criação da AVSI Brasil. Sua missão é tornar as pessoas, em situações de vulnerabilidade ou emergência humanitária, protagonistas do próprio desenvolvimento, da sua família e comunidade, por meio de projetos sociais em diferentes áreas.

Neste contexto a AVSI mobiliza, operacionaliza e gerencia os Programas Sociais de Sustentabilidade da ENEL São Paulo, implementando iniciativas de eficiência energética e engajamento comunitário em comunidades de baixa renda. title: Groepsbegeleider kleinschalige woonvorm jeugd Dordrecht
description:
Voor onze kleinschalige woonvoorziening voor 4 jongeren in Dordrecht (met 2 respijtzorg/logeerplekken) zijn wij op zoek naar meerdere groepsbegeleiders, jeugdzorgwerkers D. Jij bent als groepsbegeleider voor jongeren degene op wie ze kunnen bouwen. Heb jij de moed en de drijfveer om jongeren met complex gedrag binnen de jeugdzorg een plek te geven waar wordt gewerkt aan zelfvertrouwen en het toewerken naar een stabiele toekomst? Je zorgt voor een veilig leefklimaat. Daarnaast werk je mee aan een team in opbouw en krijg je alle ruimte om jezelf te ontwikkelen.

Daadkrachtig, empathisch en hoopvol

Soms kan een jongere niet meer thuis wonen. Dan biedt Timon een veilige woonplek in de 24-uurswoonvorm. Als groepsbegeleider begeleid je deze jongeren in het dagelijkse leven. Ze kunnen op jou rekenen. We gaan werken vanuit de Triple C methodiek. De drie c’s staan voor cliënt, coach en competentie. Dat vraagt om een andere manier van werken, om daadkracht, empathie en vasthoudendheid. Je kijkt namelijk niet naar het complexe gedrag van de jongeren, maar je kijkt naar wat zij van jou nodig hebben. Doel van Triple-C is het gewone leven, met alles wat daarbij hoort: een plek waar je je veilig bent, jezelf thuis voelt, mensen waarop je kunt bouwen en vertrouwen en een zinvolle invulling van de dag. Dat is waar groepsbegeleiders en de jongeren elke dag samen aan werken. Als dat lukt, krijgen jongeren steeds meer vertrouwen. In zichzelf, in de ander en in hun omgeving. Stress en complex gedrag verdwijnen naar de achtergrond. Om dit te kunnen bereiken is het belangrijk dat je sociaal vaardig bent en een sterke persoonlijkheid hebt.

Jouw werk doet ertoe!

Als groepsbegeleider ben je er voor de jongeren. Je zorgt voor huiselijkheid, en samen met de jongeren ga je op zoek naar oplossingen en mogelijkheden: van huiswerk en koken tot vriendschappen. Je stimuleert hen, met de persoonlijke behoefte voor ogen. De mentor stelt deze doelen op voor iedere jongere, in afstemming met jou. Als het moet, trap je op de rem. Als groepsbegeleider leef je het normale leven voor aan de jongeren. Houd er rekening mee dat je ook administratieve taken hebt. Het doel van jouw werk? Dat de jongeren het gewone leven ervaren in een veilige omgeving met jou in nabijheid en zich van daaruit ontwikkelt. Kortom, jouw werk doet ertoe!

Dit ga je doen

  • Je stelt samen met de jongeren concrete doelen en werkpunten op voor je dienst
  • Je monitort de ontwikkeling in de vastgestelde doelen en rapporteert daarop
  • Je voert de dagelijkse doelen uit en ziet erop toe dat die gebeuren
  • Overleggen intervisie met je teammanager, de mentoren, het team en de gedragswetenschapper

“Je hebt veel vrijheid om je diensten in te vullen. In het contact met de jongeren signaleer je wat een jongere nodig heeft en stem je af wat nodig is” -Linda van Oorschot, groepsbegeleider

Dit vragen we van je

Als groepsbegeleider sta je stevig in je schoenen, ook in zeer uitdagende situaties. Je kent jezelf goed (weet waar jouw triggers liggen), je bent reflectief op je eigen handelen. Je kunt je eigen grenzen goed aangeven. Je beschikt over:

  • Passie voor deze jongeren: de jongeren blijven zien en naast ze blijven staan
  • Rekening houden met achtergrond van de jongeren en (mogelijk) ingrijpende ervaringen die ze hebben opgedaan in hun verleden
  • Een positieve houding en frisse energie
  • Empathisch en onbevangen zijn
  • De focus leggen op wat goed gaat
  • Reflecteren op je eigen handelen: wat kan ik anders/beter/meer doen om de jongere te begeleiden?
  • Een sterke motivatie om samen met je team te werken, te leren en te groeien
  • Stressbestendig en flexibel zijn om, om te kunnen gaan met emotionele druk en verbale of fysieke agressie
  • Mbo-diploma niveau 4, bijvoorbeeld SPW. Of een startende hbo’er met een Social Work-diploma
  • Ervaring met competentiegericht werken.
  • Ervaring met werken met de Triple C methodiek is een pré
  • Kennis van en inzicht in groepsdynamische processen
  • Reflectie op eigen handelen samen met je team, met als doel af te stemmen op wat de cliënt nodig heeft.
  • Flexibele inzetbaarheid (onregelmatige diensten, ook weekend en slaapdiensten)

Dit bieden wij

Een gezellig team waarin je veel uitdaging krijgt. Op basis van een 36-urige werkweek kun je rekenen op:

  • Een bruto maandsalaris volgens de cao Jeugdzorg (schaal 7) vanaf €2.818,26 tot € 4.027,70 afhankelijk van je kennis en ervaring
  • Een jaarcontract voor minimaal 24 uur en maximaal 36 per week. Functioneer je goed? Dan zetten we dat om in een vast dienstverband
  • 25 vakantiedagen, 8% vakantiegeld, onregelmatigheidstoeslag en reiskostenvergoeding
  • Een eindejaarsuitkering van 8,3% van je bruto jaarsalaris
  • Een eigen buddy die je helpt met je persoonlijke doelstellingen en ontwikkeling. Binnen Timon krijg je een uitgebreid inwerktraject. Daarnaast volg je diverse trainingen en opleidingen gericht op jouw functie.

Deze functie noemen we in ons functiehuis Jeugdzorgwerker D. Voor indiensttreding is het screeningsbeleid van Timon van toepassing. Deze is altijd opvraagbaar en wordt toegelicht in het arbeidsvoorwaardengesprek.

Wij zijn Timon

Je christelijke geloof verbinden met je professionele inzet? Dat kan bij Timon! Bij ons ben je er voor kinderen, jongeren en ouders. En ons team is er voor jóu. Iedereen kan een beroep op ons doen, ongeacht achtergrond en levensovertuiging. Met bijna 800 bevlogen medewerkers werken we in een groot deel van Nederland. Timon innoveert en groeit. We denken in kansen en zetten graag een stapje extra.

Jij @ Timon?

Denk jij dat Timon de organisatie is die bij jou past? Solliciteer dan op de vacature voor groepsbegeleider. Heb je inhoudelijke vragen? Neem dan contact op met Heidi van Essen (recruiter) via of bel naar 06-15396231.

Your Wellbeing Matters. Join a Company That Cares.

GET TO KNOW US

THE OPPORTUNITY

We are hiring a Tax Planning Senior Manager to our Tax & Finance team in Brazil!

The Tax Planning Senior Manager is responsible for leading tax planning initiatives, managing special tax projects, and ensuring compliance with global and local tax regulations. This role requires expertise in corporate tax strategy, mergers and acquisitions (M&A), transfer pricing, and cross-border tax structuring. The Senior Manager will collaborate with internal stakeholders and external advisors to optimize the company’s tax position while mitigating risks. Additionally, this role plays a critical part in protecting the company’s business model by ensuring tax strategies align with operational and strategic goals and enhancing awareness of the business model across the organization.

  • Develop and implement tax-efficient strategies to support business growth and financial objectives.
  • Provide tax advice on corporate transactions, including M&A, restructurings, and investments.
  • Support cross-functional programs across the company to ensure tax efficiency.
  • Identify tax-saving opportunities and assess the impact of tax law changes.
  • Oversee tax-related projects, including new products and tax restructurings.
  • Ensure tax policies and strategies support integrity and sustainability of the business model.

Who You Are

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Law, Taxation, or related field (Master’s or CPA preferred).
  • 5+ years of tax experience in a corporate or consulting environment.
  • Strong knowledge of international and domestic tax laws, transfer pricing, and M&A.
  • Experience with tax technology solutions and data analytics is a plus.
  • Excellent project management, analytical, and communication skills.

What We Offer You

We're a wellness company that is committed to the health and wellbeing of our employees. Our flexible program allows you to customize your benefits, according to your needs!

Our Benefits Include

  • WELLNESS: Health, dental, and life insurance.
  • FLEXIBLE WORK: At Wellhub, flexibility fosters a happier, healthier, and more productive work environment for everyone. As a Flexible First company, we offer two work model options: flexible hybrid and full remote, and make the office a place for collaboration, community, and team building. The model for this role can be discussed with your recruiter and hiring manager. We offer all employees a home office stipend and a monthly flexible work allowance to help cover the costs of working from home.
  • FLEXIBLE SCHEDULE: Wellhubbers and their leaders can make the best decisions for their scope. This includes flexibility to adjust their working hours based on their personal schedule, time zone, and business needs.
  • WELLHUB: We believe in our mission and encourage our employees and their families to take care of their wellbeing too. Access onsite gyms and fitness studios, digital fitness programs, and online wellness resources for meditation, nutrition, mental health support, and more. You will receive the Gold plan at no cost, and other premium plans will be significantly discounted.
  • PAID TIME OFF: We know how important it is that our employees take time away from work to recharge. Vacations after 6 months and 3 days off per year + 1 day off for each year of tenure (up to 5 additional days) + extra day off for your birthday.
  • PAID PARENTAL LEAVE: Welcoming a new child is one of the most special moments in your life and we want our employees to take the time to be present and enjoy their growing family. We offer 100% paid parental leave to all new parents and extended maternity leave.
  • CAREER GROWTH: Outstanding opportunities for personal and career growth. That means we maintain a growth mindset in everything we do and invest deeply in employee development.
  • CULTURE: An exciting and supportive atmosphere with ambitious people from around the world! You’ll partner with global colleagues and share in the success of a high-growth technology company disrupting the health and wellness space. Our value-based culture of trust, flexibility, and integrity makes this possible every day. Find more info on our careers page!

And to get a glimpse of Life at Wellhub… Follow us on Instagram @lifeatwellhub and LinkedIn !

Diversity, Equity, and Belonging at Wellhub

We aim to create a collaborative, supportive, and inclusive space where everyone knows they belong.

Wellhub is committed to creating a diverse work environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. Ability to identify engineering solutions which meet the Company's need to maintain or increase competitive advantage, support long term manufacturing strategy, improve profitability, and provide opportunities for future strategic business decision making;

title: Graduate Legal Counsel - Tech Sector
description:
Join to apply for the Graduate Legal Counsel - Tech Sector role at Canonical

Join to apply for the Graduate Legal Counsel - Tech Sector role at Canonical

Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.
We are expanding our in-house legal team, creating an opportunity for an exceptional recent graduate as junior Legal Advisor or junior Legal Counsel. The successful candidate will be a rigorous and effective practitioner with a track record of academic achievement and social engagement. At Canonical they will have the opportunity to work on a variety of transactional matters in the technology and enterprise software realm, as well as the contracts that underpin global employment, contracting and partnerships. In this appointment we are more focused on ability than experience; the position is open to applicants with a relevant degree, but does not have a requirement for extensive work experience. The successful candidate will work closely with our in-house legal team and colleagues worldwide.
Candidates must be able to demonstrate good commercial judgment as well as being organized, efficient, and capable to provide high quality legal and commercial advice. We are looking for a rigorous work ethic, detailed analysis, conscientiousness, and the ambition to identify opportunities for improvement.
Location : This role is home based in Europe, the Middle East, Africa or the Americas, with the option of our London office.
The role entails

  • Report to our global general counsel
  • Draft, review, and negotiate commercial contracts with customers and vendors in many countries across the globe
  • Provide legal support to various internal clients across the company, including Canonical's sales organization
  • Interface with cross-functional teams to support company initiatives
  • Utilize Canonical's contract management system to ensure accurate data is maintained for signed contracts
  • Work with local counsel in many countries to seek and implement advice
What we are looking for in you
  • An exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • A degree in law, JD or equivalent, and active license to practice law or current progress towards that
  • Drive and a track record of going above-and-beyond expectations
  • Strong organizational and prioritization skills with the ability to work in a fast-paced, multi-cultural environment
  • Effective both independently and as part of a team
  • A passion for technology evidenced by personal initiatives and projects
  • Professional written and spoken English with excellent drafting and presentation skills
  • Confidence to respectfully speak up, exchange feedback, and share ideas without hesitation
  • Appreciative of diversity; polite and effective in a multicultural multinational organization
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability
  • Thoughtfulness and self-motivation
  • Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments
  • Ability to travel twice a year, for company events up to two weeks long
Nice-to-have skills
  • Experience in commercial transactions, intellectual property, or corporate law
  • Leadership and the ability to influence others to embrace new ideas or practices
  • Understanding of the open source software community and values
  • Understanding of the technology industry - silicon, data centers, PCs, connected devices, and software
  • Experience working on in-house legal team and/or law firm
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

title: Gezinsbegeleider complexe problematiek
description:
Hoop en herstel bieden voor jongeren en gezinnen, dat is waar jij als gezinsbegeleider aan meebouwt in gemeente Stichtse Vecht.
Omdat je het belangrijk vindt dat ieder kind thuis kan opgroeien, draag je daar graag aan bij als gezinsbegeleider. Je komt in een leuk en gedreven team. Als gezinsbegeleider houdt je van de uitdaging en de complexe situaties die op je pad kunnen komen en je vindt het mooi om weer perspectief te bieden aan gezinnen. We bieden je de mogelijkheid om jezelf te specialiseren door middel van een opleiding.

Jouw werk doet ertoe

Als gezinsbehandelaar ben je er voor ouders en het kind. Je brengt samen met hen de (vaak complexe) situatie in kaart en stelt doelen. Je stemt af met de wijkteammedewerker (die casusregie voert) begeleidings-/behandelingsgesprekken met ouders, het kind, gezin en hun netwerk. Samen werk je ernaar toe dat ze weer met elkaar verder kunnen. Dat is niet altijd een soepel traject.

Het aansluiten bij het gezin vraagt een goed ontwikkeld analytisch vermogen en sterke communicatieve vaardigheden. Je werk is veelal solistisch, maar er is ondersteuning vanuit een teamcoach, een gedragswetenschapper en collega’s van het specialistisch team. Je hebt kennis en kunde en je vindt het leuk deze te delen met je collega’s. We hebben regelmatig werkoverleg en casuïstiekbesprekingen en je draagt hier graag aan bij. Er is veel afstemming met het gezin en de betrokken medewerkers. Het specialistisch team is stabiel en ervaren.

Het vraagt dus wel iets van jou als professional. Het uiteindelijke doel? Een fijne en veilige opgroeisituatie voor het kind of de jongere. Kortom, jouw werk doet ertoe.

Dit ga je doen

  • Ondersteuning en begeleiding bieden aan ouders en kinderen in complexe thuissituaties
  • Samen met ouders en/ kind(eren) stel je doelen, legt die vast en ondersteunt het veranderingsproces
  • Zelfstandig begeleidingsgesprekken voeren, observeren en vooruitgang rapporteren
  • Handvatten bieden en een klankbord zijn voor ouders en of jongeren
  • Veiligheid en de ontwikkelingsmogelijkheden van het kind nauwgezet in de gaten houden

Dit vragen we

  • Relevante Hbo-diploma (bijvoorbeeld Social Work of Pedagogiek)
  • Een geldige SKJ-registratie of je voldoet aan de eisen om je op zeer korte termijn te kunnen registreren
  • Tenminste 1 jaar ervaring in de (ambulante) specialistische jeugdhulpverlening. Er is voor ruimte voor een junior in ons team.
  • Rijbewijs B en een auto. Ons hoofdkantoor in Maarssen is tegenover het NS-station en biedt gelegenheid tot gratis parkeren.
  • Het helpt als je al een systemische opleiding hebt gedaan zoals bijvoorbeeld een contextuele opleiding, IAG, casemanagement of MDFT maar dat is geen must. Wel ben je bereid een dergelijke opleiding te volgen en hier snel mee te starten.
  • Het is een pré als je ook trainingen/cursussen hebt gedaan met specialisaties: autisme en/of ADHD begeleiding, gehechtheidsproblematiek, cultuur sensitieve hulp voor gezinnen met migratie achtergrond, complexe puberbegeleiding.
  • Enthousiasme en reflectie- en relativeringsvermogen zijn nodig om je te verwelkomen in ons specialistisch team.

Jouw plek in de organisatie

TIM Stichtse Vecht is in de gemeente Stichtse Vecht verantwoordelijk voor de jeugdhulp, WMO-begeleiding en ondersteuning vanuit de wijkteams. TIM Stichtse Vecht staat voor een Stichtse Vecht waarin iedereen, van jong tot oud, meetelt en meedoet. Lukt dat even niet zo goed? Dan begint passende zorg met luisteren naar de inwoner, zodat je de juiste ondersteuning kunt bieden, dichtbij inwoners en met weinig regeldruk. We stellen daarbij inwoners én medewerkers centraal. Eind 2026 zal Tim Stichtse Vecht stoppen en zal de hulpverlening op een andere wijze worden ingericht. Ga jij die uitdaging aan, dan kom je werken bij TIM Stichtse Vecht in dienst van Timon. Binnen Timon zal er ook na 2026 ruimte zijn voor (gespecialiseerde) jeugdhulpverleners.

Dit bieden wij

Op basis van een 36-urige werkweek kun je rekenen op:

  • Een bruto maandsalaris volgens de cao Jeugdzorg schaal 9 vanaf € 3191,69 tot € 4766,96,- afhankelijk van je kennis en ervaring
  • Een jaarcontract tussen de 28-36 uur, afhankelijk van wat jij wilt. Functioneer je goed? Dan zetten we dit contract om in een vast dienstverband
  • 25 vakantiedagen, 8% vakantiegeld en reiskostenvergoeding
  • Een eindejaarsuitkering van 8,3% van je bruto jaarsalaris
  • Een eigen teamcoach die jou helpt met je persoonlijke doelstellingen en ontwikkeling
  • Binnen TIM Stichtse Vecht krijg je een uitgebreid inwerktraject waarin we je koppelen aan een buddy. Daarnaast volg je diverse trainingen en opleidingen gericht op jouw functie.

Wij zijn Timon

Je christelijke geloof verbinden met je professionele inzet? Dat kan bij Timon! Bij ons ben je er voor kinderen, jongeren en ouders. En ons team is er voor jóu. Iedereen kan een beroep op ons doen, ongeacht achtergrond en levensovertuiging. Met 800 bevlogen medewerkers werken we in een groot deel van Nederland. Timon innoveert en groeit. We denken in kansen en zetten graag een stapje extra. Dat is voor ons vanzelfsprekend, daar worden we om herkend. Benieuwd hoe Timon omgaat met haar christelijke identiteit? Kijk dan op .

Jij @TIM Stichtse Vecht?

Denk jij dat Tim Stichtse Vecht de organisatie is die bij je past? Solliciteer dan op de vacature. Wil je eerst nog even wat vragen of wil je meer informatie, dan kan je contact zoeken met Carla Verkroost- de Bruijn, teamcoach via 06 21 97 03 24 of met Esther Muijlwijk, teamcoach, op telefoonnummer 06-11104184. Voor vragen over de procedure kun je contact opnemen met onze recruiter.

Voor vragen over de procedure kun je contact opnemen met onze recruiter.

Wil je eerst even komen kennismaken en koffiedrinken op onze nieuwe, toegankelijke locatie? Welkom! We gaan graag met je in gesprek op onze hoofdkantoor in Maarssen. Bel de recruiter voor een afspraak met een van de teamcoaches van het specialistisch team.

Met jouw skills help je collega’s hun cliënten goed te begeleiden en samen de kwaliteit van maatschappelijke zorg aan jonge moeders en kind te waarborgen. Voor het team Danita in Amsterdam zijn we op zoek naar een gedragswetenschapper voor 16 uur per week. In combinatie met de Gedragswetenschapper Alleenstaande moeders en kind kan je 32 uur per week werken.

Danita betreft twee locaties voor kleinschalig wonen voor (jonge) vrouwen, waarvan sommigen moeders en hun kind(eren). We bieden een veilige plek om tijdelijk te wonen en ondersteuning te krijgen om gefaseerd weer op eigen benen te gaan staan. Binnen Danita staat het gewone leven centraal. Op de locaties wonen tevens omwoners die als goede buur voor de jonge dames aanwezig zijn. Samen met je collega’s ben je verantwoordelijk voor het draaiend houden van de locaties.

Analytisch, inspirerend, daadkrachtig

Als gedragswetenschapper geef jij, samen met de teammanager, duaal sturing aan je team. Hulpverleners hebben de juiste vaardigheden en tools nodig om hun cliënten goed te begeleiden. Jij coacht hen daarbij en bespreekt de kwaliteit van zorg in de werkbegeleidingsgesprekken. Je sluit aan bij de vragen van hulpverleners en denkt mee over casuïstiek. Je traint hen met jouw kennis en ervaring. Je volgt de ontwikkelingen in de wetenschap en in de samenleving. Samen met de afdeling Strategie & Beleid werk je aan doorontwikkeling van zorgconcepten. En in samenwerking met de regiomanager bewaak je de kwaliteit van zorg én de zichtbaarheid van het zorgaanbod bij gemeenten en collega-organisaties. Dat vraagt wat van je. Je bent analytisch, inspirerend en onderzoekend. In acute situaties treed je daadkrachtig op.

Jouw werk doet ertoe!

Als gedragswetenschapper ben je er vooral voor de zorgprofessionals. Samen met de hulpverleners zet je begeleidings- en behandeltrajecten op en houd je deze op de rit. Je werkt veelal alleen in deze functie, mét de mogelijkheid om te sparren met andere gedragswetenschappers in Amsterdam of het land. Bijvoorbeeld als je ergens tegenaan loopt in jouw zorgconcept. De protocollen en richtlijnen maken we op maat voor de specifieke situatie van cliënten. Het mooie is dat je ook invloed hebt op de kwaliteit van zorg in het algemeen. Jouw werk doet ertoe! Susanne, gedragswetenschapper

title: Head of Public Policy, Latin America
description:
Discord is used by over 200 million people every month for many different reasons, but there’s one thing that nearly everyone does on our platform: play video games. Over 90% of our users play games, spending a combined 1.5 billion hours playing thousands of unique titles on Discord each month. Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming. We are focused on making it easier and more fun for people to talk and hang out before, during, and after playing games.

As Discord’s Head of Public Policy for Brazil and Latin America, you will be responsible for building trust and finding common ground with policymakers, regulators, and other stakeholders in Brasilia and national capitals across Latin America. This role can be resident in Sao Paulo or Brasilia and will report to the Head of Americas Public Policy.

What you will do

  • Introduce Discord to government policymakers and civil society stakeholders in key markets across the region, including educating decision-makers on our founding vision, our products, and our investments in privacy and safety;
  • Develop and execute a multi-year government advocacy strategy that maps the interests of Discord users and the company’s business goals to the evolving legal and regulatory landscape in those key markets;
  • Identify emerging trends in the regulation of online communications services and build action plans responsive to these trends in coordination with our Legal, Product, and Communications teams;
  • Advocate for Discord’s position on key legislative and regulatory initiatives that will impact our users and our business, balancing direct advocacy with effective leverage from coalitions and associations;
  • Provide context and support for the company’s responses to regulator inquiries;
  • Promote employee awareness and invite employee engagement on our public policy strategy and priorities;
  • Engage in public policy coalitions with peer companies and civil society organizations;
  • Coordinate and drive compelling returns from the company’s partnerships with non-profits and civil society organizations; and
  • Manage the company’s government affairs consultants and advisors in Latin America.

What you should have

  • Sustained (7+ years) professional success at the highest levels of government and/or in strategic public policy advocacy
  • Experience developing and executing public policy advocacy campaigns in Brazil, with experience in other key markets (Mexico, Argentina, Chile) in the region a plus
  • Insight on the policymaking process in key markets throughout the region
  • Commitment to Discord’s mission to be the place where everyone can find belonging before, during and after playing games together online
  • Willingness to travel as necessary within the region, with occasional travel to the U.S. as required

Bonus Points

  • Work experience on technology policy initiatives such as online safety, privacy, cybersecurity, or content moderation, especially in the online gaming space
  • Ability to translate complex technical information into clear, compelling narratives for non-technical audiences
  • Leadership experience with a civil society organization and/or tech company
  • Success building trust and consensus across stakeholders with different perspectives and priorities

Why Discord?

Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming. We're a multiplatform, multigenerational and multiplayer platform that helps people deepen their friendships around games and shared interests. We believe games give us a way to have fun with our favorite people, whether listening to music together or grinding in competitive matches for diamond rank. Join us in our mission! Your future is just a click away!

description:

Role Overview

The Senior Risk Manager plays a pivotal role in developing and executing risk-based monitoring strategies, ensuring data quality and integrity in clinical research projects. This position involves cross-functional collaboration to identify, assess, and mitigate risks throughout the clinical trial lifecycle, supporting the seamless implementation of Risk-Based Study Management (RBSM) principles.

Responsibilities

  1. Provide subject matter expertise for developing and updating the risk-based monitoring strategy tailored to project needs.
  2. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify and mitigate risks associated with complex indications.
  3. Draft initial risk assessments and support the finalization of Risk Assessment and Categorization Tools (RACT).
  4. Guide Project Managers (PMs) in transferring identified risks to the appropriate tracking systems and ensure ongoing reviews.
  5. Advise on developing functional plans to mitigate risks effectively.
  6. Utilize available tools to conduct remote data reviews and centralized statistical monitoring, identifying risks to data quality and integrity.
  7. Facilitate internal and sponsor reviews of findings, seeking cross-functional support for complex risks and mitigations.
  8. Deliver initial and ongoing training for study teams on risk assessment, centralized monitoring, and risk-based monitoring strategies.
  9. Mentor peers and train new team members on functional delivery, risk evaluation, and action implementation.
  10. Escalate risks or deliverables at risk to the PM, including scope changes.
  11. Provide strategic input on risk characterization and reporting to leadership.
  12. Take on additional responsibilities as required, ensuring qualifications and training align with assigned tasks.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in a field relevant to clinical research; Master’s degree or health data sciences degree preferred.
  • Expertise in Good Clinical Practice/ICH E6 (R3) Guidelines and other regulatory requirements.
  • Proficiency in Risk-Based Monitoring strategies, processes, and tools.

Technical Skills

  • Mastery of MS Excel (sorting, filtering, pivot tables).
  • Advanced skills in analytical data visualization tools.
  • Knowledge of Lean Six Sigma and web based RACT tools.

Core Competencies

  • Strong analytical and statistical understanding.
  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and leadership skills.
  • Ability to anticipate critical issues and develop proactive contingency plans.
  • Skilled in project workflows and cross-functional collaboration.
  • Training, mentoring, and organizational capabilities.

Experience

  • Minimum of 5 years in risk management within a clinical research setting.
  • Minimum 7 years of experience across clinical monitoring, data management, drug safety, medical monitoring, biometrics, or project management.

Attributes

  • Fluent in English (excellent oral and written).
  • Must be able to communicate clearly and effectively at all levels within the organization and with external customers.
  • Must be a fast learner and able to understand new concepts quickly.
  • Prioritization skills with the ability to plan, monitor, and manage workload fluidly in response to changing project demands.
  • Excellent understanding of project protocol, project documentation including centralized monitoring and risk-based monitoring.
  • Broad working knowledge of the roles, functions and process of conducting clinical trials.
  • Must be able to manage time effectively, working with multiple functions and requirements.
  • Must have been involved in the use of trial management or data management systems.

Good knowledge of good clinical practices, and applicable Health Canada and Food and Drug Administration (FDA) regulations/guidelines.

Additional Information

  • Seniority level: Not Applicable
  • Employment type: Full-time
  • Job function: Finance and Sales
  • Industries: Research Services

Join to apply for the Chair, Department of Psychiatry role at Lehigh Valley Health Network

Chair, LVHN Department of Psychiatry
Lehigh Valley Health Network (LVHN), proudly part of Jefferson Health, is seeking a proven and effective leader to spearhead our Department of Psychiatry as Chair. The Chair will support the Lehigh Valley Fleming Neuroscience Institute as part of the LVHN legacy services in addition to the Psychiatry & Human Behavior service line under Jefferson Health.

Position Overview
Chair, LVHN Department of Psychiatry
Lehigh Valley Health Network (LVHN), proudly part of Jefferson Health, is seeking a proven and effective leader to spearhead our Department of Psychiatry as Chair. The Chair will support the Lehigh Valley Fleming Neuroscience Institute as part of the LVHN legacy services in addition to the Psychiatry & Human Behavior service line under Jefferson Health.
The Department of Psychiatry at LVHN is one of four pillars of the Lehigh Valley Fleming Neuroscience Institute, the other pillars being the Department of Neurology, the Department of Neurosurgery, and the Fleming Memory Center. Under this Institute structure, these four key entities are devoted to the clinical, academic/research, and educational missions related to brain/nervous system and mental health in the region and beyond. The Lehigh Valley Fleming Neuroscience Institute is a system partner of the Vicky and Jack Farber Institute for Neuroscience of Thomas Jefferson University.
LVHN and our Department of Psychiatry are dedicated to providing a safe and comfortable place for our community to overcome life’s challenges. Our team of psychiatrists, psychologists, physician assistants, certified registered nurse practitioners, licensed clinical social workers, psychiatric nurses and occupational therapists work collaboratively to ensure the best outcomes for their patients.
In addition to our inpatient behavioral health services at Lehigh Valley Hospital (LVH)–Muhlenberg, LVH–Schuylkill and LVH–Pocono, we provide short-term services at LVH–Muhlenberg and LVH–Cedar Crest, which include individual, couples, family and group therapy. Our department also aids with medication management to children, adolescents and adults.

We provide a full continuum of care in behavioral health from emergency evaluation to intensive care, partial hospitalization, outpatient follow-up, homecare and skilled nursing facility consultation. We are growing the Department of Psychiatry which is comprised of more than 30 Psychiatrists and 120 mental health professionals in addition to our residency and fellowship programs.
Discover more about LVHN along with our mission and values on our about page or learn more about the LVHN Department of Psychiatry.

As Chair Of Psychiatry With LVHN, You Will
Oversee clinical operations of the Department of Psychiatry. Provide leadership and management oversight in areas of quality improvement, care management, clinical program development, business development, medical staff relationships and policies, education and research.

  • Essential functions include:
  • Appoint and supervise all Division Chiefs, the program director of the department's residency programs, and other physician leaders within the department.
  • Develop, implement and manage quality improvement and care management programs.
  • Oversee, manage and maintain the quality of all educational and research activities.
  • Appoint appropriate physician and non-physician leadership for the department's educational and research activities.
  • Work with other members of the administration on the development of clinical programs designed to meet the needs of the people served by the network.
  • Work collaboratively with the Network Office of Research and Innovation and LVHN’sInstitutional Review Board to ensure the research produced by department members meets the rigorous standards of human subject safety and academic excellence.
  • Oversee the business and financial implications of psychiatry program development.
  • Serve as a member of the Lehigh Valley Physician Group (LVPG) Board of Governors.
  • Serve as a member of the network’s Medical Executive Committee.
  • Maintain good relationships with network affiliated education organizations.
  • Collaborate with all clinical entity leaders to provide comprehensive psychiatric programs for our community.
  • Collaborate with colleagues across Jefferson Health and within the Behavioral Health service line to provide comprehensive care across our community.
Compensation and benefits for Chair, Department of Psychiatry with LVHN
We acknowledge the dedication of our colleagues and offer a benefits package that makes LVHN an even better place to work and grow your career. And now that we’re proudly part of Jefferson Health, we can offer current and future clinicians new educational and development opportunities at Thomas Jefferson University across our larger service area. We leverage its position as a world-class medical institution to recruit the best and brightest clinicians.
Our compensation/rewards package is highly competitive, and benchmark driven, including a significant opportunity for a performance-based incentive. As a large health network, we also offer a robust and comprehensive benefits package including health, vision, dental, short / long term disability, CME and retirement benefits, to name a few.
About The Lehigh Valley Area
The Lehigh Valley is one of the fastest-growing areas in the country, located in the heart of eastern Pennsylvania, 60 miles from Philadelphia and 80 miles from New York City. The area has outstanding public and private school systems, more than a half-dozen colleges and universities and an abundance of cultural and recreational year-round offerings. As a resident of the Lehigh Valley, you’ll experience the charming, close-knit community atmosphere while being just a short drive from the hustle and bustle of larger cities. Learn more about the Lehigh Valley by visiting our careers page.

  • Board-certification in Psychiatry by the American Board of Psychiatry and Neurology
  • PennsylvaniaMedical License
  • Medical Degree M.D. or D.O.
  • Five years of experience in a medical leadership role

Join Our Legal Team at Covetrus!

Are you a skilled legal professional looking to make an impact in an international environment? We’re seeking a talented individual to support Covetrus’ International Region in Brazil, working closely with the VP Legal International and Deputy General Counsel.

In this role, you’ll tackle a wide range of legal matters across all Brazilian entities within the group, crafting pragmatic solutions to complex challenges. You’ll collaborate cross-functionally with diverse teams across the globe, providing strategic legal guidance in a fast-paced and evolving industry. If you thrive in an international setting and enjoy working on diverse legal issues, we’d love to hear from you!

Fluency in English is essential for this role. To be considered, please submit your CV/Resume in English.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Provide practical legal advice and support across a range of business functions in Brazil (in charge) and internationally and on ad hoc projects (as support)
  • Draft and negotiate commercial contracts, e.g. purchase, distribution and service agreements, IT contracts, Terms and Conditions, Data Privacy
  • Assist with all company matters, including commercial, competition and employment
  • Responsible for maintaining and updating the company's legal records and licenses with the relevant authorities
  • Work towards the creation and continuous improvement of contract templates and processes
  • Promote a culture of compliance and ethics within the team
  • Assist with the implementation of policies, procedures and best practices
  • Monitor and report on the latest legislative and judicial developments/changes in the country, inter alia, advising the Board of Directors on potential impacts and risks
  • Work cross-functionally with all internal stakeholders, including finance, HR, IT, distribution, regulatory, procurement teams and marketing
  • Develop and deliver training sessions for local teams on various legal topics
  • Effectively collaborate with external counsel when appropriate
  • Represent the company in court and local authorities

QUALIFICATIONS AND EXPERIENCE:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Law from Brazil, member of the Brazilian Bar Association, with excellent academic credentials. Postgraduate degree in Corporate Law or Compliance or similar qualification is an advantage
  • At least 8 years of substantial relevant experience with a top-tier law firm or in-house legal department, preferably in the healthcare, pharmaceutical or related sectors.
  • Fluency in English and Portuguese is required. Additional language skills are an advantage.
  • In-depth knowledge of Brazilian labor, commercial, competition and compliance legislation, with specific knowledge of the LGPD. Knowledge of regulations from Animal Health and Agricultural Regulatory Agencies (ANVISA, MAPA, SIPEAGRO, ADAB, etc.) is a plus.
  • Strong grounding in ethics and corporate governance, with the ability to advise on ethical business practices and corporate governance issues.
  • Experience in dealing with complex compliance issues, including antitrust and anti-corruption laws. Ability to conduct risk assessments and provide guidance on risk management, especially in areas unique to the Brazilian market.
  • Experience with Brazilian legal proceedings, including administrative and judicial proceedings, and the ability to represent the company before local authorities.
  • Excellent time management, communication, decision-making, presentation, interpersonal and organizational skills in an international environment.
  • Team-oriented, self-directed and hands-on, with a strong sense of responsibility and ownership and the ability to network effectively within the legal and regulatory community.
  • Experience working internationally and remotely in multiple locations, ideally within a matrix organization.
  • Ability to understand business issues, identify legal issues in commercial transactions and provide practical legal recommendations and business considerations.

Covetrus is an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected Veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law.

The Risk division is responsible for credit, market and operational risk, model risk, independent liquidity risk, and insurance throughout the firm.

Credit Risk (CR) is responsible for managing the firm’s credit exposure to its trading and lending counterparties. At Goldman Sachs, we commit our people, capital and ideas to help our clients, shareholders and the communities we serve to grow. Founded in 1869, we are a leading global investment banking, securities and investment management firm. Headquartered in New York, we maintain offices around the world.
