title: Senior Product Manager – Warehouse OPS
description:
A Daki nasceu para revolucionar o delivery de mercado. O que antes alguém recebia em horas ou dias, agora recebe em minutos!
Mais que entregar rápido, buscamos entregar uma experiência incrível para os nossos clientes. Buscamos aquele "UAU" de quando o cliente recebe muito antes do que esperava.
E tudo começa muito antes da montagem do pedido, na verdade, começa bem aqui.
Estamos em busca de uma pessoa Senior Product Manager para liderar a evolução dos produtos relacionados à gestão de armazéns (Warehouse OPS) que envolve toda a nossa operação de centros de distribuição e dark stores. Essa pessoa será responsável por conectar as necessidades do negócio com soluções escaláveis e eficientes, colaborando com áreas como Engenharia, Design, Dados e Operações.
Responsabilidades
Entender profundamente as necessidades do negócio relacionadas à operação e gestão de armazéns;
Definir a estratégia de evolução dos sistemas existentes, visando maximizar o impacto nos resultados do negócio;
Especificar requisitos de produto (PRDs) claros e orientados por valor;
Planejar e gerenciar o roadmap de produtos voltados à gestão de warehouse;
Liderar o planejamento e execução de sprints em parceria com times multifuncionais;
Atuar na gestão cross-functional junto aos times de Engenharia, Design, Dados e Operações;
Acompanhar testes de aceitação e garantir a qualidade das entregas;
Coordenar o deploy e o go-live das soluções junto ao time de operações.
Requisitos
Proficiência em português e inglês (oral e escrita) para atuar com times locais e internacionais;
Experiência sólida em gerenciamento de produtos digitais;
Vivência em discovery, priorização, definição e lançamento de soluções de produto;
Capacidade analítica e de tomada de decisão baseada em dados;
Excelentes habilidades de comunicação, influência e gestão de stakeholders;
Experiência na coordenação de squads multifuncionais em ambientes ágeis e dinâmicos.
Informações adicionais:
Estamos em crescimento: Nosso modelo de trabalho é home office, permitindo que o Dakier atue de forma remota e presencial;
Somos Modernos: por meio de um cartão de crédito da bandeira Mastercard, você recebe o vale refeição, dando mais liberdade ao Dakier de como utilizar;
Transporte: realizamos o depósito direto no VT de acordo com a necessidade de passagem do Dakier até a unidade;
Saúde: Hoje disponibilizamos para o nosso Dakier a Assistência Médica e Odontológica, e também o Total Pass;
Mimo: Nossos Dakier tem desconto de 10% em todas as compras feitas em nosso do APP.

Sobre a Daki:
Poucas indústrias passaram por uma revolução tão grande na pandemia da COVID-19 como a do delivery de supermercado. Ao mesmo tempo que muitas empresas consolidadas cresceram ainda mais nesse período, elas ainda não conseguiam entregar uma boa experiência para seus clientes.
E nós sabíamos que o cliente merecia mais. Por isso, resolvemos desenvolver um modelo do zero, com foco total nas pessoas e com a ambição de uma startup que busca a liderança de mercado!
Aí criamos a Daki. :)
Somos o app de delivery mais rápido do Brasil. Entregamos mais de 1000 produtos na sua porta em minutos! Simples, intuitivo e super rápido - para você ter tempo de desfrutar o melhor da sua vida sem precisar perder tempo indo ao supermercado.
Nossos produtos foram cuidadosamente selecionados para atender aos prazeres do dia-a-dia e também às necessidades de uma vida agitada. Temos da cerveja gelada ao carregador de celular, e estamos sempre à procura de inovações que entreguem experiências ainda melhores para a nossa exigente clientela.
Estamos em busca de pessoas que compartilhem essa visão de um mundo mais simples, tecnológico e com foco no cliente, e também que transbordem energia para tirar esse sonho do papel. Se você se identificou, esse é um bom sinal!

Nossos valores:
Na Daki, acreditamos que é possível revolucionar o mercado sem abrir mão do que é mais importante: as pessoas.
Cuidar de você e do outro é essencial para manter um ambiente de trabalho leve, onde todos se sintam seguros, física e psicologicamente.
Colaborar é a chave para o sucesso. Estamos sempre atentos às necessidades e objetivos de todos, porque sabemos que o nosso propósito final é comum: encantar nossos clientes!
Entregar do Jeito Certo significa agir com integridade e ética, enfrentando desafios de frente para garantir a melhor qualidade, experiência e valor em tudo o que fazemos.
Mas não queremos apenas atender expectativas, queremos Surpreender. Ir além do esperado e fazer tudo parecer mágica faz parte do nosso DNA.
Inovar está no nosso dia a dia. Para isso, estamos sempre dispostos a Questionar. Se existe uma forma melhor e mais eficiente, nós vamos atrás dela. Sempre com base em dados e com uma abordagem estruturada para propor mudanças que façam a diferença.
E, claro, também precisamos Curtir o caminho. Celebramos cada conquista – das pequenas até as grandes – com brilho nos olhos, aprendendo com os erros e criando espaço para aquilo que mais importa na vida.
Se você se identifica com essa forma de trabalhar e viver, então você encontrou o seu lugar.
Seja bem-vinda(o) à nossa página de Carreiras!

Join to apply for the Software Engineering Manager - Sustaining Engineering role at Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1100+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder led, profitable and growing.
We are hiring a Engineering Manager for Sustaining Engineering passionate about open source software, Linux and cloud computing. Come build a rewarding, meaningful career working with the best and brightest people in technology at Canonical, the growing international software company behind Ubuntu.
Sustaining Engineering is a business critical team that continuously improves various open source software by resolving software defects reported by customers. Software stack includes everything from the kernel all the way up to the user space applications and IaaS platforms. This position leads one of our regional teams and is one of several managers, who report directly to the global Director of Sustaining Engineering.
Our customers build large-scale mission critical infrastructure and application solutions on Ubuntu and open source from Canonical. While not actively developing products, Sustaining Engineering, as part of Support Engineering, solves problems for the customer and for the benefit of the wider Open Source community. This team is well staffed with experts in every time zone and, while the work can be challenging sometimes, the team is resourced to ensure a good work-life balance and ongoing development of each team member.
As an engineering manager in the Sustaining Engineering team, your primary responsibility is to the people you support: ensuring that they are growing as engineers, making valuable contributions, and generally having a great experience at Canonical. Technical leadership and a solid background in software development are a must, so that you are able to help your team members grow professionally. You will have the opportunity to influence the culture, facilitate technical delivery, and work with your team on strategy and execution.
Location: This is a globally remote role, unless specified otherwise.
The role entails

  • Manage and lead a distributed team of engineers
  • Hire, coach, mentor, provide feedback and career development guidance to your team
  • Manage & measure key performance indicators (KPIs), and training
  • Support timely delivery of bug fixes, patches, and other technical solutions to address business needs in a variety of technology fields, including but not limited to Ubuntu, OpenStack, Ceph, Kubernetes, Juju & MAAS
  • Demonstrate the very best of Canonical in customer interactions
  • Set and manage expectations with other engineering teams, senior management, and external stakeholders
  • Advocate and advance modern software development practices
  • Grow a healthy, collaborative engineering culture in line with the company value
  • Collaborate with other teams in the organisation
  • Work from home with global travel up to 10% for internal and external events
What we are looking for in you
  • Professional software delivery experience using C, C++, Go, Python, or similar
  • You are knowledgeable and passionate about software development
  • Leadership experience displaying ability to organise and prioritise complex problem resolution and bug fixes
  • Experience with version control systems such as git
  • Experience with debugging tools such as gdb, crash or other
  • Demonstrated strong commitment to testing methodologies and maintainable code quality
  • Excellent communication skills in the English language, both verbal and written
  • Experience with Linux, with a preference towards Ubuntu
  • Experience with Open Source and Open Source Business Models
  • People management experience in a support organisation is a strong plus
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards

Sabores que inspiram histórias
Há mais de 70 anos, a Ofner transforma ingredientes em memórias e memórias em momentos únicos.
Nossa história é feita de pessoas, de cuidado artesanal e da busca constante por encantar com o que fazemos de melhor: criar sabores que acolhem, surpreendem e fazem parte da vida das pessoas.
Desde o início, acreditamos que o sabor é uma forma de expressão. É por isso que nossos produtos carregam mais do que técnica e qualidade — eles trazem alma. Da vitrine às embalagens, dos bastidores à mesa do cliente, tudo é feito com intenção, afeto e atenção aos detalhes.
Nossas criações atravessam diferentes momentos do dia e da vida. Temos orgulho de oferecer uma linha completa de produtos: salgados, panificados, chocolates, confeitaria, bebidas, gelato e presenteáveis. Cada categoria tem seu ritmo, sua beleza e sua história. E todas compartilham a mesma essência: o toque humano e o respeito pelo sabor.
Estamos presentes em lojas físicas (de rua, shoppings e quiosques) e meio digital, com e-commerce e delivery próprios. Levamos nossos produtos a empresas, grêmios e parceiros por meio do modelo store in store. Expandimos fronteiras com o B2B, atendendo projetos especiais como white label, L’Atelier e distribuidores nos Estados Unidos. E ainda colocamos a experiência na rua, com o Truck — nossa confeitaria sobre rodas
Seja no balcão de uma loja, no ambiente corporativo ou na tela do celular, nosso compromisso é o mesmo: entregar algo que vá além do esperado. Algo que inspire, que emocione e que alimente conexões.
Missão & Valores
Trabalhar com dedicação para servir produtos gostosos de alta qualidade e gerar momentos de prazer todos os dias.? Vivemos nossos valores todos os dias:
- Vontade de crescer: aprendemos, evoluímos, nos desafiamos.
- Inovação para encantar: respeitamos o passado, sem medo de inventar o novo.
- Amor pelo que faz: a paixão é o nosso ingrediente mais presente.
- Feito por pessoas, com alma e coração: o toque humano está em tudo que fazemos.
Nossas Competências
- Comunicação: transmite ideias e informações de forma clara, mantém o tom de voz adequado ao ambiente.
- Inovação: busca ampliar ou atualizar os conhecimentos, trazendo novas ideias e maneiras de realizar o trabalho.
- Inteligência Emocional: tem atitude positiva e com foco na resolução do problema.
- Liderança: lidera projetos e pessoas de forma inspiradora para atingir resultados que contribuam para o crescimento da Ofner.
- Experiência do Cliente: mostra interesse, antecipa e responde rapidamente às necessidades do cliente.
- Foco na qualidade: realiza de forma precisa e criteriosa suas atividades, atendendo os padrões de qualidade esperados.
- Foco em resultado: demonstra facilidade e domínio nas atividades do dia a dia e no uso das ferramentas necessárias da área.
- Cultura: está integrado ao time, as atribuições do cargo, as normas e políticas da empresa.
Números que contam histórias
+1.000 colaboradores entre lojas, fábrica e escritório.
+70 mil produtos produzidos por dia.
3 milhões de panetones produzidos em 2024 (entre B2C e B2B).
11 mil clientes recebidos por dia em nossas lojas.
25 toneladas de grãos de café preparados por nossos baristas ao longo do ano.

Join to apply for the Software Engineering Manager - Ubuntu Linux Kernel role at Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.
We are hiring Software Engineering Managers to lead technical teams in the various aspects of the delivery and ongoing support and maintenance of all Linux kernels provided by the Ubuntu Linux distribution. As the Linux kernel itself is now quite broad, so are the technical domains and challenges involved, ranging from integrating support for bleeding-edge hardware into the latest Ubuntu kernels, to expanding the range of execution environments available to Ubuntu, to the complexities inherent in applying the latest fixes and updates to all of the >100 Ubuntu Linux kernels under active support during our Stable Release Update cycles.
This role would suit either an experienced manager of high performing software development teams, or a very proficient technical lead who is excited to take on a management responsibility. You will need to be passionate about Linux and aspire to be an integral part in its distribution to millions of users worldwide.
As an Engineering Manager at Canonical, your primary responsibility is to your team: helping them grow as engineers, do important and satisfying work, and have a great time while doing it. Technical leadership experience and a background in software engineering are necessary prerequisites for this role. You will be expected to lead, challenge, and develop strong engineers, positively influence the culture, facilitate technical delivery, and work with your team on strategy and execution.
Location: Working from home, worldwide. We have kernel teams and openings in every time zone and with the notable exception of Taipei, Taiwan, have no offices and therefore no pressure to work from an office.
The role entails

  • Leading a distributed team of software engineers in your geographic region in distinct aspects of delivery of all Linux kernels for the Ubuntu Linux distribution
  • Taking ownership of particular aspects of Ubuntu Linux which can include but not be limited to:
    • Working with silicon or cloud partners to implement Linux kernels optimised for their execution environments
    • Ensuring Ubuntu Linux is able to run on a wide range of diverse hardware platforms
    • Definition and execution of the stringent quality control standards expected by the Ubuntu user community
    • Mitigation of the latest security threats and exploits to the Linux kernel
    • Strong process automation as it pertains to the build, test, and delivery of the Linux kernel
  • Engagement with other teams at Canonical, the open source community and commercial partners
What we are looking for in you
  • Significant programming experience in C, with Python, Golang, or other like languages is also highly regarded
  • Substantial experience with operating system kernel internals and concepts, Linux would be highly regarded but not essential
  • Demonstrated experience managing or leading a team of software engineers
  • Ability to coordinate between multiple distinct teams of differing technical focus to achieve common goals
  • Familiarity with version control practices, ideally with git
  • Prior experience developing with software packaging formats, with direct Ubuntu/Debian/Snap experience being highly regarded
  • Professional written and spoken English with excellent presentation skills
  • Ability to travel internationally twice a year for company events up to two weeks long
Nice-to-have skills
  • Demonstrated experience with kernel patching and debugging
  • Strong grasp of device drivers, BSP's, and other low level system engineering
  • Solid background in driving CI/CD and process automation initiatives
  • Prior public involvement with an open source project
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

É uma organização local vinculada ao contexto internacional, por meio da parceria com a Fundação AVSI, ONG de origem italiana que atua no Brasil desde os anos 80 e que estimulou a criação da AVSI Brasil. Sua missão é tornar as pessoas, em situações de vulnerabilidade ou emergência humanitária, protagonistas do próprio desenvolvimento, da sua família e comunidade, por meio de projetos sociais em diferentes áreas.

Interlocução com os líderes locais para a apresentação, entrada e permanência das ações nas comunidades; Acompanhar a equipe subordinada em suas atividades; Fazer palestras educativas sobre Eficiência Energética; Supervisionar e monitorar as instalações físicas e condições para execuções dos serviços; Supervisionar e monitorar os materiais e equipamentos disponibilizados para execução das ações; Supervisionar e coordenar o trabalho das equipes diretamente subordinadas; Validar a localização e solicitar a ligação provisória de energia elétrica; Interlocução com secretarias de Educação e demais órgãos competentes; Identificar e sinalizar a necessidade de treinamentos específicos para as equipes; Identificar e sinalizar problemas na execução das atividades, propondo melhorias no processo.

  • Guia e orientação da visita do público nos espaços “aulas de energia”;

  • Serviços de reparo e manutenção nas UME e nos equipamentos dos acervos;
  • Operação dos equipamentos no processo;
  • Atendimento ao público, estudantes e professores;

  • Apoio administrativo (pesquisas internet; organização e controle de material; alimentar planilhas).

title: Pleegzorgbegeleider Haaglanden
description:
Ben jij er graag voor pleegkinderen, ouder(s) en pleegouders, zodat kinderen kunnen opgroeien in een stabiele en fijne omgeving? Kom dan werken als pleegzorgbegeleider bij Timon in de regio Haaglanden.

Doortastend, geduldig en daadkrachtig

Een stabiele en veilige omgeving is niet altijd vanzelfsprekend. Daar weten we bij Timon alles van. Lukt het echt niet thuis, dan is een pleeggezin vaak een oplossing, voor korte of langere tijd. We proberen altijd om een kind terug te laten gaan naar de ouders, tenzij het niet anders kan. Als pleegzorgbegeleider bij Timon ondersteun je ouder(s), pleegouders en pleegkinderen bij de uitdagingen waarvoor zij staan. Elke situatie is anders. En het kan gaan om een vrijwillige plaatsing, voogdij of een ondertoezichtstelling (OTS). Dat vraagt van jou als pleegzorgbegeleider om geduld, sensitiviteit en daadkracht. Je kunt goed organiseren en houdt overzicht. En, als de situatie erom vraagt, overwicht.

Jouw werk doet ertoe

Als pleegzorgbegeleider coördineer je de pleegzorgplaatsing en alles wat daarbij komt kijken. Je begeleidt de samenwerking tussen ouder(s) en pleegouders. Daarbij staat het belang en de ontwikkeling van het kind altijd voorop. Je ondersteunt richting kind, pleegouders en ouder(s) in hun rol. Je monitort de samenwerking en signaleert. En biedt individuele ondersteuning en gezamenlijk ondersteuning in de samenwerking in het zorgteam. Samen zoek je naar oplossingen. Je signaleert spanningen en emoties. Hebt oog voor loyaliteit en hechting. En kijkt altijd naar het beste voor het kind. Met als doel: een fijne omgeving zodat het kind zich kan ontwikkelen. Kortom, jouw werk doet ertoe.

Dit ga je doen

  • Je ondersteunt het kind, de pleegouders en de ouders en bent de schakel tussen hen.
  • Je stelt samen doelen op, legt die vast in een plan en gaat daarmee aan de slag.
  • Je bent een klankbord voor pleegouders en biedt handvatten voor zorg en opvoeding.
  • Je houdt contact met instanties als zoals school, GGZ, Jeugdbescherming en CJG.
  • Je zorgt dat iedereen zich gehoord en gezien voelt
  • Je werkt zelfstandig en overlegt met collega’s en de gedragswetenschapper .

'Het mooist vind ik wanneer we samen met ouders en pleegouders een kind zien ontwikkelen.'

Nicole van Schaijk, pleegzorgbegeleider bij Timon. Lees het heleverhaal van Nicole .

Dit vragen we van je

  • Een relevant hbo-diploma (bijvoorbeeld Social Work of Pedagogiek).
  • Een geldige SKJ-registratie.
  • Rijbewijs B en een auto.
  • Goede mondelinge en schriftelijke communicatievaardigheden.
  • Een aantal jaar relevante werkervaring in de jeugd- of pleegzorg.

Dit bieden wij

Op basis van een 36-urige werkweek kun je rekenen op:

  • Een bruto maand salaris volgens de cao Jeugdzorg (schaal 9) van € 3. 191,69 tot € 4.929,28, afhankelijk van je kennis en ervaring.
  • Een jaarcontract van 24 uur tot 36 uur per week. Functioneer je goed? Dan zetten we dit contract om in een vast dienstverband.
  • 25 vakantiedagen, 8% vakantiegeld en reiskostenvergoeding.
  • Een eindejaarsuitkering van 8,3% van je bruto jaarsalaris.
  • Een eigen coach die jou helpt met je persoonlijke doelstellingen en ontwikkeling.

Binnen Timon krijg je een uitgebreid inwerktraject waarin we je koppelen aan een buddy. Daarnaast volg je diverse trainingen en opleidingen gericht op jouw functie, zoals: Functiescholing pleegzorg, Contextuele hulpverlening en Traumasensitief werken.

Wij zijn Timon

Je christelijke geloof verbinden met je professionele inzet? Dat kan bij Timon! Bij ons ben je er voor kinderen, jongeren en ouders. En ons team is er voor jóu. Iedereen kan een beroep op ons doen, ongeacht achtergrond en levensovertuiging. Met ruim 800 bevlogen medewerkers werken we in een groot deel van Nederland. Timon innoveert en groeit. We denken in kansen en zetten graag een stapje extra.

Jij @ Timon?

Herken je jezelf in deze vacature en denk je dat je past bij onze organisatie? Solliciteer dan snel, de collega’s van Haaglanden gaan graag met je in gesprek.

title: Gedragswetenschapper alleenstaande moeders en kind
description:
Als gedragswetenschapper werk je op alle niveaus mee aan goede zorg en ondersteuning aan jongeren en jongvolwassenen en hun gezin. Met jouw skills help je collega’s hun cliënten goed te begeleiden en samen de kwaliteit van maatschappelijke zorg te waarborgen. Voor het team van Noa in Amsterdam zijn we op zoek naar een gedragswetenschapper voor 16 uur per week.

Noa biedt 24-uurs ondersteuning aan (jonge) moeders tussen de 18 en 40 jaar zonder vaste woon- of verblijfplaats. In een kleinschalige woonomgeving worden moeder en kind opgevangen en begeleid richting zelfstandigheid. Deze begeleiding wordt uitgevoerd door maatschappelijk begeleiders, ondersteund door pedagogisch medewerkers. Daarnaast zijn er ouder-kind begeleiders gekoppeld aan de locatie, die zich specifiek bezighouden met het bevorderen van de ouder-kind interactie. In de voorziening wonen tevens omwoners die als goede buur voor de cliënten aanwezig zijn.

Analytisch, inspirerend, daadkrachtig

Als gedragswetenschapper geef jij, samen met de teammanager, duaal sturing aan het team van maatschappelijk begeleiders en pedagogisch medewerkers. Hulpverleners hebben de juiste vaardigheden en tools nodig om hun cliënten goed te begeleiden. Jij coacht hen daarbij en bespreekt de kwaliteit van zorg in de werkbegeleidingsgesprekken. Je sluit aan bij de vragen van hulpverleners en denkt mee over casuïstiek. Je traint hen met jouw kennis en ervaring. Je volgt de ontwikkelingen in de wetenschap en in de samenleving. Samen met de afdeling Strategie & Beleid werk je aan doorontwikkeling van zorgconcepten. En in samenwerking met de regiomanager bewaak je de kwaliteit van zorg én de zichtbaarheid van het zorgaanbod bij gemeenten en collega-organisaties. Dat vraagt wat van je. Je bent analytisch, inspirerend en onderzoekend. In acute situaties treed je daadkrachtig op.

Jouw werk doet ertoe!

Als gedragswetenschapper ben je er vooral voor de zorgprofessionals. Samen met de hulpverleners zet je begeleidings- en behandeltrajecten op en houd je deze op de rit. Je werkt veelal alleen in deze functie, mét de mogelijkheid om te sparren met andere gedragswetenschappers in Amsterdam of het land. Bijvoorbeeld als je ergens tegenaan loopt in jouw zorgconcept. De protocollen en richtlijnen maken we op maat voor de specifieke situatie van cliënten. Het mooie is dat je ook invloed hebt op de kwaliteit van zorg in het algemeen. Jouw werk doet ertoe! Wil je meer zien over het werk van onze Gedragswetenschappers, bekijk dan hier het filmpje van Helga , één van onze Gedragswetenschappers binnen Timon.

Dit ga je doen

  • Je stuurt met de teammanager het team duaal aan.
  • Je werkt samen met ketenpartners rondom een cliënt, zoals bv GGD.
  • Je ondersteunt de regiomanager en spart over ontwikkelingen in de jeugdzorg.
  • Je maakt kwartaalrapportages en analyseert de uitkomsten inhoudelijk.

Nossa história

Nossa história nasceu do sonho de uma grande mulher empreendedora, a espanhola Asunción Romacho. Em 1960, dona "Asun", como era chamada carinhosamente, chegou ao Brasil. Trouxe junto no navio os três filhos, a sogra e a experiência de sete anos como dona de uma ferragem na cidade espanhola de Guadix, na Andaluzia.

No ano de 1963, seu marido Ernesto instalou um pequeno armazém que ficava junto à casa da família, no bairro Cavalhada, onde todos trabalharam juntos durante anos.

Em 1975, a família deixou Porto Alegre rumo a Quintão, com muitos desafios, pois naquela época não havia luz elétrica na cidade. A iluminação ficava por conta de lampiões, carne, manteiga e perecíveis eram mantidos em isopores. Não tinha horário, "Eu começava às vezes às 7h e só saía meia-noite. Ficava até quando tinha cliente" – lembra a matriarca, em bom espanhol, que os mais de 40 anos no Brasil não a fizeram perder. Asunción passou 10 anos em Quintão, até voltar para Porto Alegre, em 1985. No retorno à Capital, a fundadora não abriu mão de seu lugar, de pé, atrás de uma caixa da loja.

A rede cresceu e a matriarca de uma família supermercadista tem hoje seu apelido estampado na fachada de 42 lojas, agora presentes não só em praias gaúchas mas também em Porto Alegre, Região Metropolitana de Porto Alegre e Serra Gaúcha.

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.
We want to transform the world of software operations by enabling true model-driven operations via next-generation infrastructure-as-code. This will allow companies to run very efficient bare-metal operations for high-performance computing, private cloud, data lakes, AI/ML, and analytics. We need to invent some new technology, and we need to build some new products; we are therefore looking for someone who can lead and inspire a regional software engineering team to fulfill this initiative.
The Solutions Engineering team works in close collaboration with our managed infrastructure operations team, which runs many private OpenStack clouds and Kubernetes clusters for customers around the world. This enables us to improve our infra-as-code products based on our own real experience, mirroring that of our users and customers. We work in Python, creating open-source automation capabilities that simplify operations for anybody, anywhere, who is building on Ubuntu.
Most of the team's work involves pure Python software development focused on enabling true DevOps workflows. We strive for high quality in both design, documentation, tests, and performance as we enhance operations code packages and Ubuntu itself in order to ensure our platform is the easiest, most robust, and best performing for driving your infrastructure.
As an Engineering Manager, your primary responsibility is to the people you lead and support: ensuring that they are growing as engineers, doing valuable work, and finding satisfaction in their career at Canonical. We need someone who can display technical leadership by leveraging a solid background in software development so that they're able to challenge and grow their team members. You will have the opportunity to influence the culture, facilitate technical delivery, and work with your team on direction and execution.
What you will do

  • Lead and develop a team of Python engineers working remotely in global locations
  • Hiring, coaching, mentoring, feedback, and hands-on career development
  • Demonstrate sound engineering principles by directly contributing code yourself
  • Plan and manage progress on agreed goals and projects
  • Set and manage expectations with other engineering and operations teams
  • Coordinate with management and internal and external stakeholders or customers
  • Advocate for modern, agile software development practices
  • Help develop and evangelize great engineering and organizational practices
  • Grow a healthy, collaborative engineering culture in line with the company values
  • Be an active part of the leadership team and collaborate with other leaders in the organisation
  • Travel globally up to 10% of time for internal and external events
Who you are
  • You love developing and growing people and have a track record of doing it
  • You are knowledgeable and passionate about agile software development
  • You love leading, coaching, and mentoring software developers - especially Python ones
  • You are knowledgeable in cloud computing concepts & technologies
  • You are comfortable administrating Linux servers, including their storage and networking
  • You have hands-on experience with software automation
  • You are organized and want your team to deliver high-quality software in a timely manner
  • You are a lifelong learner
Bonus points for
  • You have graduated with a university degree in Computer Science or related software engineering field
  • Having a thorough understanding of modern infrastructure, including OpenStack or Kubernetes
  • Having experience in operations as well as software development
  • Being familiar with the challenges of large-scale, multi-cloud operations
  • Go expertise
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

description:
Join to apply for the Account Director role at Hogarth

Join to apply for the Account Director role at Hogarth

Hogarth is the Global Content Experience Company. Part of WPP, Hogarth partners with one in every two of the world’s top 100 brands including Coca-Cola, Ford, Rolex, Nestlé, Mondelez and Dyson. With a breadth of experience across an extensive range of sectors, Hogarth offers the unrivaled ability to deliver relevant, engaging, and measurable content across all channels and media - both established and emerging. The number of channels at our fingertips; the need for speed; and the drive for mass personalisation, all mean that brands need different solutions. Our global team of over 7,500 craft and technology experts brings together creative, production and innovation to help clients navigate this exciting and ever-changing world of today’s content experience.
WPP is the creative transformation company. We use the power of creativity to build better futures for our people, planet, clients and communities. Working at WPP means being part of a global network of more than 100,000 talented people dedicated to doing extraordinary work for our clients. We operate in over 100 countries, with corporate headquarters in New York, London and Singapore. WPP is a world leader in marketing services, with deep AI, data and technology capabilities, global presence and unrivalled creative talent. Our clients include many of the biggest companies and advertisers in the world, including approximately 300 of the Fortune Global 500. Our people are the key to our success. We're committed to fostering a culture of creativity, belonging and continuous learning, attracting and developing the brightest talent, and providing exciting career opportunities that help our people grow.
A Hybrid working model
We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.
What does an Account Director do at Hogarth?
We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Account Director to join our dynamic team. As an Account Director, you will be responsible for the overall management of key client accounts, leading and developing a team, and contributing to the growth of our business. You will be the primary point of contact for client and internal escalations, ensuring smooth and efficient operations while fostering strong, long-lasting relationships. This role requires a strategic thinker with a strong understanding of integrated campaigns, particularly in the video production space, and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment
Key Responsibilities:
Client Account Management:

  • Assume overall responsibility for the successful management of assigned client accounts.
  • Develop and maintain strong relationships with key client stakeholders, managing their perceptions and expectations.
  • Act as the primary point of contact for client escalations, proactively resolving issues and communicating effectively.
  • Understand and adhere to contractual obligations, commercial arrangements, and SLAs.
  • Liaise with Print Production/Broadcast teams to ensure client requirements are met and resolve any issues or complaints to the satisfaction of all stakeholders.
  • Maintain a deep understanding of the client, agency, and Hogarth relationships and how they interact.
Team Leadership & Development:
  • Coach and develop team members to ensure their success through personalized development plans.
  • Provide guidance and support to team members in their day-to-day tasks and responsibilities.
  • Foster a collaborative and positive team environment.
Business Growth & Financial Management:
  • Work closely with the GAD on P&L management, forecasting, and budgeting.
  • Prepare cost estimates and support the SAM/AM in their cost estimation process, providing final sign-off.
Operational Excellence:
  • Make informed decisions and solve problems based on sound knowledge and experience.
  • Work effectively under pressure and meet tight deadlines.
  • Understand the technical elements of video production, including formats, delivery options, uploads, compression, and web platforms (YouTube, etc.).
  • Possess knowledge of the editing and post-production process for video.
Qualifications & Experience:
  • Minimum 6 years of experience in Client Service.
  • Minimum 2-3 years of experience as an Account Director leading a team.
  • High level of IT literacy, including proficiency in spreadsheet software.
  • Strong numeracy skills.
  • Excellent prioritization, time management, and attention to detail.
  • Fluent oral and written English is essential; other languages are desirable.
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills.
  • Clear understanding of international brand challenges.

Description

Willis Towers Watson (WTW) is seeking ambitious, analytical underwriting talent with 5-10 years of experience in the insurance industry with experience in builders’ risk and property underwriting. This is a high-profile client facing role working directly with WTW CRB NA to develop new and existing partnerships in line with its strategic growth initiatives. The successful candidate will work in a highly collaborative Verita (MGU) team environment.

Note: Employment-based non-immigrant visa sponsorship and/or assistance is not offered for this specific job opportunity.

The Role

  • Work with WTW’s broking team(s), Verita executives, actuaries, and cat modelers to analyze Verita’s insurance risks on a portfolio level to obtain capacity in the form of delegated authority, reinsurance structures and/or other innovative solutions.
  • Negotiate and place Reinsurance Treaties and/or FAC placements utilizing markets from London, the US, Bermuda and around the world.
  • Coordinate and attend underwriting and claim audits with Verita’s capacity markets on a regular basis.
  • Ensure that company, market and client related documentation is issued (internally and externally) accurately and on time.
  • Comply with external regulatory and internal statutory policies, procedures and regulations.
  • Coordinate internal resources, such as analytics, contracts and client services to provide solutions to client(s).
  • Meet with senior management both internally and externally to present materials.
  • The candidate must have experience in Builder’s Risk, General Liability and Property
    • Candidates with significant experience/relationships in one of these areas will be considered and expected to develop the expertise in the other areas.
  • Conduct comprehensive market analysis to identify trends, opportunities, and potential risks to Verita’s portfolio.
  • Engage with capacity providers and reinsurance markets to negotiate terms, pricing, and coverage to secure optimal outcomes for Verita.
  • Stay abreast of industry developments, regulatory changes, and emerging risks that may impact reinsurance strategies.
  • Assist in the training and development of graduate hires.
  • Other duties and responsibilities as assigned.
  • Good understanding of pricing components and rating methodologies
  • Uses all appropriate underwriting tools, disciplines and knowledge of strategies to ensure underwriting guidelines are followed
  • Exhibits strong underwriting skills through strategic, thorough account reviews and file documentation
  • Adheres to guidelines and underwriting discipline to minimize exposure and appropriately price risk.
  • Complete understanding and ability to use sophisticated pricing models across various structures, guaranteed cost, captives, SIR’s, deductibles, etc.

Qualifications

The Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree (B. A.) from a four-year College or university.
  • 8+ years of work experience, preferably in Property and Casualty insurance, reinsurance or related non-life insurance consulting.
  • Understanding of Managing General Underwriter program life cycles and placements.
  • Strong negotiation skills
  • Ability to multi-task priorities in a fast-paced, high intensity environment.
  • Experience in giving presentations to prospects, capacity partners and internal groups.
  • Computer skills, including Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Outlook.
  • Effective analysis, problem solving and communication skills.
  • Strong knowledge of property insurance policies and regulations.
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Attention to detail and accuracy in assessments.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
  • Very strong technical and leadership qualities
  • Well established in the marketplace and has excellent relationships with brokers and agents on both regional and national level
  • Well versed and experienced in working, producing and underwriting all sizes of accounts with large brokerage houses, agents and specialty retailers.
  • Established underwriting, quoting and binding track record of profitable business.

This position will remain posted for a minimum of three business days from the date posted or until a sufficient/appropriate candidate slate has been identified.

Compensation and Benefits
Base salary range and benefits information for this position are being included in accordance with requirements of various state/local pay transparency legislation. Please note that salaries may vary for different individuals in the same role based on several factors, including but not limited to location of the role, individual competencies, education/professional certifications, qualifications/experience, performance in the role and potential for revenue generation (Producer roles only).

Compensation
The base salary compensation range being offered for this role is $150,000 - $250,000 USD per year. This role is also eligible for an annual short-term incentive bonus.
Company Benefits
WTW provides a competitive benefit package which includes the following (eligibility requirements apply):

  • Health and Welfare Benefits: Medical (including prescription coverage), Dental, Vision, Health Savings Account, Commuter Account, Health Care and Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts, Group Accident, Group Critical Illness, Life Insurance, AD&D, Group Legal, Identify Theft Protection, Wellbeing Program and Work/Life Resources (including Employee Assistance Program)
  • Leave Benefits: Paid Holidays, Annual Paid Time Off (includes paid state/local paid leave where required), Short-Term Disability, Long-Term Disability, Other Leaves (e.g., Bereavement, FMLA, ADA, Jury Duty, Military Leave, and Parental and Adoption Leave),Paid Time Off
  • Retirement Benefits: Contributory Pension Plan and Savings Plan (401k). All Level 38 and more senior roles may also be eligible for non-qualified Deferred Compensation and Deferred Savings Plans.

At WTW, we trust you to know your work and the people, tools and environment you need to be successful. The majority of our colleagues work in a ”hybrid” style, with a mix of remote, in-person and in-office interactions dependent on the needs of the team, role and clients. Our flexibility is rooted in trust and “hybrid” is not a one-size-fits-all solution.

description:
WHAT MAKES US EPIC?

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.

ENGINEERING - GAMES

What We Do

Unreal projects have been leading the pack of real-time entertainment with our constantly growing team of engineering experts. We’re always improving on the tools and technology that empower content developers worldwide.

What You'll Do

Join us in shaping the future of Fortnite — one of the world’s most influential interactive platforms. We’re looking for an experienced engineering leader to drive the development of foundational systems that support the Fortnite experience at scale — including player onboarding, progression, identity, lobbies, and purchasing. These systems form the connective tissue of the Fortnite ecosystem, powering player interaction, progression, and seamless transitions between experiences. This role is central to our goal of delivering consistent, high-quality user experiences across internal and third-party content — while enabling scale, flexibility, and innovation for the entire platform.

In this role, you will

  • Set the technical vision and architecture for Fortnite’s ecosystem systems, driving scalability, consistency, and platform evolution.
  • Lead development of features that span all Fortnite content, ensuring unified experiences and reliable scale across modes
  • Partner with internal teams (e.g., Battle Royale, LEGO Fortnite, new IPs) to ensure systems align with desired flows and player-facing requirements.
  • Collaborate with third-party developers to enable flexible, performant integration with Fortnite's shared systems.
  • Grow and lead a high-performing team, fostering a culture of innovation, inclusion, and engineering excellence.
  • Drive platform evolution while balancing stability, performance, and flexibility for diverse use cases.
  • Drive innovation and creative problem solving in areas that do not have an internal precedent

What we're looking for

  • Proven experience architecting and building user-facing systems in a live services or platform environment (e.g., menus, accounts, progression, commerce).
  • Strong understanding of scalable backend and client-service patterns, ideally in cross-platform or online service contexts.
  • Comfortable navigating complex user flows and dependencies across multiple teams and surfaces.
  • Strong leadership and communication skills with a track record of cross-functional collaboration.
  • Passion for building intuitive, reliable systems that support a wide range of player and developer needs.

EPIC JOB + EPIC BENEFITS = EPIC LIFE

We pay 100% for benefits for both employees (EEs) and dependents (deps). Our current benefits package includes coverage for medical, dental, and life insurance. We also offer supplemental benefits including daily meal vouchers, and commuter benefits for onsite employees.

ABOUT US

Epic Games spans across 25 countries with 46 studios and 4,500+ employees globally. For over 25 years, we've been making award-winning games and engine technology that empowers others to make visually stunning games and 3D content that bring environments to life like never before. Epic's award-winning Unreal Engine technology not only provides game developers the ability to build high-fidelity, interactive experiences for PC, console, mobile, and VR, it is also a tool being embraced by content creators across a variety of industries such as media and entertainment, automotive, and architectural design. As we continue to build our Engine technology and develop remarkable games, we strive to build teams of world-class talent.

Ser responsável pelos processos de administração da hotelaria em atendimento e satisfação do efetivo embarcado da unidade de trabalho, de acordo com as normas e procedimentos adotados pela empresa e auditoria interna nas dependências do cliente (embarcações/plataformas).

Responsabilidades:

  1. Acompanhar todo movimento do estoque em todas as áreas da unidade de trabalho, verificando diariamente o mesmo, planejando os consumos dos produtos de acordo com suas respectivas datas de validade de modo que não haja descarte desnecessário, também sendo de sua responsabilidade o desempenho em relação aos limites de consumos estabelecidos pela empresa – traduzindo em custos.
  2. Receber e armazenar todas as mercadorias recebidas no rancho, seguindo os padrões PVPS, confirmando o recebimento das mercadorias enviadas nos ranchos periódicos, através da relação enviada pela Expedição / Supervisão. Qualquer alteração nos padrões de consumo deve ser enviada juntamente com o pedido e justificada.
  3. Controlar e checar os cardápios diariamente para que não haja alterações no cardápio padrão, acompanhar os mesmos pré-estabelecidos e suas fichas de preparação quando aplicável, para que sejam produzidos eficientemente e da forma requisitada pelo cliente, acompanhando as quantidades produzidas e repostas durante refeições e lanches.
  4. Realizar obrigatoriamente visitas à cozinha às 07:00h; 08:30h; 10:00h; 14:30h; 16:00h e às 19:00h, para supervisão da limpeza, arrumação e organização de equipamentos e utensílios, verificando se as pias estão vazias e limpas, se as panelas estão tampadas ou limpas e embocadas para baixo, se as placas de altileno estão imersas em solução sanitizante, se os objetos cortantes estão devidamente protegidos e guardados, se os equipamentos estão sendo utilizados corretamente ou se estão devidamente limpos e desligados e, se os colaboradores estão utilizando os EPI’s em concordância com as atividades exercidas.
  5. Coordenar as equipes para que as refeições e lanches sejam organizados nas rampas adequadamente e servidos no horário contratual, sempre verificando a limpeza do refeitório antes, durante e após o serviço, além de realizar as provas das refeições com antecedência antes de servi-las, alterando-as caso haja necessidade; e em concordância com o cliente.
  6. Acompanhar a separação das carnes para descongelamento, pré-preparo e preparo das mesmas.
  7. Acompanhar o cumprimento de normas da ANVISA: coleta de amostras; verificação e controle de temperaturas dos alimentos e equipamentos.
  8. Verificar constantemente, os pontos de lanches, solicitando reposição de mercadorias, caso necessário, obedecendo criteriosamente o instrumento contratual.
  9. Criar listas de tarefas para seus subordinados referentes às limpezas a serem efetuadas diariamente, semanalmente e mensalmente. Controlar e acompanhar os mesmos.
  10. Verificar diariamente a limpeza dos camarotes, escritórios, salas de lazer, e da lavanderia, como também acompanhar as realizações das higienizações cumprindo na íntegra o cronograma estabelecido na unidade. Além de observar o desempenho da equipe e a satisfação do cliente em relação aos serviços prestados destas áreas.
  11. Realizar diariamente o DDSMS, orientando os funcionários em normas de higiene, SMS e procedimentos operacionais, auditoria comportamental e demais tópicos necessários, adicionando tópicos solicitados pelo cliente ou pela base.
  12. Desenvolver e treinar sua equipe, possibilitando o desenvolvimento e crescimento interno dos mesmos, mantendo a disciplina e harmonia dentro de sua equipe, visando o bom desenvolvimento, com foco na qualidade, dos serviços prestados na unidade de trabalho.
  13. Manter sempre sua equipe informada com datas de embarque, férias, incluindo a passagem de informações gerais para equipes embarcando, tais como: comunicações de embarque e quaisquer demais informes provenientes da base.
  14. Realizar a avaliação de desempenho dos profissionais de sua equipe embarcados, de acordo com os critérios adotados pela empresa.
  15. Enviar, periodicamente, os RDH’s / FATURAS por e-mail, ou quando solicitadas, estas deverão ser assinadas e enviadas digitalizadas.
  16. Realizar inventário de todos os produtos enviados pela empresa.
  17. Realizar controle de saída diária dos alimentos.
  18. Controlar desperdício, levando em consideração a quantidade planejada, sobra limpa, sobra suja e resto ingestão.
  19. Reportar a base qualquer solicitação ou ocorrência de imediato.
  20. Realizar controle de validade.
  21. Realizar implantação e auditorias dos processos offshore.

title: SUPERVISOR COMERCIAL
description:
MISSÃO DO CARGO:
Supervisionar e coordenar as atividades inerentes à área de vendas da Filial Campinas, contribuindo com a gerência na definição dos critérios e prioridades em cada processo, visando garantir o cumprimento das metas e indicadores estabelecidos, em termos de volume de vendas, participação de mercado e lucratividade, bem como assegurar o padrão de qualidade, das ações e das diretrizes estabelecidas, buscando novas tecnologias para o aumento da produtividade, automação e sustentação do negócio.

  6. Acompanhar contratos na região, avaliando tarifas, serviços e negociando preços com clientes.

  13. Pesquisar, analisar e implantar indicadores de qualidade e desempenho, tomando ações corretivas.
  14. Atualizar indicadores do sistema de qualidade e planos de ação.
  15. Liderar, motivar e desenvolver a equipe alinhada aos valores da Via Pajuçara.

DEFINIÇÃO DE NÍVEL/ CARREIRA: Cargo de Gestão / Nível Tático

FORMAÇÃO PROFISSIONAL: Superior Completo em Administração, Marketing ou Comércio Exterior

COMPETÊNCIAS ESSENCIAIS: Negociação, Solução de Problemas, Foco em Resultado, Liderança, Visão Sistêmica, Planejamento, Relacionamento Interpessoal

Desde 1984, a Via Pajuçara constrói sua história baseada no respeito e no compromisso com a qualidade. Construiu sua marca no mercado com a contribuição de clientes, colaboradores, parceiros e fornecedores.

Join to apply for the Graduate Legal Counsel - Tech Sector role at Canonical

Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.
We are expanding our in-house legal team, creating an opportunity for an exceptional recent graduate as junior Legal Advisor or junior Legal Counsel. The successful candidate will be a rigorous and effective practitioner with a track record of academic achievement and social engagement. At Canonical they will have the opportunity to work on a variety of transactional matters in the technology and enterprise software realm, as well as the contracts that underpin global employment, contracting and partnerships. In this appointment we are more focused on ability than experience; the position is open to applicants with a relevant degree, but does not have a requirement for extensive work experience. The successful candidate will work closely with our in-house legal team and colleagues worldwide.
Candidates must be able to demonstrate good commercial judgment as well as being organized, efficient, and capable to provide high quality legal and commercial advice. We are looking for a rigorous work ethic, detailed analysis, conscientiousness, and the ambition to identify opportunities for improvement.
Location : This role is home based in Europe, the Middle East, Africa or the Americas, with the option of our London office.
The role entails

  • Report to our global general counsel
  • Draft, review, and negotiate commercial contracts with customers and vendors in many countries across the globe
  • Provide legal support to various internal clients across the company, including Canonical's sales organization
  • Interface with cross-functional teams to support company initiatives
  • Utilize Canonical's contract management system to ensure accurate data is maintained for signed contracts
  • Work with local counsel in many countries to seek and implement advice
What we are looking for in you
  • An exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • A degree in law, JD or equivalent, and active license to practice law or current progress towards that
  • Drive and a track record of going above-and-beyond expectations
  • Strong organizational and prioritization skills with the ability to work in a fast-paced, multi-cultural environment
  • Effective both independently and as part of a team
  • A passion for technology evidenced by personal initiatives and projects
  • Professional written and spoken English with excellent drafting and presentation skills
  • Confidence to respectfully speak up, exchange feedback, and share ideas without hesitation
  • Appreciative of diversity; polite and effective in a multicultural multinational organization
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability
  • Thoughtfulness and self-motivation
  • Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments
  • Ability to travel twice a year, for company events up to two weeks long
Nice-to-have skills
  • Experience in commercial transactions, intellectual property, or corporate law
  • Leadership and the ability to influence others to embrace new ideas or practices
  • Understanding of the open source software community and values
  • Understanding of the technology industry - silicon, data centers, PCs, connected devices, and software
  • Experience working on in-house legal team and/or law firm
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Our Purpose

Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart, and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses, and governments realize their greatest potential.

Title and Summary

Regional Product Director, Threat Intelligence Solutions – LAC (RF #177)

About us
At Mastercard, we are committed to safeguarding the digital ecosystem by pioneering cutting-edge security solutions. As cyber threats evolve, so do we—leveraging deep expertise in network security and data intelligence to protect transactions worldwide. We don’t just react to cyber threats; we stay ahead of them.

As a key member of the Security Solutions Organization (SSO), you’ll be at the forefront of this mission, ensuring our Threat Intelligence solutions empower businesses across Latin America and the Caribbean (LAC) to mitigate risks and build resilience in an increasingly complex cybersecurity landscape.

Your role

As Regional Product Director, Threat Intelligence Solutions, you will be the primary advocate for our intelligence-driven security products across LAC. You’ll lead go-to-market strategies, revenue growth, and product adoption while collaborating with internal teams and external stakeholders to drive innovation. Your expertise will shape how financial institutions and businesses across the region combat cyber threats.

Key Responsibilities:

  1. Lead Regional Strategy & Execution—Manage the Threat Intelligence solutions market performance across LAC, overseeing revenue performance, defining KPIs, growth plans, and expansion strategies to develop a sustainable business model.
  2. Drive Revenue and Product Adoption—Oversee sales performance, support and maintain a strong customer pipeline, identify new opportunities, and develop business cases to scale our offerings.
  3. Product Roadmap & Market Insights—Collaborate with global teams to refine and localize solutions based on customer feedback and regional and local needs.
  4. Customer Engagement & Advocacy—Build and maintain client relationships, ensuring seamless onboarding, training, and continuous value delivery.
  5. Cyber Threat Intelligence Thought Leadership—Stay ahead of emerging threats and market trends, shaping how Mastercard delivers security across the payment and financial sectors.

What We’re Looking For

  1. Threat Intelligence Expertise—Deep understanding of cyber risk management, information security, and threat intelligence solutions.
  2. Payments & Financial Sector Experience—Strong industry knowledge and experience with financial institutions, payment networks, or fintechs.
  3. Proven Product Leadership—Background in product management, go-to-market strategy, and customer-driven innovation.
  4. Strategic & Analytical Mindset—Strong business case development, financial acumen, and ability to translate data into insights.
  5. Strong Communicator & Collaborator—Ability to work cross-functionally, influence stakeholders, and drive impact in a fast-moving environment.
  6. Multilingual Proficiency—Fluency in English (Spanish is highly recommended).

Corporate Security Responsibility

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks come with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

  • Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
  • Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
  • Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
  • Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

São Paulo, BR

Este é um Banco de Talentos de Professores para a Escola Eleva São Paulo. A Escola Eleva é uma das escolas Inspired no Brasil. Aqui nós temos vocação para ensinar e paixão por aprender. Nosso time é movido por excelência, entusiasmo, respeito e responsabilidade. Somos adeptos da mentalidade de crescimento e estamos constantemente motivados a buscar o que há de melhor em educação, no Brasil e no mundo e em pensar as melhores maneiras de aplicar isso em nossas escolas e inspirar nossos alunos.

Nossa missão é formar uma nova geração de líderes capazes de fazer a diferença em suas vidas e contribuir para um mundo melhor. Para isso, contamos com um time de profissionais inquietos, com brilho nos olhos e movidos por entusiasmo. Pessoas que superam desafios diariamente, com otimismo e acreditando no legado que estamos construindo.

Se juntando a nós como professor(a), sua missão principal será lecionar para nossos alunos, estimulando o desenvolvimento deles com cuidado, responsabilidade e entusiasmo!

O que você fará:

  • Adquirir conhecimento sobre os programas curriculares utilizados nas séries em que leciona;
  • Trabalhar colaborativamente com outros professores e lideranças da matéria e do segmento, buscando alinhamento e consistência;
  • Planejar as aulas e produzir materiais pedagógicos, levando em conta as individualidades dos alunos;
  • Ministrar aulas da matéria alinhadas com a BNCC e o Material Didático selecionado pela escola (físico ou digital);
  • Utilizar práticas variadas de ensino/aprendizagem, incluindo metodologias ativas, ensino responsivo, avaliação para o aprendizado (Assessment for Learning) e métodos investigativos;
  • Utilizar de forma consistente tecnologias para enriquecer e melhorar o aprendizado;
  • Supervisionar alunos em espaços escolares;
  • Substituir professores no mesmo segmento quando solicitado;
  • Mediar relacionamento entre crianças, famílias e escola;
  • Preparar avaliações e comunicar os resultados;
  • Tabular e analisar dados pedagógicos com o intuito de ajustar ensino e melhorar o aprendizado;
  • Formatar e alimentar com dados nossa plataforma de acompanhamento de avaliações (iSams) em preparação para relatórios para famílias;
  • Participar de reuniões pedagógicas (incluindo COC) e eventos realizados na escola;
  • Garantir a segurança física e emocional dos alunos, e zelar pelo seu crescimento sócio-emocional (safeguarding).

Por mais que nos esforcemos para incluir todas as principais responsabilidades e atribuições desta posição, pode ser que nem toda atividade pertinente à função tenha sido identificada. Dessa forma, a lista acima não é restritiva e pode ser estendida ou alterada para incluir outras tarefas que se aplicam ao cargo.

O que você precisa ter:

  • Diploma de licenciatura na matéria da sua área ou de Pedagogia ou Normal se tiver interesse em posição de Regente para Infantil ou Fundamental 1.

Nossos professores devem ser capazes de/devem ter:

  • Paixão pela profissão;
  • Estar sempre em busca de melhorias;
  • Atitude positiva frente a mudanças;
  • Compreensão profunda da matéria lecionada;
  • Estabelecer expectativas claras e esticar metas;
  • Excelente planejamento de aulas e domínio de sala;
  • Habilidade de julgar a efetividade do aprendizado;
  • Comprometimento com o desenvolvimento dos alunos, avaliando os resultados e fornecendo feedback para melhorar seu desempenho;
  • Preocupação e atenção genuína pelos níveis mais altos de bem-estar dos alunos.

Será um diferencial se você tiver:

  • Experiência em escolas bilíngues ou internacionais;
  • Inglês intermediário ou avançado.

O Inspired se compromete em salvaguardar e promover o bem-estar das crianças e jovens e, se você se juntar ao nosso time, esperaremos o mesmo de você, assim como que se comprometa a realizar os treinamentos de safeguarding que consideramos pertinentes à sua função. A proteção do bem-estar dos nossos alunos é de responsabilidade de todos os colaboradores e os mesmos devem se comportar de maneira a refletir os princípios e valores da organização. Qualquer candidato pode ser submetido aos procedimentos apropriados de verificação.

As a Principal Database Administrator, you will:

  • Apply security patches , conduct version upgrades, and enforce strict compliance with database security best practices.

  • Leverage expertise in alternative database engines like MongoDB and CockroachDB to contribute to cross-functional database projects.
  • Manage and optimize cloud-based database environments , ensuring scalability, performance, and reliability in cloud infrastructure.

What You’ll Bring:

  • Solidhands-on experience in MS SQL Server Database Administration in production environments.
  • Extensive experience with MS SQL Server database features, including Jobs Scheduling, Monitoring, Patching, Backup/Recovery, Replication, Availability Groups , and Always On configurations.
  • Proven expertise in diagnosing and resolving performance bottlenecks and availability issues .
  • Solid understanding of alternative database engines like PostgreSQL , MongoDB and CockroachDB , with practical experience in their administration and troubleshooting.
  • Proficiency in cloud database administration , with experience in cloud platforms like AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.
  • Fluency in English , both written and verbal, with excellent communication skills.
  • Strong teamwork, analytical thinking, and problem-solving abilities, alongside a proactive approach to continuous learning.

You will substantially contribute to a wide variety of complex analyses and projects involving the design, financing, measurement, and financial analysis of the full spectrum of employer health and group benefit programs including medical, dental, life, disability, voluntary benefits, etc. You will interface with vendors and client service teams, prepare and communicate complex analyses to clients, and ensure quality standards are met. You will have the opportunity to position yourself to lead financial projects with small-to-midsized clients and work on cutting-edge projects alongside leaders in the industry.

  • Develops knowledge of varying client complexity by working across different client profiles and roles, including leading clients’ financial/actuarial engagements for a portfolio of small clients or managing FAA resources to coordinate effective and efficient delivery of more complex client deliverables.
  • Demonstrates an advanced/expert knowledge in all aspects of employee benefit plan design, underwriting, and funding concepts and H&B tools.
  • Is a key member on multiple employer client teams providing financial analyses, outputs, and client deliverables across a region.
  • Provides direction on benefit plan analysis, design, cost avoidance, risk, and funding strategies.
  • Reviews technical & consulting accuracy on client projects, including developing pricing and employee contributions strategies, modeling plan design alternatives, and calculating reserves.
  • Communicates complex financial/actuarial/analytic results to effectively drive client action.
  • Partners with Global Delivery Centers and Client Service teams to deliver superior project management.
  • Builds strong relationships internally and collaborates effectively on cross-functional teams.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years’ experience in professional services, ideally gained in a benefit consulting/brokerage firm or health underwriting/actuarial function of an insurance company.
  • Advanced knowledge of health and welfare products & services.
  • Experience with big data analytic techniques preferred.
  • Advanced knowledge of underwriting and funding concepts.
  • Proven ability to lead multiple projects simultaneously and produce quality deliverables on time and within budget.
  • Desire and ability to expand relationships with clients.
  • Proven ability to identify and resolve issues with limited information and experience.
  • Polished and well-developed written and verbal communication skills.
  • Self-starter attitude and ability to work independently and as part of a team.
  • Strong analytical, creative, and integrative skills.
  • Ability to direct work of more junior colleagues and provide feedback.
  • Excellent Microsoft Office skills, particularly in Excel and PowerPoint.
  • State Life and Health license required within 90 days of joining.
  • Relevant financial experience and/or university degree.
  • Progress towards completion of health actuarial designation or CEBS designation (optional).

Note: Employment-based non-immigrant visa sponsorship and/or assistance is not offered for this specific job opportunity.

This position will remain posted for a minimum of three business days from the date posted or until a sufficient/appropriate candidate slate has been identified.

Company Benefits

WTW provides a competitive benefit package which includes the following (eligibility requirements apply):

  • Health and Welfare Benefits: Medical (including prescription coverage), Dental, Vision, Health Savings Account, Commuter Account, Health Care and Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts, Group Accident, Group Critical Illness, Life Insurance, AD&D, Group Legal, Identity Theft Protection, Wellbeing Program and Work/Life Resources (including Employee Assistance Program).
  • Leave Benefits: Paid Holidays, Annual Paid Time Off (includes paid state/local paid leave where required), Short-Term Disability, Long-Term Disability, Other Leaves (e.g., Bereavement, FMLA, ADA, Jury Duty, Military Leave, and Parental and Adoption Leave).
  • Retirement Benefits: Contributory Pension Plan and Savings Plan (401k).

If the position allows for flexible working:

At WTW, we trust you to know your work and the people, tools, and environment you need to be successful. The majority of our colleagues work in a ”hybrid” style, with a mix of remote, in-person, and in-office interactions dependent on the needs of the team, role, and clients. Our flexibility is rooted in trust and “hybrid” is not a one-size-fits-all solution.

We understand flexibility is key to supporting an inclusive and diverse workforce, and so we encourage requests for all types of flexible working as well as location-based arrangements. Please speak to your recruiter to discuss more.

title: Machine Learning Engineer
description:
Join to apply for the Machine Learning Engineer role at Techunting

We are looking for a Machine Learning Engineer who dares to work with cutting-edge technology! It involves inspiring yourself with state-of-the-art research papers to help with the Machine Learning model design, implementation, training, and deployment. You will be responsible for applying the best MLOps practices and principles to the whole modeling workflow. It will require you to gain great insight into the problems, conceive how data can be exploited, and how new concepts can be created. This role enables you to apply novel ideas that can change the world, while learning a lot at the same time!

Main responsibilities and duties:

  1. Stay up-to-date with the latest advancements in machine learning by exploring and drawing insights from state-of-the-art research papers. Leverage this knowledge to design and develop innovative machine learning models tailored to our specific needs.
  2. Translate conceptual models into practical implementations, utilizing programming languages and machine learning frameworks. Train and fine-tune models to achieve optimal performance and accuracy.
  3. Drive the deployment process of machine learning models into production environments. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure smooth integration and scalability of the models.
  4. Apply the best MLOps (Machine Learning Operations) practices and principles throughout the entire modeling workflow. Streamline processes for efficient development, testing, and deployment of machine learning solutions.
  5. Dive deep into problem domains to gain a comprehensive understanding of challenges and opportunities. Analyze and preprocess data to extract valuable insights for model improvement.
  6. Propose and experiment with novel ideas and approaches to tackle complex problems. Explore creative ways to leverage data and develop new concepts that could potentially revolutionize the field.
  7. Collaborate with a team of skilled professionals, including data scientists, engineers, and domain experts. Foster a collaborative environment that encourages knowledge sharing and continuous learning.

Qualifications and Skills:

  1. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software or Electrical Engineering, or comparable professional experience in Machine Learning related areas.
  2. Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
  3. Experience working with native ML orchestration systems such as Kubeflow, Step Functions, MLflow, Airflow, and TFX.
  4. Experience in technologies like Spark, Kafka, Spark streaming, Flink, etc.
  5. Expertise in MLOps and model integration into larger-scale applications.
  6. Experience with implementing and scaling feature stores across organizations.
  7. Strong programming skills in Python and experience with popular machine learning libraries/frameworks (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch).
  8. Expertise in using Docker and Kubernetes.
  9. Strong problem-solving skills and ability to analyze and translate business requirements into technical solutions.
  10. Ability to read, interpret, and apply research papers in machine learning. A strong grasp of foundational machine learning concepts is essential.
  11. Knowledge of agile methodologies and ability to work in a fast-paced and evolving environment. Willingness to learn and adapt to new technologies and methodologies.
