Responsibilities
The Global Communications team at TikTok is responsible for all external communications related to the company. We're currently looking for a dynamic senior communications leader to join our fast-paced Global Communications team. As Head of Communications for Latin America, you will be responsible for providing ongoing counsel and partnership to the company's senior leaders across the region, while leading, inspiring and motivating a highly-engaged team.
We're looking for a dynamic leader with strong experience working in the technology industry. At TikTok, our leaders are also doers and you have proven experience conceptualizing, planning, and executing projects that have meaningful business impact. You're able to effectively manage through complex decisions and challenges, using sound judgment and expertise to mitigate risks and ensure the best outcomes. You are familiar with the media, regulatory and policy, as well as competitive landscape across the region and, as such, are able to effectively develop strategies to manage issues and mitigate risk, while ensuring balance between consumer and creative campaigns and reactive response efforts. As a strategic leader, you will work closely with other teams across the Global Brand & Comms department, including Marketing and CSR, as well as with our cross-functional partners — Product, Legal and Public Policy —to create cohesive and compelling communication strategies.
Ideal candidates are resilient, entrepreneurial-minded leaders who work well in an ever-evolving environment. You have strong media relationships. You collaborate with ease across teams and are able to weigh big picture objectives with immediate business needs. You're good at connecting the dots and you thrive in an entrepreneurial environment. And you lead with a compassionate, people-first mindset. This role reports to the Head of Global Corporate Communications.
Responsibilities:
- Advance the team's business objectives and enhance and protect corporate reputation in support of building our brand.
- Develop regional communication strategies that provide clear direction for the company's key initiatives.
- Build strong creative consumer campaigns, in partnership with Marketing, that help grow brand affinity.
- Create and lead strategies to effectively identify and mitigate early-stage crises while also effectively managing other potential risks to the company.
- Identify strategic priorities across the region aligned with cross-functional partners and mapped to overall business objectives.
- Work closely with teams, such as Public Policy and CSR, to develop and implement strategic communications plans that amplify how TikTok is enabling progress for businesses and communities.
- Lead and develop a high-performing team, while fostering a culture of excellence, accountability, and continuous development.
Qualifications
Minimum Qualifications:
- Extensive communications experience and a deep knowledge of consumer, business, and trade/vertical media in the region.
- Able to diplomatically handle change and exhibit sound judgment.
- Demonstrated experience in influencing stakeholders, resolving complex problems and ensuring collaboration within teams and across cross-functional disciplines.
- Proven ability to mentor and inspire high-performing teams across multiple geographies in region.
- Excellent strategic, analytical, and verbal communication skills.
- Previous experience working for a global company is strongly preferred.
- Must be fluent in English & Portuguese. Given the regional LATAM scope, Spanish would be a plus.
About ByteDance Brazil
ByteDance is a global incubator of platforms at the cutting edge of commerce, content, entertainment, and enterprise services - over 2.5 billion people interact with ByteDance products, including TikTok.

Why Join Us
Inspiring creativity is at the core of TikTok's mission. Our innovative product is built to help people authentically express themselves, discover and connect – and our global, diverse teams make that possible. Together, we create value for our communities, inspire creativity and bring joy - a mission we work towards every day.
We strive to do great things with great people. We lead with curiosity, humility, and a desire to make impact in a rapidly growing tech company. Every challenge is an opportunity to learn and innovate as one team. We're resilient and embrace challenges as they come. By constantly iterating and fostering an "Always Day 1" mindset, we achieve meaningful breakthroughs for ourselves, our company, and our users. When we create and grow together, the possibilities are limitless. Join us.
Diversity & Inclusion
TikTok is committed to creating an inclusive space where employees are valued for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. Our platform connects people from across the globe and so does our workplace. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. To achieve that goal, we are committed to celebrating our diverse voices and to creating an environment that reflects the many communities we reach. We are passionate about this and hope you are too.

description:
Why join us

TRACTIAN is transforming the industrial world by empowering frontline maintenance workers to achieve more. We’ve fused cutting-edge hardware with innovative software into one powerful platform, disrupting legacy systems and delivering smarter, faster solutions for our clients.

At TRACTIAN, you'll break boundaries, question convention, and collaborate with top talent to drive real change. As a part of our growth-stage startup, you’ll work alongside the founders, shaping the vision, products, and experiences that will define the future of industrial tech.

Sales at TRACTIAN

The Sales team is the driving factor behind revenue at Tractian. We focus on generating new opportunities, acquiring new customers, and building even stronger relationships with our current accounts. Our Enterprise customers are comprised of Fortune 500 companies, such as Hyundai, Bosch, Unilever, P&G, PepsiCo, and others. Tractian's Net Revenue Retention (NRR) is as big as Silicon Valley startups, such as Snowflake (158%) and Twilio (155%), which highlights the stickiness of our products. We make sure that top performers are recognized and over-beating quota.

What you'll do

As a Sales Engineer for TracOS at Tractian, you will be instrumental in driving the sales and adoption of our TracOS software in various industries. Your role will be to leverage your extensive technical expertise in software solutions, particularly in B2B environments, to demonstrate the unique capabilities and benefits of TracOS to potential clients. Using HubSpot CRM, you will manage the entire sales cycle, from lead generation to deal closure, ensuring alignment with our company’s growth targets and client satisfaction.

  • Conduct in-depth analysis of client needs and tailor presentations of TracOS to showcase its benefits and applicability.

  • Collaborate closely with the technical team to understand product updates and integrations, enhancing your sales presentations and demonstrations.
  • Develop and maintain strong relationships with key decision-makers in target industries, understanding their challenges and how TracOS can address them.
  • Provide expert responses to technical queries and concerns during the sales process.
  • Keep abreast of industry trends and competitor activities, adjusting sales strategies accordingly.
  • Act as a liaison between clients and the product team to relay feedback and contribute to product development.
,

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Engineering, IT, Computer Science, or a related field.
  • 5+ years of proven experience in sales engineering, preferably with software or IT solutions.

  • Strong proficiency in using HubSpot CRM for sales process management.
  • Demonstrated track record of meeting or exceeding sales targets.
  • Excellent negotiation, communication, and presentation skills.
  • Ability to travel as required for client meetings and product demonstrations.
,

Bonus Points

  • Experience with SaaS and SAP, Oracle and ERP technologies.
  • Advanced technical or sales certifications.
  • Fluent in English.

  • Competitive salary and stock options

  • Health plan with national coverage and without coparticipation

As a GTM Enablement Business Partner for EBU Sales in LATAM, you will partner closely with sales leaders, frontline managers, and cross-functional teams to identify performance gaps, deliver targeted enablement programs, and reinforce critical selling or support behaviors. You will act as a key business partner to a sales or customer success leader of an assigned region or segment. In this role, you will help develop the GTM enablement strategy aligned with the business priorities, OKRs and local needs of your GTM stakeholders. This person will own the strategic end-to-end enablement plan and calendar, to design, deliver and track enablement programs to accelerate talent development across products, industry or segment knowledge, and role-based competencies, that lead to better customer conversations and revenue growth.
This position is an individual contributor reporting to Sr. Director, NA/LATAM GTM Enablement Business Partners and Trainer.
Responsibility

  • Partner with sales and GTM leadership to understand strategic objectives, business goals, priorities, and performance targets
  • Translate strategic objectives into quarterly enablement plans that address skill, process, and execution gaps
  • Collaborate with regional sales leaders and frontline managers to identify specific team or individual performance gaps
  • Build and execute customized enablement plans (where needed) tied to performance outcomes, not just learning completion
  • Coach frontline managers on how to drive and reinforce performance within their teams
  • Serve as the main enablement point of contact for the GTM team you support
  • Design and deliver targeted training programs for GTM teams (AEs, CSMs, SEs) based on business needs
  • Facilitate live and virtual training sessions, deal clinics, role plays, and workshops focused on skill development (e.g., discovery, negotiation, objection handling, value selling, adoption amp; renewal)
  • Reinforce adoption of sales methodologies (e.g., MEDDICC, Challenger, SPICED), internal processes and tools (e.g., Gong, Highspot, Salesforce) your stakeholders use to do their jobs
  • Create and deliver big deal management courses to elevate the skill set of our Enterprise teams to engage, educate, influence and close larger Enterprise deals
  • Act as a strategic feedback loop to the Enablement, Product, and GTM Ops teams by sharing insights from the field
  • Recommend and iterate on enablement programs (even onboarding) based on performance data, rep feedback, and market changes
  • Collaborate with Enablement Operations and Ops analytics teams to track impact of enablement initiatives on KPIs (e.g., win rate, pipeline coverage, deal velocity)
  • Partner with Global Enablement Program Managers, product marketing, product, and GTM operations to ensure GTM initiatives are supported with enablement programs that drive execution
  • Work with your global enablement program manager to build any enablement plans or programs as well help prioritize content creation for the PM, making recommendations and supporting them where needed
  • Collaborate with and share ideas with your fellow Enablement Business Partners to ensure consistency in training on functions in your GTM teams
  • Ensure training is aligned to current product messaging, ICP shifts, and go-to-market motions you support
  • Align with global enablement content teams, product marketing, and ops teams to ensure enablement plans support launches, sales plays, and GTM campaigns

description:
At Franklin Templeton, we’re advancing our industry forward by developing new and innovative ways to help our clients achieve their investment goals. Our dynamic and diversified firm spans asset management, wealth management, and fintech, offering many ways to help investors make progress toward their goals. Our talented teams working around the globe bring expertise that’s both broad and unique. From our welcoming, inclusive, and flexible culture to our global and diverse business, we provide opportunities to help you reach your potential while helping our clients reach theirs.

Come join us in delivering better outcomes for our clients around the world!

This is a HYBRID position, currently requiring 3 days per week in one of our offices.

What is the FTT AI & Digital Transformation Team responsible for?

The FTT AI & Digital Transformation group is a newly established team within Franklin Templeton Technologies, the technology function within Franklin Templeton Investments

What is the Director - Principal Research Scientist – AI & Optimization responsible for?

The core mandate of this role is to bring innovative digital investment products and solutions to market, leveraging a patented and innovative digital WealthTech/FinTech product - Goals Optimization Engine (GOE) - built with several years of academic research in mathematical optimization, probability theory and AI techniques at its core. The mandate also extends to leveraging cutting edge AI, such as Generative AI, in addition to Reactive AI to create value within various business functions within Franklin Templeton such as Investment Solutions, Portfolio Management, Sales & Distribution, Marketing, and HR functions, among others, in a responsible and appropriate manner. The possibilities are limitless here and present a fantastic opportunity for a self-motivated and driven professional to make significant contributions to the organization and to themselves.

What are the ongoing responsibilities of a Director - Principal Research Scientist – AI & Optimization?

As a Principal Research Scientist - AI and Optimization, you will play a pivotal role in driving innovation, product research, and proof of concepts for our AI research and Goals Optimization Engine (GOE) product roadmap. You will be responsible for mentoring and guiding a team of highly motivated research scientists, creating intellectual property, and ensuring successful client deployments and product development.

Key Responsibilities:

Innovation, Product Research, Proof of Concepts, Pseudocode & Design (40%):

  • Lead and contribute to the multi-year Goals Optimization Engine (GOE) product roadmap, conceptualizing fitment against various industry use cases, creating product variants, and designing new features and enhancements across multiple distribution lines and geographies

  • Mentor and guide a team of research scientists to achieve common objectives

  • Serve as the Subject Matter Expert (SME) for a specific domain within AI and/or Optimization, acting as the go-to person for all internal stakeholders

  • Develop pseudocode and working prototypes in a Python environment, collaborating closely with Product Managers and Product Developers

  • Create well-articulated design documents and presentations to explain research to internal and external stakeholders, including clients and partners located globally

  • Lead industry research and evaluate partnerships with third-party vendors and specialized service providers where appropriate

  • Maintain a thorough understanding of boundary conditions, regulatory environments, data challenges, technology integrations, algorithmic dependencies, and operational process nuances to ensure nothing slips through the cracks

  • Stay up to date with the latest developments in the Investment Management industry, Financial Mathematics, Portfolio Construction, and Portfolio Management

IP Creation, Paper Writing, and Thought Leadership (30%):

  • Conceptualize and produce high-quality intellectual property for publication in top-tier academic and practitioner journals

  • Peer-review the work of other research scientists and improve the outcome of their research output

  • Create patent-worthy intellectual content, apply for patents, and win them

  • Take responsibility for winning industry awards for exceptional product research and innovative work products

  • Stay informed about the latest industry research and evaluate it objectively and in an unbiased manner

  • Publish research works for conferences

Client Deployment, Product Development, and Vendor Due Diligence (30%):

  • Act as the SME in initial client deployment discussions, showcasing the rigor of research, explaining the product or solution concept, and engaging in discussions with similar individuals/teams from the client/partner side

  • Contribute to product development by ensuring alignment with research and design

  • Provide hands-on support where required to complete time-critical work successfully

  • Engage with third-party vendors and potential integration partners to understand their capabilities, methodologies, and algorithms, and perform rigorous due diligence to make clear recommendations on Go/No-Go decisions

What ideal qualifications, skills & experience would help someone to be successful?

Education:

  • Bachelor's and Master's degree in STEM disciplines; a PhD in a relevant discipline (Optimization, Probability, Quant Finance, AI & ML, Computational Mathematics, Statistics, etc.) would be a +

  • Relevant industry certifications

Experience - Core Skills:

  • 10+ years of applied R &D experience in research departments of reputed organizations post-Masters or PhD

  • Track record of real innovation generating impact is essential

  • Demonstrated ability to create intellectual content, publish papers, and obtain patents

  • Ability to effectively bridge the gap between academia and practice, ensuring research is practical and implementable

  • Structured thinking and exceptional mathematical skills

  • Excellent team player with the ability to work with ambiguity and thrive in chaos

  • Familiarity with ML/DL/DRL, NLP, especially Large Language Models, dynamic programming, and/or convex optimization

  • Solid experience with AWS and/or Azure

  • Familiar with Python, PySpark, SQL, Hadoop, C++

Experience - Other Soft Skills:

  • Proven ability to take initiative and work under pressure in a changing, fast paced environment

  • Exceptional decision-making skills, with the ability to prioritize across needs given limited resources

  • Thrives in a startup-like environment: loves dealing with a fast pace and changing needs

  • Ability to build relationships both inside and outside of the product organization

  • Ability to narrate a story for a problem along with the capacity to dive into minute details

  • Superlative communication and consensus-building skills

  • Conduzir reuniões, formações e momentos de alinhamento com amor, escuta ativa e autoridade espiritual e técnica.
  • Mediar conflitos e demandas com as famílias, mantendo postura cristã, acolhedora e resolutiva.
  • Estimular a excelência acadêmica integrada ao desenvolvimento de caráter.
  • Monitorar e analisar os resultados pedagógicos da escola com intencionalidade e visão de futuro.

Competências Comportamentais Esperadas

  • Amor a Deus e compromisso com os valores cristãos
  • Liderança empática e firme, com espírito de serviço
  • Comunicação acolhedora, clara e respeitosa
  • Visão estratégica, organização e planejamento
  • Habilidade para formar, motivar e inspirar a equipe docente

Competências Técnicas Necessárias

  • Licenciatura em Pedagogia (obrigatório)
  • Conhecimento da BNCC e diretrizes para Educação Infantil e Fundamental
  • Experiência anterior em coordenação pedagógica

  • Facilidade com tecnologias educacionais e sistemas de gestão escolar

Diferenciais Valorizados

  • Experiência com a AEP (Abordagem Educacional por Princípios)
  • Vivência com escolas cristãs ou confessionais
  • Conhecimento prático dos 7 princípios bíblicos : Caráter, Mordomia, Semeadura e Colheita, Individualidade, Autogoverno, Aliança e Soberania
  • Experiência com metodologias ativas e avaliação formativa
  • Residir na zona leste de São Paulo

Your Wellbeing Matters. Join a Company That Cares.

Strong strategic negotiation skills and the ability to establish relationships with key partners are essential to optimize margins and ensure business sustainability.

25WD85914

Position Overview

The Technical Sales Specialist will be responsible for leading and presenting all technical sales aspects of an Autodesk sales cycle. Technical Specialists partner with Autodesk sales teams and authorized resellers to assist in the development, management, and execution of strategies and tactics for closing business. They meet with individuals at all levels within a customer’s organization to understand their issues and position solutions while discovering business opportunities for Autodesk.

Responsibilities

  • Perform in-depth assessments of customer processes
  • Investigate, uncover, and understand the customer’s business issues
  • Utilize knowledge of business trends, technology, and industry changes to identify areas of opportunity for customer process improvement
  • Capture metrics for quantifying and justifying the customer’s return on investment (ROI) for technical closure
  • Propose solutions and product overviews that relate to the customer’s business issues
  • Develop and conduct professional presentations and demonstrations, leading sales discussions with customers to generate sales of Autodesk solutions
  • Position and sell Autodesk’s unique business values in competitive sales situations against other vendors
  • Conduct presentations, demonstrations, and discussions in-person, web-based, or via different mechanisms
  • Influence product development and product direction through customer feedback and identified business opportunities
  • Develop long-term customer relationships and achieve customer success goals
  • Maintain and grow respected, trusted advisor relationships with customers and members of the Autodesk sales team involved with the opportunity
  • Work with sales teams that support both direct sales and reseller sales channels
  • Partner with sales representatives to assist in the development, management, and execution of strategies and tactics for closing business
  • Support the success of Autodesk resellers by mentoring and training reseller personnel on technical sales activities and execution
  • Support internal sales and team learning through the creation of sales content
  • Participate in company-sponsored events and tradeshows to promote Autodesk’s solutions and the customer business issues they target

Minimum Qualifications

  • 2-5 years of relevant AEC industry experience
  • Competence in Revit, Civil 3D, BIM (Building Information Modeling), Virtual BIM Collaboration, preferred ACC
  • Languages: Native Portuguese, Fluent English
  • Preferred: Engineering, Architecture background

About Autodesk
Welcome to Autodesk! Amazing things are created every day with our software – from the greenest buildings and cleanest cars to the smartest factories and biggest hit movies. We help innovators turn their ideas into reality, transforming not only how things are made, but what can be made.

We take great pride in our culture here at Autodesk – our Culture Code is at the core of everything we do. Our values and ways of working help our people thrive and realize their potential, which leads to even better outcomes for our customers.

When you’re an Autodesker, you can be your whole, authentic self and do meaningful work that helps build a better future for all. Ready to shape the world and your future? Join us!

Salary transparency

Salary is one part of Autodesk’s competitive compensation package. Offers are based on the candidate’s experience and geographic location. In addition to base salaries, we also have a significant emphasis on discretionary annual cash bonuses, commissions for sales roles, stock or long-term incentive cash grants, and a comprehensive benefits package.

Sales Careers

Working in sales at Autodesk allows you to build meaningful relationships with customers while growing your career. Join us and help make a better, more sustainable world.

Diversity & Belonging
We take pride in cultivating a culture of belonging and an equitable workplace where everyone can thrive.

This role will also involve collaboration with the business and legal teams from the United States, other Latin American countries, and Europe. We provide strategic support for satellite telecommunications operations. Conhecimento em análise financeira e controle orçamentário.

Capacidade de liderança e gestão de equipes multidisciplinares.

title: Software Engineering Manager - Sustaining Engineering
description:
Software Engineering Manager - Sustaining Engineering

Join to apply for the Software Engineering Manager - Sustaining Engineering role at Canonical .

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is widely used in enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include major public cloud and silicon providers, as well as industry leaders across sectors. The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

We are hiring a Software Engineering Manager for Sustaining Engineering, passionate about open source software, Linux, and cloud computing. This role involves leading a regional team, supporting continuous improvement of open source software by resolving customer-reported defects across the software stack, from kernel to user space applications and IaaS platforms. The team is well-resourced to ensure work-life balance and professional development.

Your primary responsibilities include supporting your team’s growth, technical leadership, influencing culture, and collaborating on strategy and execution.

Location:

This is a globally remote role unless otherwise specified.

Key Responsibilities:

  1. Manage and lead a distributed engineering team.
  2. Hire, coach, mentor, and provide career development guidance.
  3. Manage KPIs and training initiatives.
  4. Support timely delivery of bug fixes, patches, and technical solutions across various technologies including Ubuntu, OpenStack, Ceph, Kubernetes, Juju, and MAAS.
  5. Represent Canonical positively in customer interactions.
  6. Set expectations with other teams, management, and external stakeholders.
  7. Promote modern software development practices.
  8. Foster a healthy, collaborative engineering culture aligned with company values.
  9. Collaborate with other organizational teams.
  10. Work remotely with up to 10% travel for internal and external events.

Qualifications:

  • Experience in software delivery using C, C++, Go, Python, or similar.
  • Passion for software development.
  • Leadership experience in complex problem resolution and bug fixes.
  • Experience with version control systems like git.
  • Proficiency with debugging tools such as gdb or crash.
  • Strong commitment to testing methodologies and maintainable code.
  • Excellent English communication skills.
  • Experience with Linux, preferably Ubuntu.
  • Knowledge of Open Source and its business models.
  • People management experience in support organizations is a plus.

What We Offer:

  • Distributed work environment with biannual in-person team sprints.
  • USD 2,000 annual learning and development budget.
  • Annual compensation review and recognition rewards.
  • Generous leave policies, including maternity and paternity leave.
  • Employee Assistance Programme.
  • Travel opportunities to meet colleagues.
  • Travel upgrades for company events.

About Canonical:

Canonical is at the forefront of open source innovation, publishing Ubuntu, a key platform for AI, IoT, and cloud. We hire globally and uphold high standards of excellence. Working remotely since 2004, we promote a forward-thinking, inclusive workplace.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer, committed to diversity and fairness in hiring.

O modelo Buurtzorg é uma filosofia que prioriza o cuidado comunitário, respeitando a individualidade de cada pessoa. A Laços Saúde está pronta para receber você!

title: Coordenador(a) de Suprimentos
description:
Você conhece a LDC?
A LDC é uma das principais comercializadoras e processadoras global de produtos agrícolas, com um portfólio diversificado, que abrange toda a cadeia de valor, da originação à distribuição. Com atividades no centro da produção agrícola e de alimentos e guiados pelos nossos fortes valores, por um legado rico e uma visão clara, estamos comprometidos em trabalhar por um futuro seguro e sustentável. Ajudamos a alimentar e vestir cerca de 500 milhões de pessoas todos os anos, originando, processando e transportando aproximadamente 81 milhões de toneladas de produtos. Estruturada como uma organização matricial de 6 regiões geográficas e 10 plataformas, a LDC está ativa em mais de 100 países e emprega cerca de 15.000 pessoas em todo o mundo. Somos guiados por valores que norteiam todos os públicos em nosso trabalho. A ética e integridade fazem parte de todas as relações de negócio, assim como a humildade, comprometimento e diversidade.

Descrição da vaga

  • Distribuir as demandas entre o time;
  • Coordenar e desenvolver time com foco em alta performance;
  • Performar análise da categoria, fornecedores, itens e cenários (TCO, should cost, etc);
  • Participação ativa no processo de planejamento e orçamento da categoria em parceria com os requisitantes;
  • Compreender profundamente as necessidades do negócio;
  • Identificar alavancas de redução de custo;
  • Definir SLA’s claros e mensuráveis para os contratos;

Qualificações

  • Experiência com soluções logísticas;
  • Saber fazer análise técnica de suprimentos, TCO, strategic sourcing, alavancas de custos;
  • Experiência prévia em cargo de liderança;
  • Habilidade para negociação e influência com os compradores da categoria;
  • Habilidade de resolver problemas simples e complexos;
  • Autonomia para executar tarefas em colaboração com os principais stakeholders;
  • Capacidade de trabalhar sob pressão e gerenciar conflitos.

Informações adicionais

  • Superior completo em Logística ou áreas correlatas;
  • Inglês avançado.

Diversidade, Inclusão e Equidade

A diversidade é parte do nosso DNA. A LDC busca sempre criar um ambiente de trabalho diversificado e inclusivo, onde todas as pessoas possam prosperar. Respeitamos e valorizamos talentos de todos os gêneros, idades, raças, etnias, sexualidades, religiões e deficiências. Diversidade é um de nossos valores! Essa oportunidade destina-se também às pessoas com deficiências (PcD).

Sustentabilidade

O valor sustentável está no centro de nosso propósito como empresa. Somos apaixonados pela criação de valor justo e sustentável, tanto para nossos negócios quanto para outros stakeholders da cadeia de valor: nosso pessoal, nossos parceiros comerciais, as comunidades e o meio ambiente ao nosso redor.

title: Groepsbegeleider flexpool - Perspectiefhuis Nieuwegein
description:
Wil je werken wanneer het jou uitkomt? Help jij graag kwetsbare jongeren op weg naar een stabiele en kansrijke toekomst? En vind je het mooi om hen te ondersteunen in hun dagelijkse leven? Lees hierover meer over onze actuele vacature groepsbegeleider op het Perspectiefhuis - flexpool in Nieuwegein.

PerspectiefHuis Nieuwegein is een plek voor jongeren tussen de 14 en 18 jaar die hulp nodig hebben en niet meer thuis kunnen wonen. Zij leren hier verantwoordelijkheid te nemen en om zelfstandig dingen te regelen en te ondernemen. Stap voor stap gaan we op weg naar volledig zelfstandig wonen. Je werkt volgens een 24-uurs roosterplanning en werkt dus ook ‘s avonds, ’s nachts en in de weekenden. Je werkt in ieder geval twee diensten per week van 15:00-23:00 en de verdere uren worden wisselend aangevuld met dag- en slaapdiensten.

Daadkrachtig, empathisch en hoopvol

Soms kan een jongere niet meer thuis wonen. Is zelfstandig wonen een brug te ver, vanwege complexe problematiek? Dan biedt Timon een veilige woonplek in een 24-uurs voorziening. Hier werken jongeren aan herstel en aan hun toekomst. Als groepsbegeleider begeleid je hen in het dagelijkse leven. Ze kunnen op jou rekenen. Je geeft hen een goede basis, structuur en handvatten om hun leven op de rit te krijgen. Dat vraagt om daadkracht, empathie en vasthoudendheid. Je bent sociaal vaardig en hebt een sterke persoonlijkheid. Want je maakt nogal eens wat mee.

Jouw werk doet ertoe!

Als groepsbegeleider ben je er voor de jongeren. Je zorgt voor huiselijkheid. En helpt hen bij wat ze lastig vinden: van huiswerk en koken tot vriendschappen. Je stimuleert hen, met de persoonlijke doelen voor ogen. De mentor stelt deze doelen op voor iedere jongere, in afstemming met jou. Als het moet, trap je op de rem. Als groepsbegeleider leef je het normale leven voor aan de jongeren. Houd er rekening mee dat je ook administratieve taken hebt. Het doel van jouw werk? Dat de jongere veiligheid en nabijheid ervaart en zich van daaruit ontwikkelt. Kortom, jouw werk doet ertoe!

Dit ga je doen

  • Je stelt concrete doelen en werkpunten op voor je dienst.
  • Je monitort de ontwikkeling in de vastgestelde doelen en rapporteert daar op.
  • Je voert de dagelijkse doelen uit en ziet erop toe dat die gebeuren.
  • Overleg en intervisie met de werkbegeleiders en het team en je gedragswetenschapper.

“Je hebt veel vrijheid om je diensten in te vullen. In het contact met de jongeren signaleer je wat een jongere nodig heeft en stem je af wat nodig is”

Linda van Oorschot, jeugdzorgwerker D

Dit vragen we van je
Als groepsbegeleider sta je stevig in je schoenen, ook in uitdagende situaties. Je kunt je eigen grenzen goed aangeven. Daarnaast beschik je over:
  • Mbo-diploma niveau 4, bijvoorbeeld SPW.
  • Of een startende hbo-er met een Social Work-diploma;
  • Ervaring met competentiegericht werken, verbindend gezag en/of geweldloos verzet;
  • Kennis van en inzicht in groepsdynamische processen;
  • Flexibele inzetbaarheid (onregelmatige diensten, ook slaapdiensten).
Dit bieden wij
Op basis van een 36-urige werkweek kun je rekenen op:
  • Een bruto maandsalaris volgens de cao Jeugdzorg (schaal 7) vanaf € 2.818,26 tot € 4.027,70, afhankelijk van je kennis en ervaring.
  • Een jaarcontract voor 32 tot 36 uur per week. Functioneer je goed? Dan zetten we dat om in een vast dienstverband.
  • 25 vakantiedagen, 8% vakantiegeld, onregelmatigheidstoeslag en reiskostenvergoeding.
  • Een eindejaarsuitkering van 8,3% van je bruto jaarsalaris.
  • Een eigen coach die je helpt met je persoonlijke doelstellingen en ontwikkeling.
Binnen Timon krijg je een uitgebreid inwerktraject waarin we je koppelen aan een buddy. Daarnaast volg je diverse trainingen en opleidingen gericht op jouw functie zoals: Competentiegericht werken & Verbindend Gezag, Motiverende gespreksvoering & Oplossingsgericht werken, Open & Alert.
Deze functie noemen we in ons functiehuis Jeugdzorgwerker D.
Wij zijn Timon
Je christelijke geloof verbinden met je professionele inzet? Dat kan bij Timon! Bij ons ben je er voor kinderen, jongeren en ouders. En ons team is er voor jóu. Iedereen kan een beroep op ons doen, ongeacht achtergrond en levensovertuiging. Met ruim 800 bevlogen medewerkers werken we in een groot deel van Nederland. Timon innoveert en groeit. We denken in kansen en zetten graag een stapje extra.
Jij @ Timon?
Denk jij dat Timon de organisatie is die bij jou past? Solliciteer dan op de vacature voor groepsbegeleider. Heb je inhoudelijke vragen? Neem dan contact op met Carolien Schrauwen op 06-81874724. Heb je vragen over de procedure? Neem dan contact op met onze recruiter.
Voor indiensttreding is het screeningsbeleid van Timon van toepassing. Deze is altijd opvraagbaar en wordt toegelicht in het arbeidsvoorwaardengesprek. #J-18808-Ljbffr

description:
Heidrick & Struggles (Nasdaq: HSII) is the world’s foremost advisor on executive leadership, driving superior client performance through premier human capital leadership advisory services. For more than 70 years, we’ve delivered value for our clients by leveraging unrivaled expertise to help organizations discover and enable outstanding leaders and teams. Learn more at

Job Description:

Heidrick & Struggles is a premier provider of global leadership advisory, serving the senior-level talent and consulting needs of the world's top organizations. In our role as trusted leadership advisors, we partner with our clients to develop future-ready leaders and organizations, bringing together our services and offerings in executive search, diversity and inclusion, leadership assessment and development, organization and team acceleration.

Heidrick Consulting Brazil

You would be part of our Consulting Practice in Brazil. At Heidrick Consulting, we work with Senior Leadership, Executive Teams, and Boards, covering major national and multi-national companies across all industry sectors in Brazil and Latin America.

You will be joining a growing, dynamic team, and in this role as a Consultant, you will continue to learn and deepen your consulting skills by working on various projects. Your contributions will expose you to senior leaders across a variety of industries and geographies.

Primary Responsibilities

The main purpose of the Consultant is to develop consulting solutions as part of client engagements, to write proposals and support business development activities, to act as engagement manager on specific projects and to support Principals and Partners in their delivery.

You will begin to lead, manage, and own problem-solving efforts on a large portion of a client engagement or to lead on smaller engagements. Specifically, you will be responsible for identifying issues, forming hypotheses, designing and conducting analysis, and then synthesizing conclusions into recommendations. Throughout an engagement, you will be involved in discussions and presentations with senior client leadership.

Role Responsibilities:

  • Gathering, analyzing and interpreting data and information; generating insights from analyses.
  • Preparing and presenting information and insights in an impactful and compelling way to help drive client insights and engagement delivery.
  • Delivering a range of consulting solutions, preparing reports and other deliverables that meet client needs.
  • Facilitating and working with client teams with a client first mindset, managing and designing client sessions.
  • Ensuring work is “client ready” (e.g., error free, aligned with expectations, ready to be shared with client) and actively managing expectations with the team.
  • Planning and prioritizing work ensuring team deadlines and quality standards are met.
  • Contributing to proposals (e.g., supporting content development of project design and approaches and case studies) and mobilizing ‘won’ initiatives.
  • Building and sharing reusable, client ready materials, insights (including case studies) and project learnings.
  • Building and maintaining relationships with colleagues across Heidrick & Struggles in Brazil and globally.
  • Contributing to thought leadership and supporting the development of product, tools, and methodologies.
  • Involving yourself in internal initiatives, supporting ongoing improvements of business and employee experience; many initiatives are global and will provide an opportunity to build a global network.

The Ideal Candidate:

Passionate and Engaged: Will bring a genuine enthusiasm for serving a broad variety of organizations on strategic people and talent topics, including leadership and team development, succession planning, Board effectiveness and organizational culture change.

Self-Driven and Inquisitive: Exhibits a strong desire to continuously learn and explore new topics relevant to client organizations and industry sectors.

Entrepreneurial Spirit and Team Player: Possesses an entrepreneurial mindset with a keen interest in contributing to a growing business unit. Brings innovative ideas and a proactive approach to delivering on agreed deadlines and client deliverables.

Minimum Role Qualifications

  • 2-4 years of professional work experience, with a minimum of 2 years in a management, strategy or leadership consulting environment.
  • An undergraduate degree is required.
  • Experience working directly with clients in a professional service, team-based environment.
  • Ability to drive workload independently within a broader team project setting.
  • Ability to manage time effectively, being comfortable with handling multiple priorities and being able to adapt to changing business needs.
  • Demonstrated advanced proficiency in PowerPoint, Excel and Word; easily able to adopt new technologies and software.
  • Excellent communication skills; writing skills with a proven track record of success preparing concise and compelling reports and other client ready deliverables.
  • Ability to communicate, both verbally and in writing, in English and Portuguese. Other languages are a plus.
  • Willingness to travel locally and globally as required.

title: Software Engineering Manager, Search
description:
Join to apply for the Software Engineering Manager II, Search role at Google .

Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

Please submit your resume in English - we can only consider applications submitted in this language.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 8 years of experience with software development in one or more programming languages (e.g., Python, C, C++, Java, JavaScript).
  • 3 years of experience in a technical leadership role; overseeing projects, with 2 years of experience in a people management, supervision/team leadership role.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science or related technical field.
  • 3 years of experience working in a complex, matrixed organization.
  • 3 years of experience in a technical leadership role; overseeing projects and managing SWEs.

About The Job

Like Google's own ambitions, the work of a Software Engineer goes beyond just Search. Software Engineering Managers have not only the technical expertise to take on and provide technical leadership to major projects, but also manage a team of Engineers. You not only optimize your own code but make sure Engineers are able to optimize theirs. As a Software Engineering Manager, you manage your project goals, contribute to product strategy, and help develop your team. Teams work across various domains such as information retrieval, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking, security, data compression, and user interface design.

Operating at scale and speed, our software engineers are just getting started — and as a manager, you guide the way.

With technical and leadership expertise, you manage engineers across multiple teams and locations, oversee a large product budget, and deploy large-scale projects internationally.

In Google Search, we're reimagining how to search for information—any way and anywhere. To do that, we need to solve complex engineering challenges and expand our infrastructure, maintaining an accessible and useful experience for billions worldwide. Joining the Search team offers an opportunity to make a global impact.

Our client is a prominent Chinese infrastructure investor and operator with a growing international portfolio focused on renewable energy and energy transition assets.   • Lead stakeholder engagement with local partners, regulatory bodies, and internal investment committees

  • Monitor asset performance and financial KPIs post-investment, providing regular reporting to senior leadership

  • Support corporate strategy development and market intelligence initiatives within the Latin American renewables market

Candidate Requirements

  • Proven track record of managing infrastructure or renewable energy investments, ideally within a global or cross-border context

  • In-depth knowledge of solar PV and BESS technologies and related commercial models

  • Strong background in cost management, budgeting, and financial analysis

  • Previous experience working within or alongside Chinese infrastructure or energy investors is an advantage

  • Fluent in English; Portuguese and/or Mandarin proficiency is desirable

  • Based in Brazil or willing to relocate

Why Apply?

This is a unique opportunity to join a globally recognised investor with long-term ambitions in Latin America. The successful candidate will play a strategic role in shaping the direction of clean energy infrastructure in one of the world’s most dynamic renewable markets.

Realizar todo atendimento de enfermagem pertinente ao nível técnico conforme preconizado pelo conselho de enfermagem. Administrar a aplicação de procedimentos e medicamentos, conforme prescrição médica, zelando pela adequada assistência ao paciente.

Efetuar o recebimento e passagem de plantão, observando o livro de ocorrências e leitura das prescrições médicas.

Promover um ambiente de acolhimento e dar assistência humanizada aos pacientes, às famílias, acompanhantes e visitantes de acordo com a necessidade de cada paciente ou da área.

Manter o setor organizado, funcional, higienizado e harmônico em tempo integral, acionando as áreas de suporte que se fizerem necessárias, tais como higienização, manutenção, engenharia clínica, hotelaria, entre outras.

Diariamente efetuar os registros de evolução e acompanhamento de enfermagem de cada paciente sob sua responsabilidade, em sistema próprio de prontuários, orientar e garantir que todos os demais técnicos (médicos, técnicos, auxiliares e equipe multi) da área também o façam.

Seguir as orientações previstas nos Protocolos Operacionais Padrão (POP) da área e aplicá-los em suas atividades, observando para que os demais colaboradores da equipe também os apliquem.

Efetuar o controle de estoque mínimo de materiais e medicamentos da sala de gesso para que não falte nenhum material durante o procedimento.

Anotar na folha de controle, na sala de procedimento, todos os materiais utilizados no serviço e/ou lançar em sistema conforme orientado.

Confeccionar e retirar aparelhos gessados e enfaixamentos com o uso do material convencional e sintético.

Executar imobilizações com uso de esparadrapo e talas digitais e outros recursos disponíveis de acordo com a comorbidade do paciente.

Preparar e executar trações cutâneas, auxiliar o médico ortopedista na instalação de trações esqueléticas e nas manobras de redução manual.

Preparar sala de pequenos procedimentos, fora do centro cirúrgico, com anestesia local, para pequenas suturas, retiradas de corpo estranho, punções, infiltrações e manobras de redução manual.

Efetuar o preparo e administração de medicação (via oral, endovenosa, intravenosa, intramuscular, subcutânea ou via retal).

Prestar assistência acompanhando procedimentos médicos.

Realizar curativos em pacientes com a técnica e material adequado à ferida.

Encaminhar pacientes para exames de imagens, laboratório e internação, conforme solicitação prescrita ou orientada.

Solicitar e fazer a troca de materiais quebrados ou danificados, tão logo observe a necessidade.

Organizar e efetuar a higienização de materiais do setor e limpeza do expurgo do setor.

Arrumar e trocar as camas, macas do repouso e consultórios, mantendo o setor organizado e higienizado.

Conferir carrinho de emergência semanalmente e teste do cardioversor diariamente.

Promover ambiente de acolhimento aos acompanhantes e familiares.

Executar outras atividades correlatas, de acordo com as atribuições próprias de sua unidade operacional e da natureza do seu trabalho, conforme determinação superior.

description:
Talent Acquisition Lead (Brazil, Peru or Ireland)

About DA

Delivery Associates (DA) is a global consultancy helping the public sector deliver lasting impact through effective implementation. With roots in Deliverology and over a decade of experience, we support leaders from strategy to execution. Our remote team works worldwide with governments and philanthropies to scale results.

We’re committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion—believing empowered, diverse teams drive stronger partnerships and more equitable outcomes.

Description

We are seeking a hands-on and proactive Talent Acquisition Lead to join our People team. This role is ideal for someone with some managerial experience, capable of leading a small team while delivering on core responsibilities within the Talent Acquisition function. The successful candidate is highly organised, detail-oriented, and comfortable managing their own workload alongside supporting the development and performance of others. They will serve as a Performance Manager to a small number of colleagues and play a key role in driving team collaboration and delivery.

While this is not a senior leadership role, we are looking for someone who has previously managed people and can confidently provide guidance, feedback, and support in a team setting. This role is fully remote, but the candidate should be based in Brazil, Peru or Ireland.

Key Responsibilities

People Leadership and team support:

  • Coach and mentor team members, providing constructive feedback to enhance their skills and capabilities.
  • Set clear objectives for team members, regularly reviewing progress and performance metrics to drive professional growth.
  • Represent the TA team as part of the wider People Team.
  • Act as a bridge between the TA team and senior leadership, facilitating effective communication and collaboration.
  • Contribute to a collaborative, high-performing, and accountable team culture.

Requisition Ownership:

  • Manage a portfolio of open roles across multiple functions and regions.
  • Lead end-to-end recruitment, including job briefings, sourcing, candidate assessment, and offer processes.
  • Partner with hiring managers to advise on recruitment strategy, structured interviews, and role scoping.
  • Ensure a high-quality candidate and hiring manager experience throughout.

Communication, Partnering and Stakeholder Management:

  • Collaborate with hiring managers and senior stakeholders to align on hiring needs and recruitment plans.
  • Act as a trusted advisor, offering clear guidance, timely updates, and pragmatic solutions.

Operational Input and process Improvements:

  • Identify operational challenges and areas for process improvement across the recruitment function.
  • Contribute to discussions and proposals to improve team efficiency and candidate experience.
  • Use data to monitor requisition progress, flag risks, and support quarterly reporting.
  • Comfortably handle reporting and data interpretation, using metrics to make informed decisions and drive improvements
  • Maintain accurate records in the applicant tracking system (Greenhouse) and support data-led decision-making.

Core Competencies

We work well with people who demonstrate the following competencies:

  • Execution – Manages requisitions from start to finish with strong attention to detail and follow-through.
  • Communication & Partnering – Builds effective relationships with stakeholders and communicates clearly and professionally.
  • Responsibility & Autonomy – Works independently, takes ownership of tasks, and uses sound judgment to escalate when needed.
  • Team Contribution – Collaborates effectively, shares knowledge, and supports the success of the broader team.
  • People Development – Provides constructive feedback, supports the growth of direct reports, and contributes to a positive performance culture.

Mindsets

We work closely in diverse, global teams, leaning on each other’s strengths. We don’t expect any one person to do all these things perfectly. Our teams are made up of people who are:

  • Adaptable : Able to thrive in a dynamic environment.
  • Proactive: Anticipates needs, takes initiative without waiting for direction, and demonstrates a forward-thinking approach to tasks and challenges.
  • Initiative: Demonstrates a self-starting attitude, actively seeks opportunities to contribute, and pursues improvements without being prompted.
  • Resourceful: Effectively navigates constraints and finds practical solutions to deliver results, even in the absence of ideal conditions.
  • Detail-Oriented: Demonstrates accuracy and thoroughness in all tasks, ensuring clarity, consistency, and high standards of quality.
  • Team-Oriented: Works collaboratively with colleagues, sharing knowledge and contributing to a supportive and effective team environment.
  • Accountable: Takes ownership of responsibilities, follows through on commitments, and consistently delivers reliable outcomes.
  • Inclusive : Embrace all voices and backgrounds to enrich our work.

Required Skills/Experiences:

  • A minimum of 6 years experience as a recruiter for an internal team, ideally in a high volume environment
  • Proven experience in people leadership, coaching, and providing feedback as a team lead or senior individual contributor
  • A proactive, resourceful and agile mindset is essential for this role
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to multitask and prioritize effectively
  • Proficiency in data interpretation and reporting
  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills for partnering with senior leadership
  • Comfortable setting objectives, reviewing progress, and enhancing team performance
  • Previous experience hiring for top-tier consulting firms is desirable but not essential
  • Experience using Greenhouse, Slack and Google Suite
  • Fluent written and spoken English

What we offer:

  • Impactful work : Opportunities to engage with senior leaders and work on transformative projects.
  • Excellent colleagues: We strive to be as talent-dense and diverse as possible, so we are always learning from each other.
  • Growth environment : Everyone’s career pathway is unique-be part of a growing organization committed to continuous improvement.
  • Flexibility : Remote working environment with opportunities for global collaboration.
  • Healthy compensation : Our colleagues enjoy a comprehensive benefits package for the effort they put in.
  • Travel opportunities : Travel may be required depending on project needs.

Our Values:

These values serve as an anchor, enabling us to stay true to who we are and what we stand for.

  • Passion : It is all about impact.
  • Excellence : Delivering to the highest standards.

title: LATAM Cash Operations Lead - Executive Director
description:
The JPMorganChase Commercial & Investment Bank is a global leader across banking, markets, securities services and payments. Corporations, governments and institutions throughout the world entrust us with their business in more than 100 countries. The Commercial & Investment Bank provides strategic advice, raises capital, manages risk and extends liquidity in markets around the world.

Payments Operations (PO) is part of the Digital & Platform Services organization in the Corporate & Investment Bank. PO supports Payments, Liquidity, Merchant Services, Receivables, Trade Finance, Commercial Card, Prepaid Card, and some new products and acts as the payment hub for JPMorgan Chase across the firm’s business lines. PO consists of ~9,000 employees across 60 sites and supports over 140,000 corporations, financial institutions, governments, and municipalities domiciled in over 180 countries.

LATAM Payments Operations processes a daily average of 135 thousand transactions. From 2021 to 2024, our volume increased by 190%, with more than 3.2 thousand active accounts. Revenues from the business in 2024 were USD 732M, and for 2025, the business is forecasting USD 817M. Join us in leading the charge to enhance our payment operations and drive growth across the LATAM region.

We are seeking an experienced Executive Director to Lead Latin America Cash Operations, reporting to the Managing Director of Global Cash Operations.

As a Cash Operations Executive Director you will lead the operational functions related to settling payments within Latin America, where JPM has a significant presence in Argentina, Brazil, Chile, Colombia, and Mexico, as well as in the Buenos Aires Corporate Center. title: Vice President of Research
description:
Why the American University of Iraq—Baghdad?
Opening its doors in January 2021, the new American University of Iraq—Baghdad (AUIB) began as a dream of influential individuals in Iraqi and United States business, industry and government who want to see a world-class institution of higher learning established in the city, reminiscent of the days when Baghdad was an educational mecca and flourishing capital of the Muslim world. With a great library, palatial college buildings and student centers, state-of-the-art classrooms, laboratories, and athletic facilities, AUIB will be a beautiful campus, attracting students, faculty, and staff from throughout the world. We invite you to join us in this exciting new venture.

This position will report directly to the University President

Job Title: Vice President of Research

Department: Office of Research

Job Summary: The Vice President of Research plays a critical leadership role in advancing the research agenda of AUIB. This position is responsible for providing strategic direction, oversight, and coordination of all research activities within the university. The Vice President of Research works closely with faculty, staff, and external partners to promote a culture of research excellence and innovation.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Leadership:

  • Develop and implement a comprehensive research strategy aligned with the university’s mission and goals.
  • Identify emerging research trends and opportunities and guide the university’s research priorities accordingly.
  • Foster a culture of research excellence, integrity, and collaboration across all academic departments and disciplines.

Administration:

  • Oversee the Research Office and all university research operations.
  • Develop university research themes and foster new research initiatives.
  • Delegate regulatory responsibility to appropriate university units.
  • Oversee all research centers, institutes, and appropriate shared or core research facilities.
  • Oversee research partnerships with industry, government, and partner institutions.
  • Represent the university at appropriate research initiatives/collaborations and programs.
  • Represent the university on the appropriate national and international research committees.
  • Communicate and report on the state of the research enterprise.
  • Develop and ensure the maintenance of policies and procedures and fiscal responsibilities for the Research Office and all pre- and post-grant award activities.
  • Ensure university membership in the appropriate professional research associations.
  • Oversee the outstanding faculty and student research awards.

Research Funding And Grants:

  • Identify and pursue external funding opportunities, grants, and partnerships to support research activities.
  • Provide guidance and support to faculty in the preparation and submission of research grant proposals.
  • Oversee the administration of research grants, ensuring compliance with funding agency requirements.

Research Conduct:

Human Research Participants:

  • Ensure the University’s human research participant protection program.
  • Ensure stakeholders and affiliates have adequate resources and appropriate oversight.
  • Receive and assess reports of non-compliance.
  • Place limitations or conditions on an investigator’s or research staff’s privilege to conduct human research.
  • Ensure that University officials cannot approve human research not by one of the Institution’s IRBs.
  • Disallow research approved by the Institution’s IRB or an external IRB.
  • Execute the education and training of personnel in support of an ethical human research participants program.

Animal Subjects:

  • Execute a humane and ethical animal welfare program in compliance with applicable laws, regulations, policies and procedures.
  • Communicate non-compliance to appropriate regulatory bodies.
  • Execute the education and training of personnel in support of humane animal care and use.
  • Establish a university animal care and use committee.

Research Safety and Integrity:

  • Support compliance of all government environmental, health, and safety regulations.
  • Ensure the education and training of personnel in safe research practices.
  • Promote a culture of research integrity.
  • Ensure secure and ethical data use, data confidentiality, and compliant data management, sharing, ownership, and retention practices.
  • Promote compliance for responsible and ethical conduct of research professional development and training requirements.

Patents and Inventions:

  • Promote and support a culture of innovation and entrepreneurship.
  • Oversee policies and procedures on royalties and royalty sharing.
  • Oversee the office of IP.

Research Funding:

  • Ensure high quality and high volume of research applications.
  • Oversee the grant application priorities and submissions.
  • Engage with the government and industry to establish partnerships for sponsored research.

Faculty Support And Development:

  • Collaborate with academic departments to recruit, retain, and support research-active faculty.
  • Promote faculty development in research, including mentoring, training, and facilitating interdisciplinary collaborations.
  • Recognize and reward outstanding research achievements among faculty.
  • Research Infrastructure and Resources:
  • Ensure the availability of state-of-the-art research facilities, equipment, and resources for faculty and students.
  • Manage and allocate research space and resources efficiently.

Application Requirements for Positions at the American University of Iraq—Baghdad:

Required:

To be considered for any role at the American University of Iraq—Baghdad (AUIB), applicants are required to submit the following documents:

  • Cover letter: This should detail how your skills and experience align with the specific requirements of the position you are applying for.
  • Resume/Curriculum Vitae: Please provide an up-to-date resume or CV.
  • Identification: A valid national ID or passport is required for the application process.
  • Please note that applications missing any of these components will not be considered.

Shortlisted Candidates:

If you are shortlisted for an interview, you will need to provide additional documentation:

  • Educational transcripts and certifications must be translated into English.
  • References: You must provide contact details for three references. These individuals should be those who have either worked with you or supervised your work.

We look forward to receiving your complete applications and appreciate your interest in joining our dynamic team at AUIB.

Reporting to the VP Global Alliances and Channels, the Partner Sales Director will be responsible for building trusted relationships with partners, increasing Canonical market share and attach rate, evangelizing about the partnership and leading all business interactions from engineers to CxO level. They will own the strategy, the sell-to, sell-through and sell-with motions with the GSI and will animate many customer workshops, sales events, public presentations and executive engagements.

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

title: Begeleider Crisis Opvang Jeugdzorg
description:
Ondersteun je graag jongeren in hun meest kwetsbare situatie? En sta jij stevig in je schoenen? Kom werken bij Timon. Bekijk de vacature begeleider op onze crisisopvang in Zeist.

Op onze crisisopvang werk je in een kleinschalig-wonen-voorziening (24-uurs). Hier begeleiden we jongens en meiden vanaf 12 jaar. Je werkt aan de hand van een 24-uurs rooster. Je werkt dus ook ’s avonds, ’s nachts en in weekenden. We proberen jongeren succesvol over te plaatsen na circa 4 weken. Soms duurt het langer voordat we een geschikte vervolgplek vinden. Bekijk de video van onze crisisopvang hier .

Sociaal, stabiel en flexibel
Om allerlei redenen kan het spaaklopen in de thuissituatie. Zoals persoonlijkheidsproblematiek, een hechtingsstoornis of een systeemproblematiek. Dat kan zich op allerlei manieren uiten, bijvoorbeeld agressie, misbruik of middelengebruik. Lukt het thuis écht niet meer waardoor een jongere direct uit huis moet? Dan is de crisisopvang een plek waar je terechtkunt. Hier begeleiden we jongens en meiden vanaf 12 jaar. Als jeugdzorgwerker bied je een gestructureerd leefklimaat en begeleid je hen naar een vervolgplek. Dat vraagt van jou dat je sociaal bent, stevig in je schoenen staat én flexibel bent. Je hebt humor en een eindeloos enthousiasme voor jongeren, ook als ze langer in de crisisopvang blijven. Je kunt snel schakelen en blijft rustig onder alle omstandigheden.

Jouw werk doet ertoe
De jongeren hebben allemaal hun eigen kamer, maar ze doen veel samen. Zoals koken en eten, spelletjes en uitjes. Als jeugdzorgwerker bij de crisisopvang Zeist ben je daarom mentor én groepswerker. Je legt makkelijk contact en wint snel het vertrouwen. Je bént er voor de jongeren. Je helpt hen bij wat ze lastig vinden en ondersteunt bij hun taken en doelen. Je voelt spanningen aan en bij lastige situaties treed je de-escalerend op. Je regelt alles rond de crisisplaatsing en de vervolgplek. Stapje voor stapje help je de jongere verder. Kortom, jouw werk doet ertoe!

Dit ga je doen

  • Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de begeleiding van de jongeren;
  • Je werkt 1-op-1 met jongeren én je bent beschikbaar op de groep;
  • Veel vrijheid om je begeleiding vorm te geven, passend bij wat op dat moment nodig is;
  • Je bent contactpersoon voor én tussen ouders/voogden, scholen en andere betrokken instanties.

“In deze uitdagende baan is geen dag hetzelfde. Je mag dichtbij de jongere komen in zijn of haar meest kwetsbare situatie”
Femke, jeugdzorgwerker C crisisopvang

Dit vragen we van je

  • Een relevant hbo-diploma (bijvoorbeeld Social Work of Pedagogiek);
  • Registratie in het beroepsregister SKJ (Stichting Kwaliteitskader Jeugd);
  • Minimaal twee jaar ervaring in de (jeugd)zorg;

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1100+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder led, profitable and growing.
We are hiring a Engineering Manager for Sustaining Engineering passionate about open source software, Linux and cloud computing. Come build a rewarding, meaningful career working with the best and brightest people in technology at Canonical, the growing international software company behind Ubuntu.
Sustaining Engineering is a business critical team that continuously improves various open source software by resolving software defects reported by customers. Software stack includes everything from the kernel all the way up to the user space applications and IaaS platforms. This position leads one of our regional teams and is one of several managers, who report directly to the global Director of Sustaining Engineering.
Our customers build large-scale mission critical infrastructure and application solutions on Ubuntu and open source from Canonical. While not actively developing products, Sustaining Engineering, as part of Support Engineering, solves problems for the customer and for the benefit of the wider Open Source community. This team is well staffed with experts in every time zone and, while the work can be challenging sometimes, the team is resourced to ensure a good work-life balance and ongoing development of each team member.
As an engineering manager in the Sustaining Engineering team, your primary responsibility is to the people you support: ensuring that they are growing as engineers, making valuable contributions, and generally having a great experience at Canonical. Technical leadership and a solid background in software development are a must, so that you are able to help your team members grow professionally. You will have the opportunity to influence the culture, facilitate technical delivery, and work with your team on strategy and execution.
Location: This is a globally remote role, unless specified otherwise.
The role entails

  • Manage and lead a distributed team of engineers
  • Hire, coach, mentor, provide feedback and career development guidance to your team

  • Professional software delivery experience using C, C++, Go, Python, or similar

  • Leadership experience displaying ability to organise and prioritise complex problem resolution and bug fixes
  • Experience with version control systems such as git
  • Experience with debugging tools such as gdb, crash or other

  • Excellent communication skills in the English language, both verbal and written
  • Experience with Linux, with a preference towards Ubuntu
  • Experience with Open Source and Open Source Business Models
  • People management experience in a support organisation is a strong plus
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

description:
Software Engineering Manager - Sustaining Engineering

Join to apply for the Software Engineering Manager - Sustaining Engineering role at Canonical

Software Engineering Manager - Sustaining Engineering

4 days ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Join to apply for the Software Engineering Manager - Sustaining Engineering role at Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1100+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder led, profitable and growing.
We are hiring a Engineering Manager for Sustaining Engineering passionate about open source software, Linux and cloud computing. Come build a rewarding, meaningful career working with the best and brightest people in technology at Canonical, the growing international software company behind Ubuntu.
Sustaining Engineering is a business critical team that continuously improves various open source software by resolving software defects reported by customers. Software stack includes everything from the kernel all the way up to the user space applications and IaaS platforms. This position leads one of our regional teams and is one of several managers, who report directly to the global Director of Sustaining Engineering.
Our customers build large-scale mission critical infrastructure and application solutions on Ubuntu and open source from Canonical. While not actively developing products, Sustaining Engineering, as part of Support Engineering, solves problems for the customer and for the benefit of the wider Open Source community. This team is well staffed with experts in every time zone and, while the work can be challenging sometimes, the team is resourced to ensure a good work-life balance and ongoing development of each team member.
As an engineering manager in the Sustaining Engineering team, your primary responsibility is to the people you support: ensuring that they are growing as engineers, making valuable contributions, and generally having a great experience at Canonical. Technical leadership and a solid background in software development are a must, so that you are able to help your team members grow professionally. You will have the opportunity to influence the culture, facilitate technical delivery, and work with your team on strategy and execution.
Location: This is a globally remote role, unless specified otherwise.
The role entails

  • Manage and lead a distributed team of engineers
  • Hire, coach, mentor, provide feedback and career development guidance to your team
  • Manage & measure key performance indicators (KPIs), and training
  • Support timely delivery of bug fixes, patches, and other technical solutions to address business needs in a variety of technology fields, including but not limited to Ubuntu, OpenStack, Ceph, Kubernetes, Juju & MAAS
  • Demonstrate the very best of Canonical in customer interactions
  • Set and manage expectations with other engineering teams, senior management, and external stakeholders
  • Advocate and advance modern software development practices
  • Grow a healthy, collaborative engineering culture in line with the company value
  • Collaborate with other teams in the organisation
  • Work from home with global travel up to 10% for internal and external events
What we are looking for in you
  • Professional software delivery experience using C, C++, Go, Python, or similar
  • You are knowledgeable and passionate about software development
  • Leadership experience displaying ability to organise and prioritise complex problem resolution and bug fixes
  • Experience with version control systems such as git
  • Experience with debugging tools such as gdb, crash or other
  • Demonstrated strong commitment to testing methodologies and maintainable code quality
  • Excellent communication skills in the English language, both verbal and written
  • Experience with Linux, with a preference towards Ubuntu
  • Experience with Open Source and Open Source Business Models
  • People management experience in a support organisation is a strong plus
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.
